summary: Lazily allocates up to 5 3D sound/transform objects via F_3DSoundEmitter (4 fixed 200-byte + one 204-byte variant), initializing rotation angles to 360.0f and default transform parameters. Ensures each sub-object is allocated exactly once.

name: CamMan_Post

name: GameActionStateMachine

name: ShortComputation_d3c0

name: ShortComputation_d410

name: RaceCommentaryDirectorSystem
summary: Initializes a broadcast/commentary director state machine from a configuration data block, parsing action types (camera, commentary, gridwalk, flyover, etc.), target entities, timing, and probability fields. Part of the race broadcast/cinematic commentary system.

name: ConstantsStructInit
summary: Constructor/initializer: sets 7 fields to literals (0x0, 0x4, 0x8, 0xC, 0x10, 0x14, 0x18). No reads, no globals. [auto]

name: sub_40EA30
summary: Initializes physics collision shape with subtype=2, computes bounding box dimensions from collider data, stores scaled distance-squared values (factor 0.4166667 = 5/12) and writes shape constants to sub-struct. Physics collision system.

name: sub_40ED10

name: PhysicsStateVectorConversion
summary: Converts physics state vector (13 floats) into sub-object fields: sets position + offset, copies components, applies rotation tensor matrix transform, and calls computation subroutine. Mode-based dispatch (0-5). Part of physics/vehicle state system.

name: SceneObjectLoaderStateMachine
summary: 7-mode state machine dispatching loading/unloading of scene objects: checks sub-object status, updates position from sub-object data, processes camera shake and vehicle physics. Part of scene/vehicle loading system.

name: SwitchBasedStateHandler
summary: 8-mode state handler dispatching collision detection, wheel contact distance computation, UI focus changes, and scene node visibility toggles based on mode and vtable flags. Part of vehicle/collision/physics system.

name: UICameraModeDispatchWithVehicleDataRead
summary: Mode-based dispatch: integrates physics state and sets flag for modes 0-5, or reads vehicle telemetry position from sub-object for mode 6. Part of UI/camera/vehicle data integration system.

name: CameraShakeRingBufferWrite
filled_label: Camera Shake Ring Buffer Write / Telemetry Encode
summary: Writes camera shake / vehicle telemetry data into a ring buffer (432 bytes per entry, max 1023 entries). Encodes vehicle position, orientation (as atan2 angles), velocity, and angular velocity as quantized 16-bit integers. Dispatches progress-bar HUD events based on a case-switch over a mode field at this+0x1C (cases 0-5).

name: sub_410AF0
summary: Removes an element from an unordered pointer array by index using swap-with-last (O(1) removal). Complements ArraySlotInsert. Part of dynamic array / handle table system.

name: TextFormatStructInitializer_4d70
summary: Resets a text format struct variant by setting groups of fields (DWORD/DWORD/BYTE triples at varying offsets) to -1/-1/0 across 7 named slots plus 2 extra trailing slots, interleaved with global path string reinitialization via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.

name: SceneListBuilderFromGlobalArray
summary: Clears existing scene list, then builds a new linked list of 92-byte scene entries from the global scene array (stride 0x18c). Each entry is initialized with sub-structs, text format reset, and track TV/PWS path setup via CommentaryTVPWSPathBuilder.

name: AITargetDriverSelection
summary: Classifies each driver slot relative to player: player self (1), teammate (2), scoring/overtake target (3), or retired/invalid (-1). Iterates vehicle entries (4656-byte stride), writes classification dword per slot. Called at race restart for driver targeting init.

name: AIFormationLap
summary: Handles formation lap commentary events for non-player vehicles. In race/practice sessions, uses generic event 6. In championship weekend (session type 7) with non-World-Championship mode, checks lap proximity and formation lap position status to emit specific events (180-182). Part of AI session event pipeline.

name: ConfigIniParser
summary: Parses the game's main .ini config file (config.ini): reads [Components], [Install], [Autolaunch], and [Version] sections, maps key-value pairs to struct fields (video settings, paths, ratings), and handles non-admin directory creation/copying on Windows XP/NT/2000.

name: FieldZeroSetter
summary: Resets driver status field (this[4420] / offset 0x4510) to 0. Called from AIMainUpdate to clear AI driver state at the start of each frame tick.

name: AISteeringCorrection
filled_label: AI Steering Correction and Grip-Degradation Blend
summary: Computes AI steering correction blend factor by combining racing line steering with suspension-ratio-based steering, applying tire grip degradation logic post race-start, and enforcing difficulty-scaled and track-specific limits. Part of AI driver per-frame update.

name: ForcePitExit
summary: Forces AI driver to exit pits by setting a state flag. For race sessions, only acts when NOT on the last lap AND when teammate part lookup returns 0, 4, or driver has FinishState 1. For non-race sessions always forces exit. Calls StateConditionalAction and AIStateFlagSetter.

name: PostPitCleanup
summary: Post-pit-exit cleanup routine. Fills a sentinel slot, optionally increments tire change counter (if flag at 0x4584 is clear), clears timeOfNextExit for race sessions, and sets next pit window timestamp to session time + 4.0. Returns the tire-change flag byte.

name: OpponentProximityScanTeamRecognition
filled_label: AI Opponent Proximity Scan & Team Recognition
summary: Scans all vehicles each frame to find the 5 nearest opponents, sorted by distance, then performs team/class recognition by matching team IDs; also applies overtake-direction heuristics. AI opponent awareness system.

name: AIStateFlagSetter
summary: Sets callToBox flag (this[0x454C]) to 0 or 1. Guarded: only writes when a2 <= 1. Returns the input value unchanged.

name: ParameterValueSetter
summary: Sets vehicle maxSpeed field from input parameter. If parameter ID is 18, uses idle/reverse speed target constant; otherwise casts input directly to float.

name: SmallDataStructInit
summary: Constructor/initializer: sets 6 fields to literals (0x0, 0x4, 0x8, 0xC, 0x10, 0x14). No reads, no globals. [auto]

name: ScoreSlotDeallocator
summary: Frees two dynamically allocated buffers stored at this[1] and this[3], then zeros all four pointer slots. Part of score/configuration slot teardown.

name: CRTMathHelper_e1f0
summary: Parses configuration tokens: scales two doubles by a5 factor, converts a token to int via CRTFtol, and parses/clamps a final index within [0, storedCount-1]. Used for vehicle setup file values.

name: EventTriggerOnStateChange
summary: Detects state change on tracked entity. Compares entity ID and state fields between reference (a2) and current (a3). When IDs match and state differs, copies new state and sets event trigger flags at this[0] and this[0x19A4] to 1.

name: ConfigFileParser
summary: Writes auto-load entries from internal linked list to a config file. Builds physics file path, opens file, iterates linked list nodes writing each entry via AutoLoadEntryWriter, then closes file.

name: LookUpVehicleConfigEntry
summary: Searches auto-load entry linked list for vehicle config matching settings folder and session type. Returns 0 with matching path string, or 1 with default path if no match found.

name: PiecewiseFunctionEval
filled_label: Piecewise function evaluation with boundary correction
summary: Evaluates a 2-input piecewise function with multiple linear segments selected by sign and magnitude of inputs. Applies additional correction terms when the primary input exceeds defined range boundaries. Used for non-linear spring/damper characteristic curves in the constraint solver.

name: sub_447F30
filled_label: Vehicle Physics Data Extraction to Float Array
summary: Extracts vehicle physics state (position, orientation, velocity, wheel data) from the physics object into a flat float array for telemetry/external consumption. Transforms body-frame vectors using rotation matrix and computes derived values.

name: BoundingBoxComputationFromTriangles
summary: Scans triangle vertex data to compute 2D axis-aligned bounding box (XZ plane), then stores center coordinates and inverse-half-extent scale factors for use in collision spatial subdivision/indexing.

name: FrustumViewportSetup
filled_label: Set viewport rectangle and projection factors
summary: Configures a viewport rectangle from top, left, bottom, right coordinates: stores bounds, computes center point, and pre-calculates reciprocal half-width and half-height for projection transformations. Called during cursor initialization and input restart.

name: VehicleOrientationMatrixConstruction
filled_label: Vehicle Orientation Matrix & Network Packet Writer
summary: Constructs a 4x4 vehicle orientation matrix from forward/up/right direction vectors (negated velocity components at offsets 264-280), then iterates 8 sub-blocks writing 12-byte rows via NetworkPacketDataWriter for network transmission.

name: ShortComputation_b360
summary: Initializes a 3D UI/render object with 8 viewport sub-structures. Sets vtable to RenderUIObject table (off_59F080), initializes sub-object at offset 4, configures 8 viewport blocks (92 bytes each) with default values (-1, -1.0f, 3), calls per-index field resetter for each viewport, and clears remaining state fields (0x31C, 0x320, 0x324, 0x328).

name: ClientGridDisplayTimer
summary: Timer-driven client grid overlay controller. Decrements a 7.5-second timer each call; on expiry, evaluates scene state and toggles the grid display flag. Resets timer after evaluation.

name: StructFieldZeroInitWithDefaults
summary: Constructor/initializer: sets 13 fields to literals (0x0, 0x4, 0x24, 0x3C, 0x5C, 0x7C, 0x7D, 0x7E...). No reads, no globals. [auto]

name: sub_461560
summary: Constructor/initializer: sets 22 fields to literals (0x0, 0x20, 0x40, 0x60, 0x64, 0x65, 0x66, 0x67...). No reads, no globals. [auto]

name: sub_485EB0
summary: Complex destructor for a UI component. Resets vtable, frees five individual sub-pointers, then traverses and frees three linked lists of nodes (each node has a data pointer and an ownership flag at offset +8), zeros all list head fields, and calls final cleanup.

name: LargeStructZeroInit
summary: Initializes a large screen/UI data structure (0x18EC+ bytes): zeros most fields, sets sentinel values (-1 for unsigned max), initializes sub-objects via helper constructors, and assigns a vtable pointer. Part of the screen-data initialization system called during game setup.

name: sub_499910
summary: State-machine iterator for traversing a tree hierarchy. Manages three states (init/sibling-descend/child-iterate) to walk nodes depth-first. Stops when done flag sets. Part of rendering tree traversal.

name: DestructorWithMultipleConditionalFrees
summary: Destructor that sets the vtable pointer (offset 0x00), recursively destroys a tree node via TreeNodeRecursiveDestructor, frees a linked list at offset 0x6C via LinkedListFree, then conditionally frees up to 10 pointer fields (offsets 0x10 through 0x58, step 0x08) via FreeWrapper_7bcf if non-NULL.

name: RangeProportionInitializer
summary: Initializes a float range min/max pair and precomputes inverse range for proportion calculation. Sets field 0/2/4 to min, max, and (if range positive) 1/(max-min) for fast linear interpolation lookups.

name: FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall
summary: Processes an array of pit-crew-related objects when the pending flag (bit 0) is set. Iterates through objects at base `this[4]` (each 120 bytes), calls Bit12FlagSet on non-null entries. Optionally updates UI widgets if detail level ≥ 2 and `this[5]` is non-zero. Clears flag bits 0-1 at end.

name: FlagSetterWithOR
summary: Stores a caller-supplied value into `this[4]` and sets the dirty/change flag (bit 1 on `this[0]`) to signal that the stored value was updated. Called by PitStopOperationTimer to record a pit operation parameter change.

name: FloatToRGBColorConversion
filled_label: Float to packed RGB color conversion
summary: Converts 3 float color channel values (R, G, B) to a packed 40-bit color format by clamping to [-65536, 65536] range, scaling by 32768, and packing into 3 output dword/byte fields. Part of rendering/color pipeline.

name: sub_4B2310
filled_label: Float vector to compact int16+dword pack
summary: Copies 3 source dword values to output, and converts 3 float values to int16 by clamping to [-16, 16] range and scaling by 2048. Packs vertex position or similar vector data into compact format (3×32-bit + 3×16-bit).

name: UtilityFunction_2480
summary: Converts 3 float values to int16 by clamping to [-655.34, 655.34] range and scaling by 50.0. Packs vertex/vector data into compact int16 format. Inverse of ShortVectorToFloatWithScale.

name: ProgressBarEventEncode
summary: Packs multiple parameters (event ID, sub-type, session type, etc.) into a bitfield word at offset 0x0 for progress bar UI event dispatch. Stores secondary data at offset 0x4 and resets flag at offset 0x1AC to -1.

name: DeterministicHashPseudoRandomGenerator
summary: Generates pseudo-random DWORD by combining RDTSC timestamp, GetTickCount, LCG random, and internal state counters (0x0, 0x804). Reads from a float noise table indexed by auto-incrementing counter. Part of random number generation system.

name: NetworkMessageDispatch
summary: Dispatches a network message (a2) by finding or allocating a matching node, then enqueues it with state data and calls threshold comparison. Manages a free list and an active singly-linked list.

name: MemoryAllocation_afc0
summary: Allocates a 4-byte pointer block and a 2036-byte initialized block with two 1016-byte sub-chunks. Creates a list node referencing the block and inserts it into the first list. Creates two stride-offset nodes in the second list.

name: MultiLevelAllocation
summary: Allocates a 4-byte pointer block and a 2036-byte initialized block with two 1016-byte sub-chunks. Creates a list node referencing the block and inserts it into the first list. Creates two stride-offset nodes in the second list. [twin of MemoryAllocation_afc0]

name: DynamicArrayPush
summary: Appends a value to a dynamic integer array (capacity at this[0], count at this[1], data at this[2]); grows capacity by 8 when full by allocating a new buffer, copying existing elements, and freeing the old buffer.

name: AIDriverSorting
summary: Compares an AI driver's race progress against other drivers and swaps position values when the driver should overtake. Handles race session (lap+time comparison) vs other sessions (best-lap comparison).

name: DoubleListCleanup
summary: Destructor for a structure containing two singly-linked lists. Walks each list, frees nodes and optionally their data payloads when the ownership flag (node+8) is set. Performs three passes: first list cleanup with PitStopMemoryCleanup, second list cleanup with ShortComputation_4370, then a final verification pass on the first list. Zeros all pointers afterward.

name: PlayerCareerStatsGameOptionsLoader
summary: Loads player career statistics and game options from save data — reads season state files, track stats, and game configuration parameters, building internal linked lists of career data records; validates track/directory existence before committing results.

name: ParticleCollisionEffect
summary: Spawn trail particles from three collision effect slots (index 8, 9, 10) when the collision point has moved sufficiently. Each slot tracks previous position; on significant movement (>0.15 or >0.06 distance), spawns a trail particle with noise and velocity scaling. Third slot also spawns a secondary offset trail at higher throttle.

name: sub_4D0110
filled_label: Grid girl / track-side model placement and animation initializer
summary: Allocates and initializes per-vehicle track-side decoration structures (grid girls, sign models): assigns random models/textures, positions them using weather noise tables and spatial grid queries, loads meshes and animations, and sets up rendering resources. Part of the track decoration / scene dressing system.

name: ResourceDestroy
summary: If *this (a file handle) is non-zero, performs cleanup: writes 8 zero bytes to state, reads 4 bytes back, closes the file handle, and sets *this to 0. File handle destroy/close sequence.

name: DivisionWithThreshold
summary: Performs a guarded division: if divisor a3 <= 0, uses FLT_MAX (3.4028235e38) instead. Stores the (possibly clamped) divisor in this[1], and the result of (a2 - 1.0) / divisor in this[0].

name: BoundingBoxComputation
summary: Computes 3D axis-aligned bounding box (min/max X,Y,Z) of a scene graph node. Initializes min to +FLT_MAX and max to -FLT_MAX, iterates scene graph children, filters by LOD level, extracts vertex data via PackedArray, and records extents. Returns child count.

name: sub_4DFBB0
summary: Constructor/initializer: sets 5 fields to literals (0x0, 0x90, 0x94, 0xBA8, 0x2BD4). No reads, no globals. [auto]

name: VehicleStateUpdate_19d0
summary: Per-frame vehicle dashboard/HUD update — propagates position/rotation transforms to wheel sub-objects and active components, detects state changes (low-grip warning, gear changes, byte flags), and dispatches sound/visual cues via sub_5506A0.

name: sub_4E58D0
summary: Computes spring/damper forces from suspension displacement in local frame with gravity compensation, accumulating results per-axis. Part of suspension dynamics system.

name: CollisionDetectionSystem
summary: Per-frame collision detection system for a vehicle: iterates 13 contact-point slots, reads collision events from network packets, transforms contact points to world space, identifies colliding vehicle pairs, computes collision response (penetration depth, contact normal, impulse force), and dispatches force application to both vehicles.

name: F_3DVectorAddition
summary: Sets three consecutive DWORD fields at offsets 0x0, 0x4, and 0x8 from three input parameters. [twin of TripleFieldSetter_6280]

name: F_6FieldStructInit
summary: Reads 6 coordinate/component values from three vertex sources referenced by input index array and writes them into output buffer; used by collision and tessellation subsystems to extract face vertex data. [twin of CollisionFaceVerticesGather]

name: FuelConsumptionAndWear
filled_label: Fuel Consumption and Component Wear Update
summary: Per-frame update of fuel consumption, tire wear, and random mechanical failures (engine, gearbox, puncture). Decrements fuel based on throttle and engine power, applies tire wear using track grip interpolation, and triggers random failure events at cooldown intervals.

name: WheelContactTransform
filled_label: wheel contact transform with collision feature query
summary: Transforms per-corner vectors by 3x3 rotation matrix, adds offset, queries collision normal from feature, and updates surface friction for each of 4 wheel contacts. Part of wheel contact/collision system.

name: VehicleSoundTrigger
summary: Triggers vehicle sound/HUD events based on wheel contact/force surface types, velocity change, timer state, and rigid body status. Part of vehicle audio/HUD system.

name: VehicleYawRotationRecoveryController
summary: Detects excessive vehicle yaw rotation (spinning/flipping) and triggers recovery by resetting vehicle dynamics state, recomputing orientation from atan2 of direction components, and snapping position to the racing line. Monitors wheel contact states and applies corrective contact forces for partial loss of ground contact.

name: ArithmeticComparison_3490
summary: Reads three long double values via string parser, then enforces non-negativity by applying fabs to each. Used during vehicle file parsing to normalize parameter tuples.

name: sub_4FAF60
summary: Computes suspension contact geometry for a vehicle physics node: calculates distance vectors from reference position to linked neighbor objects, normalizes the direction, computes approach angles via atan2, and propagates cosine similarity values through a chain of up to 4 linked physics nodes. Vehicle suspension/physics system.

name: sub_4FBA10
summary: Initializes cloud and skybox rendering state: resolves scene graph nodes for skybox and three cloud layers (normal, snowy, rainy), builds arrays of cloud node handles from the audio network graph, computes cloud opacity and noise-driven animation speeds, and calculates bounding boxes. Called during weather setup from sub_4FCAA0.

name: RangeInterpolationTable
summary: Populates a 16-entry interpolation lookup table (offsets 0x64–0xA0) from a [min, max] range at fixed interpolation fractions (0.0, 0.01, 0.03, 0.05, 0.06, 0.14, 0.25, 0.37, 0.5, 0.63, 0.75, 0.86, 0.94, 0.99, 1.0). Used to precompute parameter curves for physics and audio subsystems.

name: sub_4FE350
summary: Initializes weather, track temperature, and wetness data for a race session by searching linked-list data entries for the best-matching session type and minute markers. Builds a time-keyed linked list of weather condition snapshots used during gameplay. Session/weather system.

name: ImageTextureDecompressor
summary: State-machine-driven image texture decompressor. Decodes streaming texture data via setjmp/longjmp error recovery. Handles format 50 (raw RGBA copy) and format 22 (24-bit RGB unpacked from 16-bit RGB565 source). Allocates output pixel buffer on decode.

name: sub_50F632
filled_label: Render/camera object initialization with parameter dispatch
summary: Initializes a render/camera object `a1` with parameters `a2` and `a3`. Dispatches through vtable for non-default values, zeroes the 0x1A8-byte structure (preserving vtable), sets up render init via `RenderVTableObjectInit` and camera setup via `DirectorCameraObjectSetup`, then stores field values including count=200.

name: sub_50FF84
summary: Initializes/resets state fields in a command dispatch context object. Sets state code to 101 (or 60 if a re-entry flag is set), clears and configures arrays of byte/word fields, and sets the re-entry guard byte to 1.

name: sub_51030D
filled_label: Stream command parser with slot table lookup
summary: Parses a command structure from a byte stream. Reads a 3-byte header (size + slot count), validates size=2*count+6, looks up each slot ID in a 21-dword entry table, stores nibble-flag parameters, reads a 4-byte trailer, and dispatches state throughout parsing.

name: FunctionTableInit
summary: Populates an 8-entry function pointer table with math/geometry transform functions: Vec2AffineTransform, sub_517569, sub_517653, two 4x4 matrix multiply variants, Mat2x2Mul, sub_5175F4, and VectorNormalize.

name: MediaBufferAlloc
summary: Allocates a media playback buffer (80 bytes), sets its vtable to PlaybackStateController, conditionally patches vtable entries, then fills frame buffer slots from sub-struct dimension data via VertexBufferOffsetSetup.

name: AudioSubbandSynthesisFilterbank
summary: Performs MPEG audio subband synthesis — applies inverse quantization, inverse modified DCT, and polyphase filterbank to reconstruct PCM samples from 32 subband frequency-domain data. Part of the MPEG Layer 2/3 audio decoding subsystem.

name: FAILOverviewSaysFIRCrossfeedButDispatchesToIMDCT
summary: Dispatches per-object audio processing based on mode field (AudioSampleLookup, AudioFIRConvolutionFilter, FixedPointIDCT, render branch, audio mixing) and performs optional data transformation (copy, round-multiply, or float-multiply).

name: MediaAudioDecodeDispatch
summary: Allocates a decode descriptor table and populates it with function pointers selected based on media surface format, dimensions, and resampling requirements. Dispatches to the appropriate pixel copy/blend/filter routine (monochrome duplicate, interleave copy, pixel blend, image resample, or track map fill) for each sub-surface.

name: F_4x4ReflectionOrientationMatrixMultiply
summary: Multiplies a 4x4 reflection/orientation matrix (a2) with a rotation-like matrix derived from normalized input vector/quaternion (a3), storing 4-row result at output (a1). Normalizes a3 using Newton-Raphson refinement with lazy one-time constant initialization via byte_8D46B0 flags. Alignment-aware store path (unaligned stores if output address not 16-byte aligned). Part of SSE 3D math library.

name: QuaternionToRotationMatrix_fb1e
summary: Converts a quaternion (a2) to a 4x4 rotation matrix (a1) using SSE intrinsics. Loads quaternion, applies bitmask, normalizes via Newton-Raphson refined inverse sqrt, then computes 4 rotation matrix rows from quaternion component products using precomputed constants. Part of SSE math library.

name: QuaternionToRotationMatrix_0a7e
summary: Normalizes quaternion (a3) using Newton-Raphson refinement with lazy one-time constant initialization (via byte_8D46B0), then multiplies with matrix (a2) to produce 4-row rotation matrix output (a1). Uses distinct global constants (xmmword_5D8C60-CA0, dword_8D6220/24) from the related function at 0051f98e. Alignment-aware store path. Part of SSE math library.

name: SSEReciprocalSquareRootWithNewtonRaphsonQuaterni
summary: Converts a quaternion (a2) to a 4x4 rotation matrix (a1) using SSE intrinsics. Loads quaternion, applies bitmask (xmmword_5D8D20), normalizes via Newton-Raphson refined inverse sqrt using constants dword_5D8D00/D10, then computes 4 rotation matrix rows from quaternion component products with distinct constants (xmmword_5D8CB0-5D8CF0). Similar algorithm to QuaternionToRotationMatrix_fb1e but with different constants. Part of SSE math library.

name: F_3DNowMatrixConstructor
summary: Initializes a 4x4 matrix (8 __m64 values) in a1 with identity-like rotation (1.0/0 constants at specific cells) and packs three float parameters (a2, a3, a4) plus 1.0 into the last row via punpckldq to form the translation part of a transformation matrix.

name: F_3DNowQuaternionFromAngle
filled_label: 3DNow! construct 4x4 rotation matrix from quaternion + normalized axis
summary: Normalizes input a3 via F_3DVectorNormalize_7578 into stacked v14/v15 (16 bytes), then combines with quaternion/vector a2 via dot-product-like operations (pfmul/pfadd) and negated copies (XOR 0x80000000) to fill all 8 __m64 slots of output a1, forming a 4x4 rotation matrix.

name: QuaternionTo4x4RotationMatrix
summary: Normalizes quaternion from a2 via F_3DVectorNormalize_7578 into v11/v12, then constructs a 4x4 rotation matrix in a1 using the standard quaternion-to-matrix formula: computes terms -2*q² and -2*qu with pfmul(0xC0000000 = -2.0f), shuffles components via punpckldq/punpckhdq, and fills all 8 __m64 slots with pfadd/pfmul combinations including identity elements (1065353216 = 1.0f).

name: F_3DNowTransformationMatrixConstruction
filled_label: 3DNow! construct 4x4 transformation matrix from angle parameter
summary: Loads single float parameter a2 into mm0, expands via PackedFloatingPointMath to populate both dword halves, then builds a 4x4 transformation matrix in a1 with identity-like rotation elements, the parameter and its negated copy (XOR 0x80000000) placed at specific matrix cells, forming an axis-specific rotation or shear transformation.

name: SymmetricTransformMatrix3DNow
filled_label: 3DNow! construct symmetric 4x4 transformation matrix from parameter
summary: Loads packed float parameter a2, masks low dword with pand(0xFFFFFFFF), shifts high dword via psrlqi(32), calls PackedFloatingPointMath for setup, then builds a 4x4 matrix in a1 with symmetric entries: parameter value at diagonal positions (a1[0]=a1[5]), negated high dword at a1[1], identity elements (0x3F800000=1.0f) at a1[2]/a1[7], and high dword at a1[4].

name: F_3DNowQuaternionFromEncodedAxisAngle
filled_label: 3DNow! decode axis-angle parameter to 4x4 transformation matrix
summary: Loads encoded axis-angle value a2 into mm0, expands via PackedFloatingPointMath, then builds a 4x4 matrix in a1: the encoded value goes to a1[0], a negated reshuffled copy (via punpckhdq/punpckldq with XOR 0x80000000) to a1[2], identity 1.0f elements at a1[5] and a1[7], and zeros elsewhere.

name: F_3DNowMatrixVectorMath
filled_label: 3DNow! composite transformation matrix from rotation, translation, and scale components
summary: Composes a 4x4 transformation matrix from up to 6 optional input parameters: computes 3x3 inverse of rotation a3 (same algorithm as sub_522B5B), constructs identity + translation from a2, applies a4 parameter data, then optionally post-multiplies by a6 rotation and adds translation a7. Handles all null-pointer cases with identity matrix fallback. Accumulates results iteratively over all non-null inputs.

name: F_3DNowPackedFloatMatrixQuaternionOps
filled_label: 3DNow! multiply quaternions and convert to 4x4 rotation matrix
summary: Scales input quaternions a2 and a3 by 0.5 (0x3F0000003F000000LL), multiplies them via 3DNow! quaternion multiplication with component shuffling and sign flips, then converts the result to a 4x4 rotation matrix using the cofactor/adjugate pattern (same as sub_522B5B): 2x multiplications, cross-term products, 1.0 - trace subtraction (pfsubr 0x3F8000003F800000LL), and homogeneous row {0, 0, 0, 1.0}.

name: F_4x4TransformationMatrixConstructor
filled_label: 3DNow! construct 4x4 transform from scale, rotation, and translation
summary: Builds composite 4x4 transformation matrix: starts with diagonal scale matrix from parameter a2 (repeated at a1[0], a1[2] high, a1[5]), then if a4 (rotation) is non-null, computes 3x3 adjugate/inverse rotation matrix (same pattern as sub_522B5B) and optionally applies a3 translation by subtraction + matrix multiply. Finally applies a5 additive translation if non-null.

name: SIMDQuaternionRotationArithmetic

summary: Handles repair/service events for AI commentary. Maps event subtype (0-5) to different event codes for player vehicle (106-111) vs AI vehicles (221-223). Triggered from repair service state dispatcher. Part of AI session event pipeline.

name: ConfigDirectoryPathRegistration
summary: Registers all configuration directory paths by copying path string constants for audio, circuits, drivers, movies, options, replays, and other data directories, then initializes default config structure fields with preset values (including a count of 22 registered paths and a -1.0f sentinel).

name: sub_424080
filled_label: AI driver difficulty and scenario configuration loader
summary: Loads AI driver configuration from vehicle-specific data files: reads driver ability stats (starts dry/wet, qualifying ability, race ability, rain ability, track aggression, passing, cornering, crash probability, completed laps, script), applies difficulty scaling and track grip modifiers, and optionally injects mechanical failure events (engine, brakes, gearbox, suspension, stall) for season/career mode. Part of the AI driver setup system.

name: RandomWeightedTierSelection
summary: Selects tire compound tier based on track grip level (flt_8AFEE8). Uses tier thresholds with randomized boundaries for variety at mid ranges. Falls back to this[0x458C] (nextChosenTires) at very low grip. Maps chosen tier to a compound index via CompoundIndexLookup and TireCompoundNameIDMapping.

name: Game_Enter
summary: Game session initialization entry point — sequentially initializes all subsystems (OS manager, game files, video, special FX, dynamics, player data, audio configs, sound, input, on-screen display, game modules) and loads audio asset directories. Returns 1 on any init failure, 0 on success.

name: Game_Setup
summary: Master game initialization: sets game state to "loading" (2), parses device path string, then sequentially initializes all game subsystems — input, scoring, options, special effects, physics steward, dynamics manager, sound, on-screen display, video manager, player file, and module manager.

name: Game_Init
summary: Top-level game initialization function that sequentially starts all major subsystems (video, scene, AI, sound, rendering, input, physics, camera, special effects, UI, session manager). Sets game state to 3 (init phase) and returns 1 if video init fails.

name: Game_Restart
summary: Executes a full game restart sequence: sets game state to 4 (restarting), then calls restart/reset functions for all engine subsystems in dependency order — sound, special effects, input, dynamics, camera, rendering, HUD, video, player file, AI, and scoring. Part of the game state machine and session management system.

name: GamePostMainLoop
summary: Main per-frame game processing loop: dispatches session state checks, runs the multi-phase physics/scoring/collision pipeline, updates camera, weather, rendering, HUD, and force feedback subsystems, then checks for loop exit conditions. Core game loop / main tick orchestrator.

name: Game_Post
summary: Main per-frame Post() dispatch: calls all engine subsystems in order — guarded dispatch, nested call loop, sound, special FX, steward, hardware input, dynamics, camera, render, on-screen display, video manager, player file, and session state — then sets multiplayer flags to 3. Called from GameMainEntry.

name: GameExit
summary: Orchestrates full game teardown: logs entry, shuts down subsystems (sound, special effects, input, display, DynMan, OnScreen, session), and closes main handle. Sets game state to 7 (exiting).

name: VehicleSetupFileWriter
summary: Serializes the complete vehicle setup configuration (suspension, aero, driveline, engine, tires, brakes, controls) into a formatted text file. Writes all setup parameters as labeled key-value pairs, validates gear settings against limits, and appends setup notes.

name: StringCapitalizer
summary: Converts a string to title case in-place: capitalizes the first letter of each word (letters following non-letter characters) and lowercases all other letters.

name: AISettingsFileResolver
summary: Resolves the full AI settings file path by combining base directory with settings entry from linked-list lookup tables, based on session type. AI settings/session configuration system.

name: RigidBodyConstraintJointSolver
filled_label: Rigid body constraint joint solver loop
summary: Iterates over joint constraints between two rigid bodies, computes position and angular error, and applies corrective impulses via angular momentum accumulation. Part of the physics constraint solver system.

name: SuspensionWheelDynamicsSolver
summary: Core per-frame vehicle suspension and wheel dynamics solver — computes constraint forces via an LCP (Linear Complementarity Problem) approach with Gram-Schmidt projection, evaluates suspension spring/damper curves from lookup tables, and integrates velocity states for 4 wheels across multiple suspension modes. Vehicle physics system.

name: sub_448140
summary: Initializes helicopter audio subsystem (loads helicopter.wav, sets engine RPM-based DSP parameters) and links scene graph entities for heli system. Called once from Steward_Init.

name: QuaternionRotationStructureInitialize
summary: Initializes a quaternion/rotation structure (0x60 bytes): copies first 4 dwords from input source, duplicates axes 2 and 3 into offsets +0x10 and +0x14, zeroes a 0x2C-byte block (offsets 0x1C-0x47), sets sentinel at +0x48 to -1, and zeroes remaining fields. Called from spatial tree and mesh adjacency builder.

name: sub_44BC50
summary: Loads collision geometry from scene track file, allocates and initializes collision object and BVH node arrays, linearizes bounding volume hierarchy, processes contact pair linkages, and stores resulting pointers in output struct.

name: HTreeTerrainFileFormatLoader
summary: Opens and validates a terrain H-tree file by checking version string and header fields, allocates and populates collision object arrays and tree node buffer, then deserializes collision tree structure from file data.

name: HWInput_Exit
summary: Exits HWInput state: destructs collision objects, cleans up cursor resource and collision culling, releases the DirectInput device, and optionally unloads input module module when render flag indicates.

name: sub_4572B0
summary: Parses a static camera scene configuration file — reads position, orientation, LOD, clipping, color, and activation parameters from a key-value config and writes them into a camera descriptor struct. Part of the camera/scene loading subsystem.

name: F_2DTransformStructCopy
summary: Copies a source 2D transform/viewport structure (position, scale, rotation, clip rectangle, string data) into a destination struct field-by-field using multiple getter subroutines. Handles null-safe string copy with buffer reallocation.

name: sub_4585E0
filled_label: Renderable Object / Environment Effect Configuration Parser
summary: Parses a named configuration block for a renderable scene object or environmental effect: reads position, orientation, color, clip-planes, LOD/mipmap bias, size, center, flags, activation-zone (location + radius), tracking/movement rates, and movement path from a tokenised data source, then copies all values into the target struct with defaults applied when parsing is skipped.

name: sub_459330
summary: Copies camera/viewport configuration from a source definition struct into the destination camera object, including view position, target, FOV parameters, clipping planes, and optional buffer data.

name: FloatDoubleCoordinateTransform
summary: Converts float-precision position (offsets 4,8,12) and rotation (offsets 16,20,24) to double-precision. Stores position as 3 doubles at offset 0xD8, computes 3x3 rotation tensor matrix stored at offset 0x138, and saves position backup at offset 0xC0. If trigger flag at 0xD0 is set, calls external processing and clears buffer before conversion.

name: VehicleOrientationFromAngularVelocityIntegration
summary: Integrates angular velocity over time delta to update vehicle orientation. Reads angular velocity components, computes incremental rotation, extracts Euler angles from rotation matrix, and forwards result for body-state update. Part of vehicle physics integration system.

name: FileScanner
summary: Clears previous scan results, frees linked list of file entries, then re-scans directory for .gdb, .hdv, and terrain.ini files using type-specific check functions. Initializes random seed bytes. Part of resource file enumeration for scene loading.

name: TerrainSurfaceRoughnessHeightSampling
summary: Samples terrain surface roughness/height at a given index: validates surface type, checks cached height, otherwise decodes packed height data, computes weighted average over sample window, caches result, and computes penetration compensation for surface type 16. Part of terrain/collision system.

name: sub_45CD70
summary: Decodes a 6-byte XOR key from obfuscated source (byte_59F0C4 ^ 0x3E) into scratch globals dword_8D4680-8C, then calls sub_561BF0 with the decoded key, config pointer (off_5C5B68), and four callback function pointers. Sets initialized flag at this[0] on success. Only executes once.

name: NetworkReplayBufferInit
summary: Initializes replay/network buffer structure: stores session port, clears flag byte, XOR-decodes obfuscation key data into global buffers, then allocates a memory object for network encoding.

name: sub_464D30
summary: Reinitializes a collision-sensor or physics-tracking data structure: stores a new input value, resets performance timer, walks and frees four linked lists of allocated nodes, clears all list-head pointers, and reinitializes collision sensor entries via CollisionSensorInit. Part of the collision detection / physics data management system.

summary: Destructor for the track database object: cleans up linked lists of track segments and curve data, frees heap-allocated memory arrays, invokes virtual destructors on child objects with vtable checks, and zeros all internal pointer fields to prevent dangling references.

name: sub_4963D0
summary: Iterates through all internal linked lists of managed resources (generic objects, collision geometry, cursor textures, MAS audio handles), calls each resource's destructor via vtable dispatch, and frees memory. Part of the global manager shutdown sequence executed on game exit.

name: sub_496E90
filled_label: Car Crash Damage / UI Render State Machine
summary: Orchestrates car crash damage processing and UI rendering for the damage/repair screen. First calls CarCrashDamageProcessing; if it returns true, returns 0 immediately. Otherwise iterates a linked list of crash damage nodes (8 primary + chained via field 26), calling virtual dispatch per-node to get screen coordinates, then renders damage overlays, combo lists, and text dialogs. Manages a timer at this+0x44 (float, decremented by FloatFieldAccessor) for timed UI transitions.

name: FunctionCallWrapper_91e0
summary: Constructor for a UI element: zeroes sentinel/index fields, sets vtable to off_5ACA74 (UIElementVTable), and registers with system via sub_4992E0. Part of UI element creation pipeline.

name: LinkedListDestroy
filled_label: Linked-list node destruction with conditional vtable call
summary: Walks a linked list freeing each node; conditionally calls virtual destructor (vtable[0]) on nodes with flag at offset 0xC set and valid vtable pointer. Zeros list fields after loop. Part of list/container teardown.

name: StructEquality
summary: Compares two object instances by checking equality of six DWORD fields (offsets 0x00, 0x04, 0x08, 0x0C, 0x1C, 0x20) in order. Returns TRUE if all match, FALSE on first mismatch. Fields at offsets 0x10-0x18 and 0x24-0x30 are not compared.

name: F_2DRectangleRender
summary: Renders a 2D textured rectangle (quad) with computed UV coordinates. Stores rectangle parameters as floats, computes UV scale from texture dimensions, and renders 4 vertices with sub_553650.

name: sub_4A2220
summary: Initializes a pit crew animation structure with default values and releases any previously allocated resources (3D sound source, buffer, array of 28-byte animation elements). Reinit/destructor hybrid called during cleanup and loader reentry.

name: ArrayResourceCleanup
summary: Cleans up an array of 120-byte pit crew animation sub-structs and releases associated resources (3D sound source). Zeros 3 header DWORDs, iterates over elements calling sub_4A2220 destructor on each, frees the array block, then destroys the sound source.

name: PitCrewAnimationLoader
summary: Parses pit crew animation definition files (.ANM): reads ACTOR/MESH/POSITION/MOVE/ROTATE directives, allocates actor entry array (120 bytes per actor, 30 dwords), maps wheel-on/off MTS meshes to mode-dependent subsystem calls, and initializes rendering resources.

name: PitCrewAnimationMASSetup
summary: Loads pit-crew animation MAS files from season/track-specific directories, builds file paths with left/normal hand variants, and sets up animation range parameters for pit crew members. Part of pit stop animation system.

name: AIStateMachineWithModeDispatch
summary: Main AI state machine dispatcher. Reads state from ring buffer entry `a2` (byte at +8 = mode, float at +4 = value). Updates internal mode (offset 0x184), calls AIPitStrategyState on mode change. Based on vehicle sub-state (offset 0x32C8 == 2/3) and mode, dispatches to sub_4A5EA0 (mode 2, pits-under-red) or sub_4A5F20 (mode 0). Then dispatches steering/physics via ConditionalDelegateDispatch + sub_4A3320 for modes 1/2, or FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall for mode 0.

name: sub_4A5EA0
summary: Handles the "entering pits under red flag" scenario. Fires once (guarded by flag at offset 0x180). Records state change to 2, updates session phase, processes vehicle pit state (offset +0x4034). If race start gate flag is 2 and penalties are enabled, either disqualifies (session type 7) or applies time penalty (sub_4BBA90 with 1000.0).

name: sub_4A5F20
summary: Handles the "exiting pits under red flag" scenario. Fires once when flag at offset 0x180 is set. Records state change to 0, increments pit exit counter (offset +0x406C+56), calls AIFormationLap. If race config gate flag is 2 and penalties enabled, either disqualifies (session type 7) or applies time penalty (sub_4BBA90 with 1000.0). Always calls ShortComputation_3fe0 on sub-object at offset 0x14.

name: VehicleProximityCollisionDetection
summary: Checks if vehicle is within proximity collision range of another object, evaluates direction/velocity for collision response, and triggers collision state notification. Part of vehicle physics/tick system.

name: PitStopReadyCheck
summary: Determines if vehicle is ready for pit stop by checking wheel speed, race session state, and tire compound decision. Sets pit stop timer and triggers pit lane entry logic. Part of pit state machine.

name: PitStopOperationTimer
filled_label: Pit Stop Operation Timer & Sequence Coordinator
summary: Manages pit stop operation timing per frame — computes max duration of all pending operations (tire change, jack, wheel gun, refueling), tracks progress, dispatches audio/visual effects, and handles crew condition checks. Pit stop system.

name: PitStopProgress
filled_label: Pit Stop Progress Timer and State Machine
summary: Manages pit stop progress each tick: applies wheel damage repair forces on a timed schedule, controls pit speed limiter, triggers pit exit state transitions, handles post-pit cleanup and camera mode changes.

name: CollisionAvoidanceCheck
summary: Checks vehicle's movement direction against all other vehicles' projected trajectories to detect imminent collisions. Transitions collision avoidance state between checking and clear. Part of vehicle physics/tick.

name: VehicleControlEnabled
summary: Evaluates whether vehicle controls should be enabled by checking session type, damage/health status fields, car control mode, and force feedback state. Returns false if car is non-operational.

name: PitStateUpdateMachine
summary: Main pit state machine that dispatches to collision detection, pit stop readiness, pit progress, and collision avoidance based on current pit state (entering/in-pit/exiting). Coordinates vehicle control enable checks and state transitions.

name: StaticInitBulk
summary: Bulk destructor/cleanup for a large object (~4680 DWORDs). Calls DoubleListCleanup, frees arrays of two-pointer structs in loops (36-byte stride), calls ShortComputation_4370 on many short fields, frees multi-pointer structs, then walks a linked list at the head freeing each node and its payload, finally zeroing the first 4 DWORDs.

name: sub_4AE750
summary: Initializes vehicle damage/part-state arrays based on an input mode selector. Clamps the input value within valid range, then sets paired flag+value fields (enabled/disabled booleans + part type IDs) for different damage configurations across front, rear, side, and wheel components.

name: CollisionObjectListManagement
summary: Manages 4 collision object sub-lists: rebuilds/sorts lists, finds global minimum float threshold, removes entries within ±0.02 tolerance of minimum, processes removed entries through collision dispatch pipeline, returns count processed. Called from sub_4B7860 for per-frame collision management.

name: PhysicsObjectListManager
summary: Drains all 4 collision object sub-lists: removes each node, frees type-1 buffers, reallocates node as free list entry and prepends to global free pool. Stores session time at offset 0x6C, resets sub-list metadata, sets enable flag to 1. Called from QuadrupleListCleanup and PitstopActionSet.

name: sub_4B5E50
summary: Iterates 104 slots (stride 16 bytes), each containing a linked list head/tail/count. For each non-empty slot, destroys all existing nodes (freeing data payloads), reinitializes the underlying data via StructInitWithGlobalData, and relinks nodes into a new list at this+0x10.

name: LinkedBufferTransfer
summary: Iterates a doubly-linked source list at this+0x714, removing each node and its data pointer, then reinitializing the data via SmallStructZeroInit and relinking into a singly-linked output list at this+0x30. Frees source node wrappers and creates new 12-byte wrappers for the output.

name: ModelSceneFileLoader
summary: Deserializes a binary model/scene file: reads string tables and byte flags from the stream, allocates and links scene-object nodes into two managed linked lists (at this+0x6C0 and this+0x714), processes per-node format headers, and computes bounding extent values. Part of the game-data file I/O system.

name: sub_4B7860
filled_label: Circular Buffer Processor With List Output
summary: Processes entries from the circular buffer via CollisionObjectListManagement, collecting results into a doubly-linked list at this+0x714. Advances the buffer read index via RingBufferCounterWithWrap. Returns 1 if processing occurred, 0 if buffer not ready.

name: ArithmeticComparison_9fb0
summary: Checks if vehicle type identifier is 2; if so, validates that the vehicle data value at offset 0xF8C is within range 6-8, returning false if outside.

name: TwoPathDispatch
summary: Dispatches between session/ring-buffer update (type 1) and weather particle update (type 2) based on sentinel at this[0]. Path 1 also gates on byte_7C56AC enable flag and session state.

name: LinkedListDestructionWithRefCountLoop
filled_label: List destructor with refcount element cleanup
summary: Walks linked list freeing nodes. For flagged nodes with data, iterates over refcounted 884-byte elements (calling EmptyStub per element), then frees the refcounted block, data pointer, and node. Zeroes all list fields.

name: LinkedListDestroy_b5a0
summary: Walks linked list freeing nodes. For flagged nodes with data, iterates over refcounted 884-byte elements (calling EmptyStub per element), then frees the refcounted block, data pointer, and node. Zeroes all list fields. [twin of LinkedListDestructionWithRefCountLoop]

name: sub_4BBA90
summary: Displays a "Fined US" or "Penalty" message with driver name and optional fine amount to the HUD, accumulating the fine total in this[41]; guarded by penalty state flags.

name: WarningHandler
summary: Formats and displays a "Warning <message>" text to the HUD using string table lookup and text rendering, guarded by penalty state flags.

name: StopGoPenaltyHandler
summary: Displays a "Stop/Go Penalty" message with driver name to HUD and logs the penalty event (type 4, ID 23) to the ring buffer with driver identifier and session time.

name: DisqualificationHandler
summary: Displays a "Disqualified:" message with driver name to HUD and logs disqualification event (type 4, ID 28) to ring buffer, guarded by this[12] != 3 to prevent double-disqualification.

name: sub_4BC9B0
summary: Validates grid position alignment and detects jump-start violations — computes velocity magnitude, transforms vehicle orientation vectors, and checks distance/angle thresholds to determine if the car is properly lined up; triggers stop-go penalty or disqualification for jump starts when penalties are enabled.

name: AIOpponentSelection
summary: Builds a sorted linked list of AI opponent candidates by randomly selecting vehicles, computing audio/skill parameters for each, and merge-sorting by float value. Used to select opponents for AI path/difficulty assignment.

name: AIPathPerformanceFunction
summary: Builds a merge-sorted linked list of AI opponents from the vehicle pool by excluding already-selected vehicles and lookup up audio/skill parameters. Used to generate a performance-ranked opponent list for path assignment.

name: LinkedListNodeRemovalWithCleanup
summary: Removes a node from a singly-linked list by matching its data pointer against LinkedListDereference result. Updates head/tail/count metadata, optionally frees the node's data payload if ownership flag is set, then deallocates the node. Returns 1 on success, 0 if target not found.

name: GameOptionsWriter
filled_label: Game options / career stats file parser and loader
summary: Parses game options and career statistics from config files: reads career season state, player track stats, and race condition settings (qualifying, race length, opponent strength, fuel/tire multipliers, speed compensation, mechanical failure rate, weather, flags, format). Populates an options struct for use in race setup. Part of the game options / career system.

name: ListDestructorWithSubFree
summary: Walks linked list freeing nodes. For flagged nodes with data, iterates over refcounted 884-byte elements (calling EmptyStub per element), then frees the refcounted block, data pointer, and node. Zeroes all list fields. [twin of LinkedListDestructionWithRefCountLoop]

name: sub_4C83B0
filled_label: Audio scene reinitialisation with playlist shuffle
summary: Destroys existing audio playlist linked list (frees all entries), then scans the track directory to build new .wav and .mp3 playlists. If tracks exist, selects a random starting track. If no tracks are found and InitStatus exists, triggers scene index loading via vtable dispatch.

name: sub_4C84A0
summary: Scans a directory for files matching a given extension (.wav/.mp3). For each file found, allocates a linked list node with file path data and appends it to this object's playlist list (head at *this, tail this[1], cursor this[2], count this[3]).

name: ParticleEmitterInit
summary: Initializes particle emitter struct: sets vtable pointer, zeroes state fields, configures duration (default 1.0), and computes randomized end offset from trig lookup table.

name: StateIndexedFieldGetter
summary: Indexed field selector: reads selector at this+0x1C (0/1/2) and returns the corresponding value at this+0x20/0x24/0x28. Returns 0 for out-of-range index.

name: AmbientSoundPlayback
summary: Loads an ambient sound file ("pithorn.wav" from "ambient" subdirectory) and initializes playback with volume, pan, and fade settings. Called once to start ambient audio.

name: ArithmeticComparison_a3e0
summary: Constructor/initializer: sets 11 fields to literals (0x0, 0x4, 0x8, 0x40, 0x50, 0x54, 0x58, 0x5C...). No reads, no globals. [auto]

name: ParticleTrailEmitter
summary: Spawn a trail particle at a collision point. Allocates slot, sets position/velocity from collision data, applies noise, computes normal. Optionally adjusts Y position when a7 flag is set (surface offset mode).

name: WeatherParticleUpdate
summary: Main weather particle system update — sorts drivers by distance, spawns weather particles with wind noise, updates all particle subsystems via type dispatch, and updates emitter children with rotation/scaling based on camera direction and visibility distance.

name: sub_4D0080
summary: Destructor for an array of 3D sound sources (132-byte stride). Iterates through array calling F_3DSoundSourceDestructor on each, then cleans up internal fields via sub_4A2220, frees the allocation, and zeroes both count and pointer fields.

name: sub_4D4860
summary: Decrements reference count on a container object; when count reaches zero, calls destructor callback on inner pointer and frees associated resource via FreeWrapper. Part of ref-counted COM-like object system.

name: TelemetryDataDump
summary: Initializes a telemetry output session — destroys previous telemetry state, checks scoring gate, finds active player vehicle, opens output file, computes sampling rate (1-40 Hz), writes CSV-style header with all telemetry channel names, embeds XML scene config, and writes integrity checksums (CRC, vehicle hash, scene hash, session seed) into the file.

name: ArrayBlockCleanup
summary: Cleans up a two-part dynamic array block structure. Iterates first array (24-byte entries at this+0xC), calling StructEntryCleanup and freeing sub-pointers; iterates second array (680-byte entries at this+0x14), calling ShortComputation_4370 on fields. Frees both array headers, zeros counters, sets sentinel at 0x20 to -1. Called by multiple teardown paths.

name: TextureSurfaceDestroyer
summary: Destroys a texture surface container: iterates active entries calling ArrayBlockCleanup per entry, then walks the full allocated block freeing sub-pointers at offsets 0 and 0x18 via FreeWrapper_7bcf, frees the block header, zeros both fields. Called by SessionReset and TireBrandLoader during teardown.

name: IteratorCheck
summary: Advances a sequential iterator: reads current index from `this[0]`, calls a vtable method (offset 20) on the associated entry object, and resets index to -1 when iteration completes (method returns 1). Acts as a "step and check done" for an entry list walk.

name: sub_4D89D0
summary: Initializes a race render struct to default values: set three ID/index fields to -1, clear all object pointer arrays (25 D3D slots + 3 sub-object slots + 2 singletons) to null via memset and direct assignment, and store default float/byte configuration (0.5f scale, 1.0f scale, 1-byte flag).

name: sub_4DAE00
summary: Gate function controlling race-end flow progression. Returns 1 when timers have expired and player position relative to finished vehicles allows proceeding. Part of race management system.

name: sub_4DCBA0
summary: Attempts to initialize a texture/rendering object: first tries D3D texture creation, then falls back to generic object construction with sub-init; stores configuration fields (a2, a7, a8) and computes alignment when both paths fail. Cleans up on error.

name: VehicleRespawnReset
summary: Resets vehicle state on respawn or race restart: clears collision/contact data, computes random respawn delay from noise table, reinitializes vehicle sub-structs, resets gear-change animation timer, zeroes force accumulators, and dispatches per-contact-zone state reset via ConditionalDispatchByFlag.

name: AudioSoundEffectController
summary: Per-frame audio/UI widget visibility controller that manages which HUD widgets are shown/hidden based on the current game mode (view=0, replay=1, driving=2, default=3). Handles session phase transitions for audio state changes and pit-control widget toggling.

name: PhysicsIntegrationStateMachine
summary: Selects integration sub-step size based on wheel speed squared vs threshold, then runs v4 iterations of suspension/tire physics (spring-damper reset, force computation, torque integration). Stores step value in 4 wheel slots (62-DWORD stride). Part of vehicle physics time integration.

name: BrakeCoolingPostTreatment
summary: Computes brake cooling effectiveness factor from temperature delta and cooling mode selector, clamped to [0,1]. Part of brake thermal/suspension system.

name: BrakeThermalModel
summary: Computes normalized brake thermal factor from squared suspension displacement divided by heat capacity, clamped to [0,1]. Part of brake thermal simulation.

name: TireGripLateralForceCalculation
filled_label: lateral tire grip force with multi-contact iteration
summary: Computes lateral tire grip force using friction-circle model, iterates over wheel contact patches to accumulate individual slip forces, limits by friction circle and contact capacity. Part of tire dynamics system.

name: ComputeSlipVelocityNorm
filled_label: slip velocity vector norm with local-frame transform
summary: Transforms position delta (reference minus current) into local frame via rotation matrix, computes Euclidean norm, adds constant bias 3.2, and clamps to minimum threshold. Part of tire slip velocity computation.

name: VehicleBodyToWheelContactDistanceComputation
filled_label: body-to-wheel contact distance with network write
summary: Computes local-frame distance from predicted vehicle body position to wheel contact reference, writes 13 contact elements to network packet, returns clamped norm. Part of vehicle dynamics/netcode system.

name: F_3x3MatrixTransformWithTranslation
summary: Transforms local offset vector by 3x3 rotation matrix, adds body world position, stores world-space result. Standard rigid-body point transform for suspension/contact system.

name: AIRacingLinePathFollowing
filled_label: AI Racing Line Path Node Traversal
summary: Traverses the racing line's doubly-linked path nodes for an AI vehicle: looks up the current and target nodes via position queries, iterates node-by-node applying position/orientation to vehicle state, updates suspension and wheel contact distances, and toggles scene-node visibility for track-follow display. Part of the AI path-following and racing-line visualization system.

name: VehicleTelemetryPositionAccumulator
summary: Accumulates velocity-scaled deltas into position, transforms by rotation matrix, dispatches to rigid-body or pointer-based update depending on mode selector. Part of vehicle telemetry/positioning system.

name: RepairServiceStateDispatcher
summary: Dispatches repair service state transitions (0-13) with subslot cleanup, wheel collision flagging, resource release, and brush-model force solver calls. Part of repair/pit service system.

name: VehicleGeometryProximityTest
filled_label: vehicle geometry proximity test with collision response
summary: Tests proximity of a point to vehicle geometry by transforming to local frame, checking distance against per-corner thresholds, and computing contact force with anisotropic triple product. Part of collision detection system.

name: AIVehiclePathPositionTracking
summary: Tracks AI vehicle position error against target path position, accumulates correction offsets, and ensures rigid body constraint is solved. Part of AI vehicle path following system.

name: RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate
summary: Manages race start countdown sequence — advances countdown steps, triggers sound effects, records telemetry on green light, and manages timer state. Part of race start system.

name: sub_4F0D20
summary: Applies team color scale to object after conditional render transform, comparing vehicle team color against current player. Part of rendering/appearance system.

name: ScaleAudioPitch
summary: Scales audio pitch and wheel RPM values by speed ratio based on physics random flags, then solves tire brush model. Part of audio/pitch scaling system.

name: MatrixVectorSetup
summary: Copies a 3x3 rotation matrix and input vector, computes their product, stores result. Part of vehicle physics/matrix transformation system.

name: sub_4F1FE0
summary: Manages yaw recovery state for a vehicle: accumulates time since last check, monitors postProcessInput state, validates qualifying/disqualifying conditions, computes vehicle position relative to track, and triggers recovery (position reset + audio + AI path tracking) when vehicle is off-track beyond timeout. Vehicle physics/recovery system.

name: SoundEffectTrigger
summary: Computes a clamped ratio of two sub-struct floats, combines with noise table values and random number to produce two intensity parameters, then configures an indexed HUD element. Used for randomized sound/feedback effects.

name: SoundEffectTrigger_89a0
summary: Variant of SoundEffectTrigger that computes intensity via ratio and noise, then configures HUD element with base indices 15-17 (vs 12-14 in the other variant). Same noise/random jitter pattern.

name: MultiFieldReset
summary: Constructor/initializer: sets 11 fields to literals (0x0, 0x10, 0x44, 0x48, 0x4C, 0x50, 0x70, 0x7C...). No reads, no globals. [auto]

name: sub_4FCAA0
summary: Initializes weather parameters: reads or writes weather.txt file, sets up weather mode constants (0.75/0.5 scaling factors, 175/675 range limits, 150.0 default, 0.01 threshold), computes derived values from orientation angles and field lookups, and delegates to sub_4FBA10 for cloud/skybox scene graph setup. Called from Game_Init.

name: DDSTextureFormatValidationDecoding
summary: Validates DDS header and pixel format, maps DDS pixel formats to internal format IDs, allocates output buffer, and decodes pixel data to 32-bit BGRA. Handles palette expansion (8-bit indexed), RLE decompression (type 2), and uncompressed formats (1/4/8/16/24/32-bit).

name: DDSHeaderParsing
summary: Validates DDS header and pixel format, maps DDS pixel formats to internal format IDs, allocates output buffer, and decodes pixel data to 32-bit BGRA. Handles palette expansion (8-bit indexed), RLE decompression (type 2), and uncompressed formats (1/4/8/16/24/32-bit). [twin of DDSTextureFormatValidationDecoding]

name: PPMP6ImageDecoder
summary: Decodes PPM P3 (ASCII) or P6 (binary) image data into 32-bit BGRA pixel buffer. Parses header (magic, width, height, max value), allocates output buffer, and converts RGB samples with max-value normalization to 4-byte BGRA pixels.

name: DDSTextureSurfaceCreation
summary: Parses DDS data and builds a linked-list surface hierarchy for mip-mapped/cubemap textures. Creates one surface sub-object per mip level per face, each with format, dimensions, stride, data pointer, and mip chain linking. Validates DDS magic, format table lookup, and buffer size.

name: D3DContextInit
filled_label: D3D surface pair creation and transfer attempt chain
summary: Initialises a D3D texture copy context: validates parameters, creates source and destination surfaces via DirectXTextureSurfaceFactoryDispatchingFourCCCod, then attempts a chain of surface copy/resampling methods (SurfacePixelCopy, MemoryAllocationWithVectorConstructor, sub_504731, Direct3DTextureResampling, COMInterfaceVectorProcessingMethod, MultiLevelBufferAllocationWithVectorOps, sub_5054EC, VertexBufferAllocationAndStageTransformation, sub_506003, sub_502F31). First success wins; otherwise returns failure. Releases surfaces on exit.

name: D3DTextureSurfaceLockCopy
filled_label: Lock D3D surface rectangle and copy pixel data
summary: Tears down existing resources, then locks a rectangular region of a D3D surface, creates a compatible child surface, copies pixel data between surfaces handling compressed (DXT) format alignment, and fills a descriptor structure with surface info (pitch, format, dimensions). Supports partial rect copies and various copy flags.

name: sub_506971
summary: Releases existing interface, then locks a 3D sub-region of a volume texture surface. Validates 3D rect bounds (x/y/z), handles DXT format alignment, calls vtable+36 (LockBox) with flags, fills descriptor with surface info (pitch, format, dimensions, depth), and stores the surface pointer.

name: ContactManifoldCleanup
summary: Iterates contact manifold array, zeros out any contact whose position matches a reference contact position stored in the owning struct.

name: DirectXTextureSurfaceFormatInitialization
summary: Initializes a DirectX texture surface wrapper object by setting the vtable, mapping source surface format flags to internal state, selecting FourCC-specific function pointers (for encoding/decoding), and computing aligned surface dimensions with stride values.

name: sub_51177C
summary: Initializes a vtable-like structure with method pointers (ArithmeticComparison, ResourceRelease, VtableDispatch, FormatStringWithArgs, ResettableStateClear) and populates format string table fields — primary table pointer, element count (119), and zeroed alternate table. Clears five state fields.

name: ColorQuantization
summary: Find optimal min/max bounds for quantizing 16 float samples to N levels (6 or 8). Uses Lloyd-Max style iterative refinement with coefficient tables; outputs clamped [0,1] bounds.

name: OBBFittingAndProjection
summary: Compute oriented bounding box of 16 float4 vertices, then iteratively refine projection bounds for quantization to N levels. Outputs min and max float3 bounds. Used for spline/texture coordinate bound fitting.

name: QuantizationColorSpaceConversion
summary: Encode 4×4 float4 block to BC3/DXT5: quantize alpha to 4-bit nibbles with error diffusion, pack 16 nibbles into two DWORDs (MSB-first), then delegate color block compression to TextureFilterAndLayerCompositing.

name: VertexBufferOffsetSetup
summary: Allocates and populates vertex buffer offset arrays for each animation/render element. Computes per-element buffer start and end offsets based on element dimensions and stride. Part of rendering pipeline.

name: TextureRowCopy
summary: Copies texture row data for each render element between source and destination buffers, applying horizontal expansion/interpolation and offset calculations. Part of rendering/animation playback pipeline.

name: ArrayProcessingWithScaling
summary: Processes element data arrays with scaling and modulo-based offset calculation. Computes per-element size from descriptors, applies modulo wrap for data positioning, and copies mirrored data between buffers. Part of rendering/animation buffer management.

name: DrawableObjectBatchProcessor
summary: Processes a batch of drawable sprite objects by waiting for position synchronization, allocating per-object buffers, and dispatching render calls for visible objects.

name: RenderStateCopyWithValidation
summary: Copies validated render state data from source buffer to destination, checking that all sprite object pointer fields are non-null and the source state values are non-negative.

name: UIListComboBoxConstructor
summary: Allocates and initializes a rendering state buffer (116 bytes) with function pointers and per-object or flat buffer allocations, selecting between copy mode and compositing mode based on a2 parameter.

name: AudioBufferMixing
filled_label: Audio channel mixing flush and copy
summary: Mixes audio by flushing accumulated channel data when buffer is full, then copying the next block of samples to output. Iterates over active channels via virtual dispatch, clamps copy size by remaining data and output space, and updates consumed/remaining counters.

name: RotationMatrixToAxisAngleConversion
summary: Converts a 3x3 rotation matrix (a2) to axis-angle representation (a1). Computes matrix trace; if trace exceeds threshold (flt_8D611C), uses trace-based formula for axis (Rzy-Ryz, Rxz-Rzx, Ryx-Rxy) and angle = sqrt(trace + 1) * scale. Otherwise selects largest diagonal element and computes axis/angle from corresponding off-diagonals. Part of 3D math / SVD library.

name: TriangleClosestPointOrNormal
summary: Converts a 3x3 matrix (a2) to axis-angle representation (a1), algorithm identical to RotationMatrixToAxisAngleConversion_0051fd90 but with distinct global constants (flt_8D627C-8D6298, dword_8D6270). Computes matrix trace; if trace > flt_8D627C, uses trace-based formula for axis and angle; otherwise selects largest diagonal element via dword_8D6270 index LUT. Part of 3D math / SVD library.

name: F_32PointMDCTAudioTransform
summary: Performs a 32-point Modified Discrete Cosine Transform (MDCT) on 32 input samples, producing two interleaved sub-band output buffers. Uses precomputed cosine coefficients in a 5-stage butterfly decomposition. Audio codec system (MP3/MPEG layer decompression).

name: FileHandleDestructorWithModeCheck
filled_label: File handle destructor with mode-specific cleanup
summary: Frees a file stream context: calls mode-appropriate cleanup ('w' → sub_5361D0 flush/close, 'r' → GuardedFunctionCallCleanup), closes file handle, frees buffers, and deallocates the struct. File I/O system.

name: TripleFieldGetter_b1d0
summary: Reads three consecutive DWORD fields from a struct (offsets 0x1C, 0x20, 0x24) and writes them to caller-provided output pointers. Each output is conditionally written only if the pointer is non-null.

name: ForceScaleCalculation
summary: Computes a 3-component force vector for one axis using SSE: multiplies scaled direction components from a1 (indices 6-9) by transform constants from a2 (indices 17-19) and a fixed 255 scale factor. Used in physics force computation.

name: sub_53CBC0
summary: Loads and validates a .MAS cube map file: searches registered path prefixes, reads 12-byte header magic, allocates and initializes a 308-byte physics object for Cubemas410 format. Links object into a linked list at offset 304 with global head at dword_8B8F14.

name: sub_53D750
summary: Initializes Direct3D8: releases old D3D interfaces, creates new D3D8 object (SDK version 220), configures rendering mode based on config settings, zeros render state fields, and calls sub_540760 for further setup. Called during rendering system global init.

name: sub_53DB90
filled_label: Display mode capability query with format validation
summary: Queries DirectX display adapter for surface format capabilities across formats 20-25, tests multisample types (2,3,4,6,16), builds capability bitmask in *a2, then enumerates display modes, filtering by resolution constraints from state fields at 0x1508-0x1510 and calling sub_55BC00 for valid modes.

name: sub_53E070
summary: Creates and configures a Direct3D rendering device — selects display mode, back buffer format, multisample type, depth/stencil format, swap chain, and queries hardware capability bits (including DXT1-DXT5 texture compression support). Part of the Direct3D rendering initialization subsystem.

name: RendererResourceCleanup
filled_label: Renderer resource cleanup with sub-resource release
summary: Calls RenderTargetCleanup, then frees three sub-resources (this[1355], this[1353], this[1354]) via sub_53F6E0/EmptyStub_7470/FreeWrapper_7bcf, and releases sub-object at this+0x1100 via vtable[2] call, nulling all pointers.

name: sub_53EB70
filled_label: Direct3D Render State / Vertex Buffer Initializer
summary: Performs one-time Direct3D render state setup: configures render states, creates vertex buffers and index buffers, initializes surface/audio emitters, and sets up rendering pipeline state for subsequent frame drawing. Guarded by a flag (this+0x1258 bit 0x10000000) to run only once.

name: sub_53F3F0
summary: Negotiates surface format between source and destination capability bitmasks, tries up to 3 approaches (format variants 71/77/80) to create a compatible surface via vtable[10] and vtable[12] calls. Falls back with error if all attempts fail.

name: sub_53F720
filled_label: Surface allocation with format fallback chain
summary: Allocates DirectX surfaces through multiple vtable pathways (flags-driven: 0x1, 0x2, 0x40008, 0x8, 0x4) with format negotiation. Creates audio emitter and fills surfaces as needed. Returns -1 on all failures.

name: sub_540760
summary: Iterates four linked lists of audio stream resource nodes, calls virtual destructor (vtable+8) on each nested sub-object, then frees all node memory via FreeWrapper. Guarded by an enable flag at this+0x13DC; returns 0.

name: AudioBufferFormatSetup
filled_label: Audio buffer format setup with channel config
summary: Configures audio buffer format: initializes struct, sets channel count at this+0x1170 (2304/256/1280 variants), bit depth, sample rate, and audio mode flags. Dispatches to sub-setters (StructInitWithDefaultValues, PropertyValueSetterWithRefreshOnChange, etc.) for property updates.

name: OrientationRotationMatrixUpdate
summary: Stores orientation input vector (a2,a3,a4) at 0x24-0x2C, multiplies a 3×3 rotation matrix at 0x15C-0x184 by the vector to compute transformed orientation at 0x18C-0x194, and writes 1.0f to 0x198 (4×4 matrix homogeneous element).

name: AudioEngineInitialization
summary: Initializes the audio engine: allocates audio buffers via system callback, creates an audio mixer channel, allocates vertex buffer resources, and walks the audio node linked list to initialize each node's processing pipeline.

name: sub_548AD0
summary: Scans a data array for a valid reflection map entry matching MMX flag and bit-2 requirements. If a2==2, allocates (444 bytes) and initializes a reflection view object with sound instance, color, and physics parameters. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error.

name: F_2D3DTrianglePointTest
summary: Tests whether a 3D point lies inside a triangle projected onto a 2D plane. Supports 6 projection modes (selector 0-5) choosing coordinate pair and winding direction, using cross-product edge tests.

name: sub_551A50
summary: Opens a Bink video file (.bik). Sets up audio system (Miles or DirectSound) by flag bits, builds flags for BinkOpen, opens file directly then falls back to searching registered audio directories. Stores Bink handle and video dimensions (summary) in object fields.

name: sub_552470
summary: Loads a font texture file, validates the extension, parses dimensions, creates a vertex buffer surface, rounds texture dimensions up to nearest power of two (32-2048), allocates a font texture object, renders the font glyph sheet onto the surface, and replaces the original surface with the font texture's surface. Stores flags in field 0x24.

name: TexturePathParsingAndDimensionCalculation
summary: Parses font texture file path and computes texture coordinate scale factors. Dispatches to sub_552BA0 (16-bit pixel format 5/6) or sub_552D70 (32-bit pixel format 7/8) for font sheet analysis. Extracts filename without path or extension (stored at this+0x14). Computes 1.0/width and 1.0/height as floats for UV calculation, stores at offsets 0x0 and 0x4. Sets the texture's field 13 (offset 0x34) to the key color from offset 0x2C.

name: sub_553700
filled_label: Audio/Rendering Buffer Update and Format Dispatch
summary: Updates audio vertex buffers with particle/sprite data when dirty flag is set, configures audio buffer format parameters, sets up audio quality/renderer state, and dispatches vtable-based rendering calls. Part of the audio-visual rendering pipeline for particle effects and UI elements.

name: sub_554790

name: sub_555E50

name: F_3x3RotationTensorMatrixTransform

name: VehiclePhysicsStateCopyTransform
summary: Copies physics state (position, rotation, linear/angular momentum) from internal prediction buffer to working offsets, then computes angular velocity = world_inv_inertia * angular_momentum. Part of rigid body integration loop.

name: InertialTensorVectorTransform
summary: Computes gyroscopic torque (ω × L), subtracts from applied torque, transforms result through inverse inertia to get angular velocity delta, computes linear velocity from momentum, then invokes constraint preparation sub-functions and stiffness matrix assembly.

name: F_3x3MatrixInverseCoordinateTransform
summary: Computes 3x3 inverse coordinate transform for vehicle physics. Transforms two vectors via Matrix3x3VectorMultiply, computes cross products and cofactor-based inverse matrix, then applies additional matrix-vector multiplies. Transforms forces/torques between coordinate frames (chassis-local to world).

name: RelativeVelocityCompute
summary: Computes relative velocity magnitude between two points/objects in vehicle physics. Transforms each local velocity through its 3x3 rotation matrix + translation to world space, then computes Euclidean distance (sqrt of squared differences). Result stored at two output locations.

name: ZeroFillArraysAndCallInitRoutineRepeatedly

name: sub_56EE40
summary: Accumulates angular momentum and computes force contributions from constraint rows across three groups of physics bodies (wheel/suspension/other), reading 3D vectors and applying them to body struct offsets.

name: IteratePhysicsBodiesCallUpdateFunction
summary: Zero-fills arrays of 8-byte elements pointed to by each pointer in a2, then calls sub_568FB0 init routine for each vehicle physics joint struct (stride 580 bytes) in this struct's array. [twin of ZeroFillArraysAndCallInitRoutineRepeatedly]

summary: Zero-fills arrays of 8-byte elements pointed to by each pointer in a2, then calls sub_568FB0 init routine for each vehicle physics joint struct (stride 580 bytes) in this struct's array. [twin of ZeroFillArraysAndCallInitRoutineRepeatedly]

Calls sub_57E480 for final socket initialization.

summary: Destructor for a network/physics/IO composite object: closes Win32 handles guarded by byte flags, destroys linked lists with vtable-based destructors, frees allocated resources, and chains into sub_583AE0 for final cleanup.
