name: sub_58928F
summary: Parses a string to an integer with automatic base detection (8/10/16), supporting 0x/0X prefix for hex, leading 0 for octal, optional sign, and overflow detection with errno reporting.

name: sub_5896EE
summary: Gets local and system time, caches timezone/DST info with invalidation check. Converts system time to internal time format via sub_591EDF. Optionally writes result to output pointer.

name: sub_58AD08

name: sub_5955AA
summary: Formats numeric digits into a string buffer with zero-padding and rounding. Handles carry propagation on rounding overflow and adjusts leading digit for floating-point to string conversion within CRT printf family.

name: SwitchBasedFloatProcessing

name: ModeDispatchWithSwitch

name: LinkedListNodeInsert_0ad0

name: LargeStructFieldSetterWithStoredReference

name: FuelMultiplierValue

name: RatioCalculator

name: AIGearSelectionSet

name: ListSelectionClamp

name: PhysicsStateInitIndexed

name: DoublyLinkedListAppend

name: ModuleInitializationWithFallback

name: PlaneLineIntersectionRatio

name: QuadraticForm6x6

name: sub_58BE2E
summary: Formats a floating-point number's string representation: writes sign character '-', inserts decimal separator at correct position, appends exponent marker 'E' and decomposes exponent value into digits (hundreds/tens/units) added to pre-initialized '0' characters. Called by floating-point-to-string conversion routines.

name: UtilityFunction_bf45
summary: Formats floating-point output buffer: writes leading '-' if negative, fills with '0' padding, inserts decimal separator (byte_5E6BD8) after the integer part, and pads with '0' characters (0x30) for negative exponent positions. Handles zero-value special case with '0\0' termination.

name: FloadWithFBFloatLoadWithNaNCheck
summary: Bounds-checked array lookup. Returns element from 8-byte stride array at given index, or 0 if index out of range. [twin of BoundedArrayAccessor]

name: Strlen

name: BufferedByteReader
summary: Reads the next byte from a buffered I/O context. Decrements remaining count; if exhausted (negative), calls sub_58C255 to refill; otherwise returns byte at cursor and advances cursor.

name: IncrementWrapperAroundCallLoop

name: InPlaceDigitCharConversionStripSemicolons
summary: Converts a locale digit string in-place: ASCII '0'-'9' chars are converted to their nibble values (subtract 48), semicolons (';' = 59) are removed by left-shifting remaining characters, other characters are left unchanged. Used to parse locale digit grouping/format strings like "3;2;1" into binary array [3, 2, 1].

name: sub_58FCB0
summary: Checks two byte flags on object; based on their values, conditionally calls inactivity timeout handler then dispatches network packet receive, or dispatches directly. [twin of StringLengthCheckDispatch]

name: sub_59249B
summary: Determines whether a given timestamp falls within Daylight Saving Time by checking against the Windows TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION structure. If the year has changed since last configuration, re-computes DST start/end transition dates via sub_592647.

name: sub_592C46
summary: Parses command line string into argv array and argument strings, handling quotes, backslash escaping, and whitespace delimiters.

name: PEImageBaseAddressDetection
summary: Retrieves the PE optional header linker major/minor version from the current process image's NT headers. Stores MajorLinkerVersion at field offset 0, MinorLinkerVersion at field offset 1, returns MinorLinkerVersion.

name: sub_594624
summary: Frees a memory block in the slab/buddy allocator. Coalesces adjacent free blocks, splits oversize blocks, and updates the bitmap tracking for the appropriate size class.

name: ArrayOf3ZeroCheck
summary: Getter: returns field 0x0 of this. No side effects. [auto]

name: sub_5953B8
summary: Converts an internal 80-bit extended-precision float (stored as word array) to 32-bit or 64-bit IEEE float output. Extracts sign, biased exponent (bias 0x3FFF), mantissa; applies normalization, rounding, overflow/underflow detection. Returns status code (0=normal, 1=range-exceeded, 2=underflow).

name: CRTAdd12
summary: Adds two 96-bit unsigned integers (stored as three dwords each: [0]=low, [1]=mid, [2]=high) with overflow propagation. Uses OverflowCheckedUnsignedAddition for each limb, cascading carry through low→mid→high.

name: sub_597621
summary: Frees multiple pointer fields in a struct (main pointer at offset 0, and four groups of 2 pointers at stride 5) using FreeWrapper_7bcf, preceded by a TextFormatStructInitializer_4d70 reset call. [twin of MultiFieldPointerFree]

name: BoundedStringLengthWithCap
summary: Getter: returns field 0x0 of this. No side effects. [auto]

name: VtableSetSubCall_8aea

name: LocaleRefcountAcquireUnderLock

name: SetLocaleVTableCall
summary: Resets the object's vtable to std::streambuf::vftable (destructor-time vtable fixup) and dispatches a call through the locale sub-object at offset +52 (this+13). Part of C++ streambuf destructor chain.

name: VTableInitOnly
summary: Initializes object's vtable pointer (offset 0x0) to `off_5B9BCC`. Returns `this`. Unused second parameter.

name: sub_59942B
summary: Initializes encoding state object: sets offset 0x0 to a2, zeroes offsets 0x8 and 0xC, calls locale init sub_59A54D, sets offset 0x10 from CRT global dword_8D5A6C, calls cleanup sub_59A5E9. Returns this.

name: SetLocaleVTableDtor
summary: Sets vtable pointer to basic_ios vtable for locale object, then calls ObjectDestructorWithRefCountDecrement on the same object.

name: VTablePointerSetter
summary: Sets this->vtable to off_5B9C68 and returns this pointer.

name: PointerOffsetAdjuster
summary: Reverses one wide-character read: increments remaining character count (via double-indirect at this+0x2C) and moves buffer position back by 2 bytes (via this+0x1C). Implements putback/ungetc operation.

name: StdGninc
summary: Reverses one wide-character read: increments remaining character count (via double-indirect at this+0x2C) and moves buffer position back by 2 bytes (via this+0x1C). Implements putback/ungetc operation. [twin of PointerOffsetAdjuster]

name: StreamBufferPointerAdjust
filled_label: Consume next char from buffer with pointer advance
summary: Consumes next wide character from buffer: decrements remaining count at this+0x30, reads current value from position pointer at this+0x20, then advances that pointer by 2 bytes. Returns the consumed character value.

name: sub_59A854
summary: Constructs `std::ios_base::failure` exception object. Calls ExceptionObjectConstructor to build the runtime_error base, then overrides vtable pointer with ios_base::failure vtable.

name: StructFieldInitWithConditionalCall
summary: Constructor/initializer: sets 6 fields to literals (0x8, 0xC, 0x10, 0x14, 0x18, 0x1C). No reads, no globals. [auto]

name: sub_59A980
filled_label: Object teardown with callback chain free
summary: Tears down object by invoking callbacks via CallbackChainIteration, then frees two singly-linked callback lists (at this+0x18 and this+0x1C) via FreeWrapper_7bcf and clears their head pointers.

name: VTablePointerSetter_ac3f
summary: Overwrites this->vtable with std::locale::facet vtable pointer. Minimal single-write function used during destructor vtable reset.

name: StdLocaleFacetDestructor
summary: Destructor for `std::locale::facet`. Resets vtable to facet vtable, then conditionally frees the object if flag `(a2 & 1)` is set.

name: VTableConstructor
summary: Constructs `std::length_error` exception object. Calls CObjectConstructorWithVtable (logic_error base), then overrides vtable pointer with std::length_error vtable.

name: ObjectInitWithVTable_b038
summary: Constructs `std::out_of_range` exception object. Calls CObjectConstructorWithVtable (logic_error base), then overrides vtable pointer with std::out_of_range vtable.

name: sub_59B0F5
summary: Converts a single multi-byte character to a wide character. If no locale is set (dword_8D3F38 == 0), does direct byte-to-wchar assignment. Otherwise uses CharTypeTable to check lead byte, then MultiByteToWideChar with the default CodePage, handling lead-byte sequences via cbMultiByte. Returns number of bytes consumed or -1 (TLS error 42) on failure. [twin of sub_596773]

name: sub_59B260
summary: Packs four parameters into argument array, validates against version string "1.13" (a113_0) via ArgumentReorderWrapper, dispatches to sub-function sub_5357E0 for processing, and writes output pointer to *a2 on success. Part of data/serialization loading system (callers include MeshVertexIndexBufferLoader).

name: sub_59B490
summary: Grows bitmap allocation buffer when needed, using geometric growth (adding growth stride +0x18 per iteration) capped at 128000 bytes; copies old data and frees previous buffer.

name: TypeInfoDestructor
summary: Destructor for MSVC RTTI type info object: restores vtable pointer and frees the type descriptor name string under critical section 27.

name: StringCopyConstructor
summary: Copy constructor for exception string: copies message from source exception into newly allocated buffer, sets vtable (exception vftable) and refcount to 1.

name: StrlenAllocCopyConstructorPattern
summary: Copy constructor for exception string with conditional deep copy: if source refcount at a2+8 is non-zero, allocates new buffer and copies string; if zero, shares source pointer without copy.

name: MSVCExceptionDestructor
summary: Destructor for MSVC exception object: frees owned string buffer if refcount is non-zero; skips free if string is borrowed/shared (refcount == 0).

name: PhysicsNodePropagationWithDistanceFalloff
summary: Propagates suspension and tire forces through linked collision geometry chains with distance-based falloff. Calls SweptSuspensionCollisionDetection, applies TireForceSolver/TireForce/TireGripLateralForceCalculation per strut, computes contact force attenuation as a function of distance between strut center and collision feature, and records the maximum propagated force.

name: SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest
summary: Scans all active suspension struts to find the one nearest to a query point, with optional strut-type filtering. After locating the closest strut, applies a plane-normal / height test to decide whether to return the strut pointer itself or redirect to its linked collision child node.

name: RaceModeSetup
summary: Configures race mode session transition: saves previous scoring/race-mode global state, sets new race mode value (2), applies timeout overrides, sets session transition flag, and computes scaling factor based on UI slider or difficulty threshold. Non-race mode path simply sets two byte flags.

name: ConditionalSoundRenderDispatchOnParamCheck
summary: Conditionally triggers audio render setup and mixer initialization when a struct parameter (field at 0x20) equals 1 and the render fade alpha is positive.

name: ViewCameraModeDispatch
summary: Dispatches camera/view mode changes based on player input — handles cycling through cockpit/TV/external views (modes 0-2), direct mode jumps (3-8), sub-option cycling within modes (case 4), and copies UI state globals into sub-objects for replay/monitor modes (7-8). Triggers audio feedback on mode switch. Camera/UI system.

name: TracksideCameraTargetLookup
summary: Resolves a camera target name/ID by querying three registered loader objects in sequence (config, scene, module) via virtual method at vtable+28. Returns first non-zero result.

name: ModeValidationCheck
summary: Returns TRUE if the current mode (this+0x0) equals 3 or 4, FALSE otherwise. Acts as a gate to allow processing only in specific modes.

name: AudioPhysicsMixWithLerp
summary: Computes averaged vertex position from packed array, lerps with bounding box center using blend factor (0.35 for mode 2, 0.70 otherwise), then applies triple-field offset and updates global vector. Part of audio-physics scene graph integration.

name: ShortComputation_e710
summary: Switch on value at this+0x1C (modes 0-5): writes parameter a2 to a destination field. Cases 0/3/1/4/2/5 all write a2 to offset 0xD0 within a sub-struct pointed by this+0x20; default returns immediately without writing.

name: LinkedListIndexedAccessor_56c0
summary: Returns the value (first DWORD) at a given index in a singly-linked list with head at this[8] and count at this[11]. Returns 0 if index out of bounds or node not found.

name: AISessionModeTransition
summary: Processes a session mode transition (0/1/2) for AI commentary/event system. Validates race active, track condition, and player vehicle match. Converts mode index via FloatRangeIndexLookup/ThreeWayEnumConverter, checks ScoringGateSelector, then fires BooleanOROfTwoChecks + DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion per mode, inserts table entry, and marks mode as transitioned. Part of AI session event pipeline.

name: AIPositionChangeEvent
summary: Detects and processes position changes for AI race commentary. Compares stored vs current position per driver. On change, determines gain/loss event type, builds driver data, and inserts into session event table. Handles player and AI vehicles differently.

name: AISessionPhaseChange
summary: Processes session phase changes (race phase counter transitions) for AI commentary. For non-player vehicles during race sessions, inserts phase change event (21 or 22) or qualifying/practice event (178/179). Always calls AIPositionChangeEvent for race sessions regardless of player match.

name: AISessionPhaseCounter
summary: Tracks completion of up to 4 session phases per driver using flags at this+0xA44. Counts active flags; if fewer than 3 are set, emits an individual phase-event (95/97/99/101) based on phase index. If 3+ flags set, emits a combined event (105). Part of AI session event pipeline.

name: PitStateSlotActivation
summary: Tracks pit state slot activation for up to 4 slots (flags at this+0xA44). Sets flag to 2 for given slot index, counts activated slots. If fewer than 3 activated, emits individual slot events (94/96/98/100). If 3+ activated, emits combined event (104). Analogue of AISessionPhaseCounter but for pit state.

name: sub_41AD80
summary: Tracks overtaking/passing events between two vehicles. Checks time since last event (2-second cooldown) and distance threshold (>1250.0). Updates per-driver timestamps, distances, and opponent references. Emits events: 114/115 for player-involved overtakes, 225 (with random weather noise gating) or 226 for AI-vs-AI overtakes.

name: PitSelectionStateMachine
summary: Complex state machine managing pit selection commentary events. Handles multiple states (0/2/3/5): deactivation with zone-aware dispatch, activation with zone-comparison logic, generic event 131, and player pit entry sub-types (123-125). Uses FloatRangeIndexLookup for zone indexing and StateCheckedVirtualDispatch for gated transitions. Part of AI race commentary system.

name: sub_42C440
summary: Per-frame input processor for in-game driver assists — reads input device action codes and toggles steering assist, traction control, ABS, auto-shifting, brake bias, and other driving aids. Also handles session transitions, visual state changes, and suspension vibration triggers. Part of the gameplay input/control subsystem.

name: MainGameTickUpdate
summary: Drives the per-frame game update loop: converts session time to tick counter, dispatches AI updates, vehicle physics, particle effects, fuel consumption, tire force computation, and player controls at fixed sub-intervals. Coordinates all per-vehicle per-frame subsystems.

name: AILateralForceComputation
summary: Computes lateral interaction forces between all vehicle pairs. Phase 1 calculates per-vehicle direction vectors and curvature radius from velocity. Phase 2 accumulates pairwise proximity-weighted forces and writes resultant vector (x,z components) to each vehicle struct at offset 14948.

name: TrackConfig
summary: Per-frame updates vehicle setup parameters (gear ratios, ride heights, spoiler angle, track-type adjustments) based on component/subcomponent indices a2/a3, clamping values, firing state-change events, and re-matching floating-point setup indices to nearest allowed steps.

name: sub_42ED70
summary: Constructs formatted resource path strings from template globals. Based on format selector at this+4, builds "%s/%s" and "%s/%s/%s" paths at this+56 and this+72, and a single string at this+88. Uses BinarySearchInStringTable to look up and copy string components.

name: CollisionContactGenerationAndFrictionResponse
summary: Solves tire-ground contact and friction: generates 3 or 5 contact points from suspension geometry, queries terrain height via spatial grid, computes friction forces using Pacejka-like curves, and applies impulse with torque to the rigid body.

name: VehicleDynamicsForceAccumulatorIntegration
filled_label: Tire/Brake Thermal Integration and Wear Simulation
summary: Integrates brake and tire temperatures over time using force inputs, weighted blending, and ambient temperature offsets. Computes wear/fatigue accumulation with blowout threshold detection, and triggers pit-stop state transitions when wear exceeds critical levels. Part of the vehicle dynamics thermal and degradation simulation system.

name: PhysicsCollisionDamageDNFDetection
filled_label: Collision Damage Accumulator with DNF Detection
summary: Per-frame collision damage computation: accumulates impact energy into a damage integrator (scaled by velocity and contact normal), computes temperature-based thermal damage component, checks if accumulated damage exceeds threshold, and when overflow/peak is detected marks the first non-DNF vehicle as DNF (sets state to 5).

name: SuspensionDataCopyToPhysicsEngine
filled_label: Suspension data copy to physics engine bodies
summary: Copies suspension geometry data (rotation matrix, inertia tensor) to physics engine body structs. Handles both active and inactive suspension paths. Part of vehicle physics initialization/data transfer.

name: BrakeBiasSetup
filled_label: Brake Bias and Vehicle Control Configuration Setup
summary: Initializes brake bias, differential, and vehicle control settings from global configuration data. Copies 11 configuration byte slots, applies bitmask filtering to disable unsupported settings, sets control mapping mode based on input device type, and computes a scaled driver data factor.

name: VehiclePhysicsBodyNameMapping
summary: Initializes the vehicle physics body/joint name-to-index mapping by searching the joint system for named bodies (wheels, spindles, axles, steering arms, fuel tank, driver head, body) and storing their array indices for fast lookup during simulation. Part of the tire model initialization pipeline.

name: sub_438F00
filled_label: Suspension geometry setup and body attachment
summary: Reads suspension geometry offsets, transforms position by rotation matrix, attaches suspension to rigid body, and calls suspension setup section reader. Part of suspension initialization in vehicle physics.

name: CollisionEnergy
filled_label: Collision energy computation with tire force evaluation
summary: Computes total collision energy from weighted sums of damage parameters, then evaluates tire force and torque models across multiple polynomial/quadratic curve functions. Returns summed damage contributions. Part of vehicle collision damage system.

name: VehiclePhysicsInitializer
summary: Initializes vehicle physics parameters for suspension geometry, tire model, weight distribution, and collision energy. Computes ride height per corner, spring/damper rates from setup data, center of mass position, inertia tensor, and sets up per-corner force computation structures. Called each frame from TireModelInit to recalculate physics constants before the main physics update.

name: FrontSteeringGeometrySetup
summary: Sets up front steering geometry for left and right wheels. Searches suspension component arrays for matching pairs, computes steering transforms, finds closest geometry pairs, applies steering angle via tan formula, and updates rotation matrices. Part of vehicle steering initialization.

name: ConstraintForceSolver
filled_label: Constraint force solver with velocity computation
summary: Searches constraint element array for matching body pair, computes constraint force with velocity-dependent terms using matrix-vector transforms, then computes relative velocity. Part of the constraint force solving system.

name: SpringDamperCompute
summary: Stores input value and evaluates three linear functions (result = a*x + b) for spring force, damper force, and combined output. Part of the spring-damper computation in the physics solver.

name: sub_43BC20
summary: Per-frame physics state copy: transfers collision geometry, spring-evaluated scalars, force/torque vectors, and damper parameters from a physics simulation object (a3) into a local snapshot struct, applying quadratic and spring-damper evaluations driven by vehicle parameters (a2).

name: TireCompoundPerWheelPhysicsApplication
summary: Loads tire compound parameters (camber curves, temperature coefficients, wear rates, grip curves) from compound data and applies them to a per-wheel physics structure. Includes debug logging for missing slip curve files. Part of tire physics initialization per wheel.

name: TireModelInit
summary: Initializes tire physics model: sets up tire parameters, parses vehicle HDV file, maps body names, initializes vehicle physics, sets brake bias, and cleans up allocated resources. Part of vehicle physics initialization pipeline.

name: WheelDynamicsInit
summary: Initializes wheel dynamics state: sets contact constraints, parameters, and grid values for 4 wheels. Initializes wheel struct entries with default bit patterns and cleans up resources. Part of wheel physics initialization.

name: RigidBodyConstraintSolve
summary: Computes position error between current and target pose using Euler-angle rotation matrix and body position, then applies constraint correction. Initializes wheel constraint state entries with default disabled values. Part of AI vehicle path tracking.

name: AccumulateAngularImpulse
summary: Accumulates linear impulse and computed torque (cross product of relative position × impulse) from a collision contact into the vehicle's accumulator buffers. Part of vehicle physics collision response.

name: RigidBodyTransformUpdate
summary: Updates a rigid body's position by adding a delta vector, computes Euler angle extraction from its rotation matrix/quaternion (atan2-based), and calls the transform update function. Part of vehicle rigid-body physics integration.

name: SuspensionDamperForceAccumulation
summary: Accumulates suspension damper forces with scaling and clamping, then evaluates the damper force curve via quadratic function. Scales input by damper-specific rates (0.23 and 0.18) and clamps accumulators to upper bounds from reference field plus offset. Part of vehicle suspension force computation.

name: ClampedSpringIntegrator
summary: Accumulates spring state with scaled input (0.23 and 0.18 rates), clamps accumulators against reference-plus-offset bounds, then computes spring-damper force via SpringDamperCompute. Part of vehicle suspension spring force system.

name: PhysicsAccumulatorIntegrate
summary: Accumulates physics state with scaled input (0.23 and 0.18 rates), clamps accumulators against reference-plus-offset bounds, then evaluates quadratic force/torque via QuadraticForceTorqueCalculator. Structurally identical pattern to SuspensionDamperForceAccumulation and ClampedSpringIntegrator. Part of vehicle physics damping system.

name: EngineStressSimulation
filled_label: Engine Stress, Thermal & Component Failure Simulation
summary: Simulates per-frame engine durability degradation from RPM, coolant/oil temperature dynamics with thermal stress accumulation, and random component failures (3 components) using weather-noise-driven probability. Engine physics / damage system.

name: WheelStateHistoryShift
summary: Shifts wheel state history buffers forward by one frame — copies current frame state to the "previous" slot for 4 wheels, then shifts per-wheel data blocks. Part of vehicle wheel state history management for physics integration.

name: WheelDataCopy
summary: Copies wheel state history forward (current→previous), copies delta state buffers for each wheel from the previous-state buffer into the current-state buffer, then runs the suspension wheel dynamics solver, two batch iterators, a per-body update function, and the sub-object data copy. Main wheel physics dispatch function.

name: VehiclePhysicsIntegrationStep
summary: Per-frame vehicle physics integration driver — runs sub-stepped RK2 (midpoint) integration loop, accumulates forces per wheel, detects collision damage, and transforms inertia tensors for physics sub-objects.

name: VelocityDampingFromSpeedError
summary: Computes aerodynamic velocity damping based on speed error (deviation from reference speed 8.0). Computes body speed from velocity vector, calculates damping force proportional to the speed error, applies direction-dependent scaling, and accumulates the result into the body's force buffer. Part of vehicle aerodynamics/damping system.

name: RigidBodyTorqueAccumulation
summary: Transforms a local-space force vector to world-space via rotation matrix, computes torque from cross product of lever arm and force, applies damping/spring factors (stiffness and damping coefficient), and accumulates the result into the target body's force buffer. Part of vehicle rigid body dynamics.

name: PhysicsIntegrationStep
filled_label: physics integration step (gravity, constraint solving, velocity accumulation)
summary: Performs a physics integration substep: applies gravity to body array, computes damper/spring forces with anti-roll, solves rigid-body constraints, then accumulates linear and angular velocities into the current body state.

name: SteeringGeometryUpdate
summary: Updates per-wheel steering geometry: computes steering angle from input, applies noise perturbation via trig table lookup, clamps to ±10 degrees, transforms wheel contact geometry through coordinate frames of matching contact bodies, and accumulates steering angle. If accumulated angle exceeds threshold, triggers a state change. Part of vehicle steering system.

name: sub_4423B0
summary: Per-frame physics tick: computes per-wheel track grip via position-projected lookup, queries spatial grid for ground plane, runs collision contact generation and friction response for 4 wheels, detects ground penetration to accumulate angular momentum impulses, and optionally applies spring-damper suspension forces.

name: sub_442C90
summary: Per-frame vehicle suspension and wheel physics update. Computes suspension arm geometry, constraint forces, anti-roll bar torques, and accumulates angular momentum for all four wheels.

name: WheelContactForceSolver
summary: Solves contact normal force for a wheel contact: transforms contact position to world space via body rotation matrix, computes slip-based force reduction using friction model (cubic falloff), and accumulates resulting angular momentum into the body. Part of wheel collision response system.

name: DamperSpringForceComputationWithAntiRoll
summary: Computes per-corner damper/spring forces from suspension travel, helper-spring abutment forces, and anti-roll bar coupling torques; accumulates resulting angular momentum into the chassis rigid-body for the physics integration step.

name: SuspensionVibration
summary: Updates suspension vibration state based on a vibration trigger flag (a2). In one mode, copies vibration state from source to destination. In the other mode (no trigger), computes a noise-based vibration value from a weather noise table lookup when vibration threshold is exceeded. Part of vehicle suspension vibration/feedback system.

name: TireSlipForceCalculation
filled_label: Per-wheel tire slip force computation and collision effect dispatch
summary: Computes per-wheel tire slip ratios, contact patch forces, and dispatches collision/particle effects for a 4-wheel vehicle each frame. Part of the vehicle physics simulation tick.

name: BrakeBiasAdjustmentControl
summary: Adjusts brake bias index based on signed input delta, computes final bias value from index * step + base offset, formats as percentage string and renders OSD display. Belongs to vehicle setup/UI system.

name: PositionLapStateUpdate
summary: Detects position change events (gained/lost positions) during a race, updates position tracking state, triggers appropriate positional change sound effects, and sets UI state machine values for position change display. Part of vehicle/race state system.

name: TriangleMeshAdjacencyBuilder
filled_label: Triangle mesh adjacency builder with BVH spatial insertion
summary: Builds adjacency data for a triangle mesh collision shape. Allocates/reallocates triangle body buffer, inserts vertices into spatial (BVH) trees, discovers shared edges between adjacent triangles, and stores edge adjacency pointers. Handles weighted edge midpoint interpolation and optionally copies edge flags.

name: sub_44F150
summary: Polls raw input device (keyboard or gamepad) for state changes, then updates BVH proxy slot states: tracks axis positions, manages proxy activation/deactivation based on input and dead zone, and conditionally registers active proxies. Called from collision update and input processing paths.

name: DriverInputController
summary: Per-frame tick that processes driver input state and vehicle physics data to update audio/visual effects across 10 channels (headlights, engine RPM, tire sounds, 3D positional audio). Reads wheel contact types and dispatches enable/disable to 4 audio sub-controllers.

name: sub_454DA0
summary: Per-frame vehicle input processor that smooths throttle, brake, clutch, steering, handbrake, and gear selection with configurable decay rates. Each axis supports a direct-mode passthrough (field==2) bypassing the smoothing ramp.

name: PhysicsIntegrationStep_e620
summary: Performs per-axle physics integration step: computes wheel velocity deltas from vehicle state, samples terrain roughness/height, integrates suspension velocity and displacement with semi-implicit Euler, applies velocity clamping, and stores updated wheel state. Part of vehicle physics simulation.

name: sub_491280
summary: Walks broadphase list applying sub_491680 filter on each node's AABB. Returns 1 on first match, 0 if list exhausted with no match. Simpler than the recursive traversal — no clipping or overlap test.

name: WheelRotationAnimation
summary: Triggers up to four wheel rotation audio effects based on driver appearance bitmask. Each wheel's audio source is stored in struct fields at offsets 0x20-0x2C.

name: sub_4A2840
summary: Updates keyframe-driven animation state: iterates through keyframe segments (7 floats each), interpolates output value based on input parameter a2, calls listener callbacks when value changes. Tracks last value for change detection. Part of animation/UI system (pit crew/animation).

name: sub_4A4110
summary: Per-frame AI incident trigger check — zeros out inactive vehicle slots, blocks incidents for vehicles in special states with moderate deceleration, then computes a race-progress-weighted probability for an AI crash/spin event with a cooldown timer at this+0x1A0.

name: PitPartStateCopy
summary: Copies pit-stop part state from a source vehicle object into a destination pit-stop state structure, including tire brand lookup, compound index search, scoring interval computation, and callback chain processing. Part of the pit-stop state management system.

name: SliderClampStringToIntControl
summary: Parses a string value to integer via ObjectHandleReader, clamps between lower bound (this+0x1C) and upper bound (this+0x20), stores result at this+0x14. Returns 0 if input is NULL/empty.

name: ClampedFloatSetter_1de0
summary: Stores a float value (passed as int a2) at this+0x14, then clamps it between lower bound (this+0x1C as float) and upper bound (this+0x20 as float). If value < lower bound, snaps to lower bound. If value > upper bound, snaps to upper bound.

name: ArithmeticComparison_20d0
summary: Stores a float value (passed as int a2) at this+0x14, then clamps it between lower bound (this+0x1C as float) and upper bound (this+0x20 as float). If value < lower bound, snaps to lower bound. If value > upper bound, snaps to upper bound. [twin of ClampedFloatSetter_1de0]

name: sub_4B9FD0
summary: Builds and displays a replay activation status message once. Checks session state, formats path+string, and renders via TextLineWrappingAndRendering. Sets completion flag to prevent re-display.

name: ConditionalMultiPathDispatcher
summary: Dispatches between steering animation and alternative handler based on KeyPriorityChain result. Then conditionally processes driver entries if float field mismatch or flag is set. Resets flag after processing.

name: VehFileParser
filled_label: Vehicle R-File Parser and File Resolver
summary: Parses a vehicle `.R` definition file (read via fopen), extracting all team/driver/livery/eyepoint/camera data into the vehicle struct, then resolves companion file paths (HDV, INI, GEN, SFX) via FileFinder. Returns 0 on success, -1 if the file cannot be opened.

name: FileFinder
summary: Searches for a file across multiple paths (custom path, season directory, common directory), opens it if found and copies the path; logs a debug message if not found in any location.

name: sub_4C6B60
summary: Per-vehicle per-frame update: runs AI path tracking, suspension simulation, state transition, and camera/frustum setup. Called each tick for every vehicle.

name: SceneRenderUpdate
summary: Per-vehicle scene render update each frame. Coordinates vehicle physics prep, AI driver state, render dispatch (grid position / path data), force feedback update, and optional collision check.

name: sub_4C6F10
summary: Allocate this vehicle to a free grid slot on the starting grid. Scans 52 slots, skips occupied ones, assigns slot index (0x48A4) and team column (0x48A8). Called per frame when position is unset.

name: ResourceReleaseTripleDispatch
summary: Dispatches vtable+8 method on up to three sub-objects stored at offsets 0x20, 0x24, 0x28. Does NOT null or free pointers. Returns result from last successful dispatch.

name: ParticleCollisionSpark
summary: Spawn a spark particle at a collision contact point. Allocates slot, sets position, velocity, size from collision data, computes spark color/intensity, flags texture layer. Called by collision dispatch when surface generates sparks.

name: ParticleSpawnFunction
summary: Spawn multiple particles in a burst. Reads particle count from parameter (shifted by emitter detail level), allocates slots, applies random noise to position and velocity from weather noise table, computes collision normal, sets up billboard quad for each particle.

name: WheelContactParticle
summary: Spawn a wheel contact particle (tire spray / smoke / dust). Allocates slot, sets particle lifetime and alpha based on surface type. Writes 4 quad vertices to texture buffer. Surface type 8 gets wet/smoke-specific color and alpha blending.

name: WheelSurfaceContactFriction
summary: Compute wheel contact friction and spawn surface particles. Compares velocity difference against threshold, computes perpendicular friction vectors, iterates contact surface types (6=grass/dirt, 7=?, 8=wet) to determine particle color and size, then spawns WheelContactParticle.

name: CollisionEffectDispatch
summary: Dispatch collision effects (spark and trail particles) based on collision type. Iterates collision effect slots: type 1 spawns collision spark particles, type 2 spawns trail particles with throttle gating (every 20 ticks), type 0 spawns trail particles from velocity field. Incorporates weather flags for render throttling.

name: DriverStandingComparator
summary: qsort-style comparator for two drivers by race standing. Status=3 (retired) drivers sort after active drivers; then compares integer rank at vehicle offset 44, float time/gap at offset 104, then pointer address as tiebreaker.

name: DriverSortComparator
summary: qsort-style comparator for two drivers by race position. Status 3 (retired) sorts after active drivers; status 1 (racing) compares lap time at offset 132; other statuses compare secondary rank at offset 12 and time at offset 16. Tiebreaker at offset 44, then pointer address.

name: PitStopOrderLoader
summary: Load and parse pit stop order data for teams. Queries team list from string-keyed linked list, allocates array for team entries, checks if reverse pit order is enabled. If reverse, iterates teams in reverse order; otherwise forward.

name: PitTimer
summary: Tick-driven pit stop timer state machine that handles countdown display, pit lane open/close transitions, time-remaining messages, and session phase advancement. Part of the race UI / session management system.

name: sub_4D59B0
summary: Packs 11 option/settings flags into a bitfield (2 bits each) plus multiplayer option flag, tire model mode, player vehicle mode flag, and input mode flag. Writes the packed bitfield and several physics globals (rain fade, track grip, temperature offsets, brake balance) through sub_4D5BE0 debug data writer.

name: TireSlipCurveNameLookup
summary: Searches a tire slip curve name table for a matching string. Iterates up to this[2] entries at this[3] with 24-byte stride, comparing each name via sub_588410. Returns pointer to matching entry, or 0 if not found (with optional debug log).

name: SuspensionSpringDampingRateReset
summary: Resets spring/damper forces to zero for all wheels, applies brake cooling post-treatment, and recomputes damping rates based on suspension type (0=push-rod, 1=double-wishbone, 2=third-spring). Core of per-frame suspension force initialization.

name: TireBrushModelForceSolver
filled_label: Compute tire forces via brush/slip model
summary: Solves tire longitudinal and lateral forces using the brush model across 4 wheels and 15 slip-ratio samples per frame. Applies load transfer, wet/dry grip scaling, and suspension geometry normalization.

name: TireGripCoefficient
filled_label: tire grip coefficient with anti-roll cross-coupling
summary: Computes per-corner tire grip coefficients with anti-roll bar cross-coupling term, selects min/max across axles based on mode selector, and clamps result to [0,1]. Part of tire dynamics system.

name: AerodynamicForceCalc
summary: Computes aerodynamic force from speed-squared with weight compensation, table lookup with linear interpolation, and quadratic drag formula. Part of aerodynamic dynamics system.

name: TireForceSolver
filled_label: tire force bisection solver with table lookups
summary: Bisection-method root solver for tire contact force using table lookups with linear interpolation. Narrows bracket [lo,hi] until force function changes sign, returns interpolated root. Part of tire dynamics system.

name: TireForce
filled_label: tire force friction-circle computation with table lookups
summary: Computes tire force using friction-circle model with sign-selected lookup tables, linear interpolation, and aerodynamic drag term. Part of tire dynamics system.

name: PositionChangeMonitor
filled_label: position change tracking with history save
summary: Monitors position changes by storing current position to history and calling an external tracking function. Returns a tracking handle. Part of position/telemetry tracking system.

name: sub_4E96C0
filled_label: vehicle proximity detection with position change tracking
summary: Determines vehicle proximity by tracking position changes, checking rotation alignment, and testing threshold distance against nearby entities. Part of collision/proximity detection system.

name: AccumulatorClamp
summary: Accumulates input scaled by 0.225, applies upper bound clamp, checks hysteresis thresholds to update output value and flag. Part of accumulator/clamping system for physics.

name: WheelTireForceUpdate
filled_label: wheel tire temperature update with thermal model
summary: Updates per-corner tire temperatures using convection and friction heating model, normalizes to [0,1] range. Part of tire thermal dynamics system.

name: ThrottleBrakeOverride
summary: Computes override value from brake ratio and cooling factor (v1³ * factor * 0.5), replaces throttle/brake channel values when reference equals sentinel -789.0. Part of throttle/brake control system.

name: VehicleClimbAdjust
summary: Adjusts vehicle climb/throttle value with optional vibration noise from weather table when rigid body constraint is present. Part of vehicle suspension/climb control system.

name: WheelContactForceAggregation
summary: Aggregates contact forces across all 4 wheels by surface type, computing weighted average direction and sending to PerIndexStructFieldSetter. Part of wheel contact/tire physics system.

name: WheelForceAggregation
summary: Aggregates wheel forces across all 4 wheels by surface type with speed-clamped weighting, computing normalized direction for PerIndexStructFieldSetter. Part of wheel force/tire physics system.

name: sub_4F18C0
summary: Sets up tire compound parameters for a specific wheel index: looks up compound data, computes spring/damping/force values, and optionally solves tire brush model. Part of tire/compound configuration system.

name: VehicleDamageModel
summary: Parses a vehicle damage configuration file/stream, extracting physics parameters (collision, mass, inertia, detach thresholds, aero coefficients, random damage factors) for engine, front/rear wings, 4 wheels, and 8 detachable body parts into a struct.

name: PerWheelBrakeSuspensionDataLoader
summary: Parses per-wheel brake and suspension configuration data from a vehicle setup file line, populating a double array with spring rates, damper settings, camber, tire pressure, brake temperature/wear/torque parameters, and ride heights; converts brake optimum temperature from Celsius to Kelvin (+273.16).

name: VehicleDampingDirectionValidation
summary: Parses 3 damping values per direction index (0-5 corresponding to X+/X-/Y+/Y-/Z+/Z-), validates that damping sign opposes motion, and logs warnings for wrong-signed damping. Suppresses logging on server sessions.

name: EngineSectionParser
summary: Parses the [ENGINE] section of a vehicle HDV/SVM file, reading RPM-torque curves, idle/launch/rev-limit logic, thermal properties (oil/water/radiator), lifetime averages, starter timing, and fuel consumption. Converts RPM fields from RPM to rad/s and validates curve ordering.

name: TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser
summary: Parses .SVM and .HDV vehicle configuration files line-by-line, dispatching to section-specific parsers for general vehicle data, aero surfaces, suspension, engine, driveline, and per-wheel brake settings. Writes parsed values into both the internal vehicle setup struct and the output vehicle state struct.

name: TireForceTorqueComputation
filled_label: tire force/torque computation with quadratic model
summary: Computes tire force (3 components) and torque outputs using quadratic polynomials and absolute values. Force component a4[2] and torque a5 use quadratic functions of a2 with additional bias/scale terms on a3.

name: AudioParameterInterpolation
summary: Interpolates audio/physics parameter state between frames: clamps delta, unpacks short vectors and bitfields, applies rotation via Euler angles, copies interpolated packed state to output. Audio/parameter blending system.

name: AudioSampleCrossFadeInterpolation
summary: Cross-fades between two audio sample states `a3`/`a4`: computes blend factor from time, interpolates position via Hermite spline, rotation via quaternion slerp, and packed bitfields. Audio sample playback system.

name: AudioSamplePlaybackWithPitchModulationAndStereoP
filled_label: Audio sample playback with pitch modulation and stereo panning
summary: Interpolates audio sample playback state: encodes progress event, blends color (RGB) and orientation data between current and target frame, clamping Euler angles to ±15.999 before quantized output. Audio sample playback system.

name: sub_5118E6
summary: Allocates and initializes a PNG/zlib decompression context block: stores parameters, validates libpng version string (must start with '1'), sets up error-recovery via setjmp/longjmp, initialises zlib stream (version 1.1.3), handles zlib error codes with specific messages, and registers sub_513C80 as read callback.

name: sub_51641E
summary: Iterates over indexed elements from array at *(this) with boundary-clamped chunk sizes, dispatching each chunk to one of two callbacks (this+0x28 or this+0x2C selected by flag a3). Each callback receives destination, state pointer, element pointer, base offset, and byte count.

name: sub_5164A6
summary: Iterates over indexed elements from array at *(this) with boundary-clamped chunk sizes, dispatching each chunk to one of two callbacks (this+0x28 or this+0x2C selected by flag a3). Each callback receives destination, state pointer, element pointer, base offset, and byte count. [twin of sub_51641E]

name: Det3x3From4x4
summary: Computes the determinant of the upper-left 3x3 submatrix extracted from a 4x4 matrix (4 rows of __m128 at 16-byte stride). Uses SSE shuffle/multiply/subtract/add with alignment-aware load path (unaligned via _mm_loadh_ps if address not 16-byte aligned). Returns determinant as double. Part of SSE math library.

name: sub_5276C5
summary: Allocate and initialize resource buffer struct via callback-based allocator. Allocates primary struct (size 64), secondary fixed buffer (size 1440), and variable-size buffer (size a3). Initializes fields, calls sub_52765A reset, with cleanup on allocation failure.

name: MPEGAudioLayer3IMDCT
summary: Inverse Modified Discrete Cosine Transform (IMDCT) for MPEG Audio Layer 3 decoding. Converts frequency-domain subband samples to time-domain audio via butterfly rotation and windowed overlap-add with coefficient table lookup.

name: MPEGAudioLayer3IMDCT_b206
summary: Inverse Modified Discrete Cosine Transform (IMDCT) for MPEG Audio Layer 3 decoding. Converts frequency-domain subband samples to time-domain audio via butterfly rotation and windowed overlap-add with coefficient table lookup. [twin of MPEGAudioLayer3IMDCT]

name: sub_536260
summary: Initializes audio codec context fields: computes buffer sizes, zeroes state flags, and loads codec configuration tables (word_5B77E8/EA/EC/EE) indexed by codec type. Part of audio codec initialization pipeline.

name: UIElementInitialization
summary: Initializes audio codec context object by setting up vtable pointers (off_5DA928, off_5DA93C), internal buffer self-pointers, a D3D shader/state pointer (unk_5DA950), and zeroing the bitstream shift register state. Part of audio codec initialization pipeline.

name: sub_53A4D0
summary: Builds literal/length (288 symbols max) and distance Huffman decode tables for DEFLATE decompression. Allocates working table via vtable, calls sub_53A020 twice (first for literals/lengths, then for distances), and handles error conditions with descriptive string messages. Part of inflate decompression pipeline.

name: EulerAngleToRotationMatrix
summary: Converts three Euler angles into a 3x3 rotation matrix stored as 15 float fields. Uses sin/cos trigonometric functions for each angle and computes cross-product terms for the rotation matrix. Part of 3D transformation/math library.

name: ClippedRectRender
summary: Renders a clipped 2D rectangle surface using F_2DSurfaceCompositing. Applies clipping bounds via sub_543540, converts float dimensions to integers, and clears the 0x400 compositing flag on the target surface.

name: sub_5434A0
summary: Fills a 2D rectangle area on a surface using F_2DSurfaceBlitFill. Reads dimensions from this[7] and this[8], applies scaling factors, validates bounds via sub_543540, and clears the 0x400 compositing flag.

name: OffsetDispatch
summary: Allocate and initialize resource buffer struct via callback-based allocator. Allocates primary struct (size 64), secondary fixed buffer (size 1440), and variable-size buffer (size a3). Initializes fields, calls sub_52765A reset, with cleanup on allocation failure. [twin of sub_5276C5]

name: BoundingBoxComputationFromVertexData
filled_label: Oriented bounding box and sphere from vertex data
summary: Computes oriented bounding box (via covariance matrix and QR decomposition for OBB axes) and bounding sphere radius from mesh vertex data. Accumulates vertex statistics, transforms AABB corners through D3D matrix, and stores sphere radius at offset 0x18.

name: sub_54EED0
summary: Inserts a 3D triangle into the scene render batch system by transforming vertex indices to world-space positions, testing each batch slot for frustum/sphere intersection, and populating the first available slot with the triangle's position, normal, and material data.

name: CollisionContactDetection
summary: Per-frame collision contact detection: iterates over triangle list, depth-tests triangle vertices against line segments via D3D device, performs 2D point-in-triangle test to confirm contact, and stores contact data (world position, penetration distance, triangle source) for physics response. Returns number of contacts detected.

name: SceneBatchRenderCheck
summary: Checks whether a scene entity is visible and within collision distance; if so, increments an audio collision counter. Part of the scene rendering / audio collision system.

name: VertexParticleBufferAllocator
summary: Allocates and initializes a particle vertex buffer: frees old buffer, allocates new descriptor and entry array, copies source position data, computes maximum camera-to-particle distance for LOD culling.

name: HighPrecisionTimerCounterArithmetic
summary: Computes elapsed time from a reference timestamp (offset 0x18/0x1C), subtracts an accumulated delta (offset 0x28/0x2C), and adds a base accumulated time (offset 0x10). Does not modify any stored fields. Part of high-resolution timer adjustment system.

name: HighResolutionTimerDeltaCalculation
summary: Computes elapsed time in seconds from the reference timestamp at offset 0x18/0x1C to the current time. Calls TimerQueryDispatcher for current timestamp, subtracts stored reference, and converts ticks to time using frequency and reciprocal. Does not update any stored fields. Part of high-resolution timer system.

name: sub_560547
summary: Copy/mix image data between two buffers using a run-length pattern array to control copy segments. Alternates copy direction per segment (via dword_5DD83C toggle). Uses stride values from source/destination structs.

name: MultiFieldObjectDestructorWithCleanupCalls
summary: Destructor for 3D sound source sub-objects. Frees three allocated sub-objects at offsets 0xC, 0x1C, 0x20, calling cleanup stubs before each free. Part of 3D sound source teardown.

name: FilePathNameLookup
summary: Dispatch incoming network packet or file path request. If packet starts with ';' (ASCII 59), call vtable function pointer at this[63]. Otherwise iterate through scene file data pointer table, call sub_562530 for each, and accumulate result strings through case-based buffer init routines.

name: sub_5687F0
summary: Checks if the input string matches a reserved DOS device name (CON, PRN, AUX, CLOCK$, COM1-COM9, LPT1-LPT9). Truncates at path separators and extracts up to 7 chars before comparison. Returns 1 if matched, 0 otherwise.

name: PerformanceCounterDiffWithScaling
summary: Computes elapsed time from a reference timestamp (offset 0x18/0x1C), subtracts an accumulated delta (offset 0x28/0x2C), and adds a base accumulated time (offset 0x10). Does not modify any stored fields. Part of high-resolution timer adjustment system. [twin of HighPrecisionTimerCounterArithmetic]

name: VehicleProjectedPosition
summary: Computes collision contact constraint response: projects contact point (a2) relative to vehicle position (offsets 0x4/0xC/0x14) onto contact normal (a3), computes velocity along normal (a4), impulse correction (a5) using world-space inertia tensor (0xEC-0x12C), and optionally outputs body-space contact offset (a6). Part of collision detection physics pipeline.

name: sub_56A390
summary: Iterates over constraint entries, computes constraint-space force values from angular velocity delta and linear velocity, accumulates into a force buffer. Part of vehicle physics constraint solver preparation.

name: sub_56A5D0
summary: Processes joint constraint velocity vectors: transforms velocities through rotation matrices via Matrix3x3VectorMultiply, computes cross products, scales by traction constants, accumulates into constraint force buffer. Part of vehicle physics constraint solver.

name: sub_56A840
summary: Iterates over contact constraint entries (stride 88), computes scalar constraint values from body position, linear velocity, angular velocity, and tire traction constants, accumulates into force buffer. Part of vehicle physics contact processing.

name: sub_56AA60
summary: Assembles off-diagonal constraint stiffness matrix blocks. For each constraint pair, computes cross products of constraint axes with world-space inverse inertia tensor rows, accumulates into a sparse 3x3 block matrix indexed by constraint IDs. Core of vehicle physics constraint solver setup.

name: sub_56B5D0
summary: Assembles diagonal and off-diagonal blocks of the constraint stiffness matrix for joint constraints (stride 132) and contact constraints (stride 88), using world-space inverse inertia tensor rows. Part of vehicle physics constraint solver matrix construction.

name: sub_56D2D0
summary: Computes world-space offset between two rigid body constraint anchor points. Transforms local anchor offsets through body rotation matrices via Matrix3x3VectorMultiply, adds body positions, computes difference vector, normalizes to unit length. Part of constraint solver anchor setup.

name: IntSetInsert
summary: Checks if integer a2 exists in set (linked list at offset 0x18). Linear scan comparing node data against a2. If found returns 1 (already present). If not found allocates 4 bytes for value, appends node via LinkedListNodeAppend_6000, returns 0.

name: NetworkMessageEventComparisonWithShortMasking
summary: Compares network event structure (referenced by this[7]) against two-component query key from a2. Two alternative match patterns within the event are tried; returns true if either matches.

name: sub_588212
summary: Computes floating-point exponentiation (FYL2X-based) with full IEEE 754 edge-case handling: NaN/infinity propagation, zero-to-zero, infinity-to-zero, sign handling, and FPU exception state management via fsave/frstor.

name: sub_588E4E
summary: Parses locale/configuration string input. Handles special case "C" (ASCII 67) as default locale. Matches input against locale compare strings, tokenizes via sub_588F8B, and updates global locale data state.

name: sub_589E6C
summary: Converts time value (seconds) to broken-down time structure with timezone bias and DST correction. Handles negative adjustments, normalizes seconds/minutes/hours/days/ months.

name: sub_58A973
summary: Internal CRT memory allocator dispatching between pool allocator and HeapAlloc based on OS version code (2=Win2K pool path, 3=WinXP sub-allocation path, else HeapAlloc). Rounds allocation size up to 16-byte alignment.

name: sub_58AA6F
summary: Memory free/dispose function dispatching to pool-based free or HeapFree based on OS version code (2=Win2K pool, 3=WinXP pool, else HeapFree). NULL-safe — returns immediately on null pointer.

name: sub_58AB58
filled_label: Aligned counted-element allocator with debug heap retry
summary: Multi-strategy memory allocator (count * size) with 16-byte alignment and zero-initialization. Dispatches to pool allocator (Win2K or WinXP style) or HeapAlloc based on OS version and size. Retries via debug heap callback when CRT_DebugHeapFlag is set and primary allocation fails.

name: sub_58D04D
filled_label: fprintf: formatted output to file stream
summary: CRT `fprintf`/`printf` core implementation. Parses a format string with full specifier support (flags `#+-0`, width, precision, size prefixes `h/l/w/I64`, conversion characters `d/i/o/u/x/X/c/s/p/n/e/E/f/g/G/Z/C/S`) and writes formatted output to a file stream. Uses a state machine driven by format-classification table byte_5B8D88.

name: sub_58E4D2
summary: Parses input from a buffered I/O context using a scanf-style format string. Handles integers (%d/%i/%u/%o/%x/%p), floats (%f/%e/%g), strings (%s/%S), character sets (%{...}), width, precision, and length modifiers. Returns count of successful conversions.

name: sub_591FA1
summary: Performs locale-sensitive string mapping (LCMapString — upper/lower case, sortkey, etc.) with automatic code-page conversion. Detects WideChar mode at runtime; in mode 2 calls LCMapStringA directly; in mode 1 converts ANSI→Wide→LCMapStringW→Wide→ANSI (or LCMapStringW→sortkey). Returns mapped length or 0 on failure.

name: sub_5932F3
summary:
Looks up error code in a table of (code, string) pairs. If console is available, writes error string to stderr via WriteFile. Otherwise builds a "Runtime Error!

Program: <exe>

<description>" message box string displayed via sub_597234. Used as CRT error display handler.

name: sub_5934E1
summary: C++ exception handler dispatch. Validates exception record (code 0xE06D7363), unwinds nested exceptions via TLS, binary-searches scope table for matching try-level range, and dispatches to matched catch handler by type comparison.

name: SEHWrapperAroundCRTFunctionCall
summary: SEH wrapper that saves/restores TLS exception context around a try-block execution. On C++ exception (code 0xE06D7363) with non-zero return, dispatches through SEHWrappedRenderDispatchCall after abnormal termination check.

name: sub_595AF9
summary: CRT file open/create wrapper around CreateFileA. Parses flag field (a2) into access mode, share mode, creation disposition, and flags-and-attributes; allocates a descriptor slot via sub_595801, assigns the handle via sub_595924, optionally reads first byte for EOF marker (0x1A) detection, and returns the file descriptor index or -1 on error.

name: sub_595DC8
summary: Classifies character types (via GetStringTypeW or GetStringTypeA) using a cached codepage mode. Mode detection first probes GetStringTypeW (Unicode path), falling back to GetStringTypeA (ANSI path). On Unicode path, converts input from multi-byte to wide char first via MultiByteToWideChar.

name: sub_59797B
summary: Truncates or extends a file to a specified size (lDistanceToMove). Saves current position, seeks to end to get file size, then either truncates via SetEndOfFile (if shrinking) or extends by writing zeros in 4096-byte chunks (if growing). Restores original file position on completion.

name: BufferedStreamReadWithFallbackVtableCall
summary: Reads one byte from buffered input stream. Returns buffered byte directly if available; otherwise calls vtable[5] (underflow) then vtable[2] (sputc) to refill and process.

name: StreamCharReaderWithBufferFillGetcFallback
filled_label: Stream char reader with buffer fill and getc fallback
summary: Reads wide characters from stream buffer using chunk copy (fast path) when internal buffer is available and non-empty; falls back to per-character virtual getc call (vtable slot 5) when buffer is exhausted. Returns total characters read.

name: sub_599DD9
filled_label: Stream char writer with buffer flush and putc fallback
summary: Writes wide characters to stream write buffer (fast path using chunk copy) when internal buffer is available and has space; falls back to per-character virtual putc call (vtable slot 1) when buffer is full. Returns total characters written.

name: sub_59A0D5
summary: Reads one byte from buffered input stream. Returns buffered byte directly if available; otherwise calls vtable[5] (underflow) then vtable[2] (sputc) to refill and process. [twin of BufferedStreamReadWithFallbackVtableCall]

name: VehicleSuspensionForceCalculation
summary: Computes suspension contact forces between wheel collision geometry and ground surface using ray-sphere intersection tests. Iterates over suspension struts, queries spatial grid for collision features, and calculates response force components along contact normal with gravity compensation.

name: SweptSuspensionCollisionDetection
summary: Advances wheel positions along velocity direction (Euler step), then performs swept collision detection for each suspension strut by sampling multiple travel positions and selecting the one with maximum contact force. Calls VehicleSuspensionForceCalculation and TireForceSolver at each sample to evaluate contact response.

name: sub_403640
filled_label: Nearest-neighbor spatial query with plane test
summary: Finds the closest physics strut or collision node to a query point using both Euclidean squared-distance and a signed-distance plane-proximity score. When a starting node is provided, walks its linked collision geometry lists to find the nearest neighbor; then scans all active struts to find the globally closest candidate that passes the plane test.

name: sub_403CD0
filled_label: Track spline data lookup with interpolation
summary: Looks up position and orientation data from a track spline array indexed by node index. If the requested entry is zero-initialized (invalid/missing), walks backwards in steps of 2 to find the nearest valid entries and performs linear interpolation between them; falls back to first entry if no valid pair exists.

name: ArrayOfStructIndexedFieldCopy
summary: Getter: returns field 0x154 of this. No side effects. [auto]

name: IndexedStructDataRead
summary: Reads position (3 floats) and orientation (3 floats) from a 2D-indexed array of 28-byte (7-float) struct entries. Computes linear index as `a2 + a3 * width_stride` and copies the first 6 floats of the entry to two output buffers.

name: RenderNodeListDestructor
summary: Destructor that frees a linked list of render nodes (each with optional conditional data cleanup), followed by freeing up to three auxiliary buffers at offsets 0x28/0x30/0x38, then frees the main object itself.

name: sub_404B60
summary: Dispatches session-specific setup logic: handles race mode (type 2) with state comparison and threshold accumulation, server mode (type 5) with conditional audio playback, and bitmap/game-command validation with main-menu check.

name: ResourceListCleanup
summary: When activated (a2 non-zero), frees all nodes in a linked list of resources, clears the list head, then rebuilds the list by enumerating directory entries from a resolved path. When a2 is zero, only sets a flag and returns.

name: MainMenuTransition
summary: Handles transition back to main menu: restores previously saved global state (race mode flag, scoring gate flag), applies timeout overrides, resets a flag, and conditionally dispatches a virtual state reset. Mirrors the save logic in RaceModeSetup.

name: F_3DSoundPositioningUpdate
summary: Computes 3D spatial audio parameters (distance attenuation, stereo pan, Doppler pitch shift) for a positional sound source relative to a listener, then applies them via Miles AIL API calls (volume, playback rate, position). Part of the Miles/3D audio subsystem.

name: PhysicsCollisionResponseComputation
summary: Computes collision response intensity for audio feedback. Copies collision position/velocity parameters to struct, evaluates collision intensity via virtual function calls, clamps to [0,1], and either cleans up (no collision) or computes distance delta for audio triggering.

name: sub_4069F0
summary: Builds an MP3 filename string from track index and stores the formatted string result handle at offset 0x5C. Frees previous slot resource via sub_406A70 before overwriting if slot was active.

name: AudioDriverInit
summary: Initializes Miles Sound System digital audio driver. Calls Miles startup, selects sample rate based on stored index (11025/22050/44100), opens digital driver, sets HWND and file callbacks on success, or shuts down on failure.

name: SafeDivisionWithZeroGuard
summary: Computes safe reciprocal (1.0/a2) guarded against zero/negative input; resets timer to 0 and triggers clamp+dispatch on invalid input. Part of physics timing/integration system.

name: sub_409890
summary: Searches for mirror bitmap in linked list, checks a flag bit (0x40000) to select rearview vs mainview mode, stores view parameters, and dispatches conditional render pipeline. Called during camera/director update for mirror rendering.

name: KeyboardInputActionMapper
summary: Iterates array of input action codes (word_7CB21C) and maps each to a camera action: target race leader, track current vehicle, or switch camera mode. Gated by CameraLockCheck and GameActionStateMachine per action.

name: RandomStateMachineWithTimerAndTrigger
summary: Countdown timer that, on expiry, picks a random camera mode (0,3,4,5) and transitions via GameActionStateMachine. Optionally targets race leader. Called per-tick from camera director.

name: CameraTargetUpdateOnPlayerChange
summary: Updates camera target when player changes vehicle. Compares current camera target ID against current player's vehicle field; on mismatch, stops/transitions audio effects and computes new camera mode based on dispatch mode selector and vehicle state. Called by camera director during player vehicle swap.

name: VirtualDispatchHelper
summary: Dispatches to a virtual method at vtable+0x18 on a component object, with early-out on cached result. Part of component-based dispatch system used across rendering, physics, and particles.

name: SessionPhaseDecode
summary: Decodes session phase identifier (0-4) from a session pointer into a stored field, or sets fallback code 5 on mismatch. Used across audio, random state machine, and session dispatch systems.

name: GameStateBranchDispatch
summary: Dispatches camera mode and game action based on global dispatch mode selector (dword_7CFDC4 values 1-4). Branches to ViewCameraModeDispatch and GameActionStateMachine with paired mode/action IDs. Part of game state management system.

name: BatchProcessWithFixedStartOffsets
summary: Dispatches StateDependentUpdateDispatch across 6 batches of objects stored at fixed offsets within a struct. Each batch has a count field and a base pointer field; stride is 36 bytes per object. Batches 4-6 have minimum start indices (416, 208, 832) below which no objects exist. Resets counter at this+0x6C to 0.

name: DelegationWrapperToFUN0040ed10

name: CommentaryTVPWSPathBuilder

name: sub_415700
summary: Iterates a linked list (head at this[0], stored at this[2]) and clears the active flag (byte at offset 0xC) to 0 for every reachable node, effectively resetting all entries to inactive.

name: InsertDriverTableEntry
summary: Inserts an 8-DWORD entry into a 20-entry sorted table (at this+0x86C). Validates input, looks up driver data, computes score, finds insertion point by time/score ordering, shifts entries, and copies. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure. Used by AI/commentary subsystems.

name: StateCheckedVirtualDispatch

name: ArraySearchReturningIndex

name: AIDriverStateTransition

name: AIOvertakeDefendStateChange

name: AIRetirementVehicleFailureEvent

name: AIOutOfTrackEvent

name: DisplayMessage0x11c

name: DisplayMessage0x4a

name: ClearPitSelectionFlags

name: PitExit

name: GdbSeasonSelector

name: sub_422BE0
summary: Writes the game configuration file (settings/config) by opening a file in write-text mode, clearing its read-only attribute, then writing all config sections (video, audio, directories, rendering, etc.) via formatted string output. Returns 1 on success, 0 if file cannot be opened.

name: StringHashTokenParsing

name: BinarySearchInStringTable

name: AIDifficultyScalar
summary: Maps AI difficulty slider value (0-100 range) to a performance scalar between 0.75 and 1.0. Above 95 returns flat 1.0 (maximum AI ability); below 95 uses linear interpolation: ((slider - 70) * 0.01) + 0.75.

name: AIDifficultyInterpolation
summary: Maps AI difficulty slider to an interpolated ability value using three anchor constants (low/mid/high). Below 100 uses low-to-mid linear interpolation; above 100 uses mid-to-high extrapolation. Called once during AI driver struct init.

name: AIRingBufferFieldInit
summary: Computes an oscillating noise value from a trig lookup table indexed by a ring buffer counter, combined with baseline offset and difficulty slider scaling. Stores result in this[4370] (offset 0x4448) to add frame-to-frame variability to AI behavior.

name: PairArrayLinearSearch
summary: Linear search for a duplicate command ID in the AI command queue. Iterates 8-byte {cmd, param} pairs in the queue buffer. Returns 1 if command ID a2 already exists, 0 if not found. Called by CommandQueueResponseHandler for deduplication.

name: SpeedDeltaComputation
summary: Computes speed difference between AI's target vehicle (stored at this[0x4354]) and another vehicle (a2). Returns: 0.0 if a2 is null, speed difference if both exist, or -1.0 if AI has no target. Used by AI overtaking and nearest-vehicle logic.

name: RacePhasePitEntryTrigger

name: TrackParameterMinimumClamp
summary: Clamps a track/steering parameter at this[0x4484] into [5.0, a2] range. If current value exceeds a2, clamps down; if below 5.0, clamps up. Used by AI steering subsystems to limit track correction values.

name: AIComputePassScore

name: WrapPlayerCallback
summary: Wraps player session callback by computing callToBox flag = AiOvertakeDistanceThreshold + this[0x4], then writing it via AIStateFlagSetter. Used during phase-3 cleanup in CommandQueueResponseHandler.

name: AISpeedDeltaSetter

name: LateralForceTorqueCalculation

name: AIDelegateCall
summary: Calls `SpatialTreeNearestNeighborSearch` with vehicle position and struct parameters to find nearest spatial neighbor. Returns handle to nearest entity or zero.

name: StateFlagsLookup
summary: Getter: returns field 0x4588 of this. No side effects. [auto]

name: DynMan_Init

name: WeightedDataLookup

name: PenaltyStructInit

name: ReplayStateCopy

name: NameStringCopy

name: SimpleSetterWithFlag

name: SettingsCopySetupFileCopy

name: PlayerNameSetup
summary: Sets up player name configuration by reading settings files, resolving folder paths, searching string tables for player name, and enumerating matching files in the settings directory. Orchestrates multiple settings-file and path-resolution steps.

name: AutoLoadEntryWriter
summary: Writes a sequence of format strings (backup extension, format specifiers, and path components) into a buffer to compose an auto-load configuration entry. Used during config file parsing.

name: LoadAIDriverNamesFromConfig

name: ValidateVehicleConfigurationFile

name: SteeringInterpolationCameraFollow
summary: Computes interpolated camera position and steering angle to smoothly follow a vehicle, handling both normal chase-cam and special fixed-camera (mode 5) paths. Part of the camera/rendering system.

name: ConstraintEnforce
summary: Computes constraint displacement and velocity error, then evaluates the piecewise constraint response function. Stores the resulting constraint force. Part of the constraint solver feedback loop.

name: TorqueForceProductComputation

name: ConstraintProjectGramSchmidt

name: SuspensionBarLookup

name: SolverDispatch
summary: Dispatches to different solver functions based on an operation type ID. Routes to spring evaluation, constraint solving, force/torque computation, or delta tracking. Part of the physics constraint solver dispatch system.

name: DeltaUpdateTracking
summary: Tracks a value's delta (change between frames), applies exponential smoothing, and accumulates the result. Used for smoothing physics parameters over time. Part of the physics update system.

name: QuadFunctionEval
summary: Evaluates two quadratic functions at input value: result = a*x^2 + b*x + c, and stores both input and results. Used for non-linear spring curve evaluation in the physics solver.

name: QuadraticForceTorqueCalculator
summary: Evaluates two quadratic functions at input value and stores results as force and torque components. Uses coefficients from the physics struct. Part of the vehicle dynamics force/torque computation system.

name: WheelCollisionContactFlagSetter
summary: Sets collision contact flags on collision data entries based on wheel contact state. When a wheel has contact (v2 != 0), marks the matching body-pair contact as collided; otherwise marks wheel-body contacts with contact flags. Part of vehicle collision system.

name: DoubleAccumulatorClamp

name: PhysicsForceScaleDispatch

name: RandomWeightedAudioMix

name: PhysicsDampingScaleApplication

name: StateAccumulateDelta
summary: Shifts wheel state history, then for each wheel computes the delta between current and previous state (position and velocity vectors), accumulating the difference back into the previous state buffer. name: PhysicsSubObjectFree

name: PhysicsStepFrame
summary: Executes one physics step frame: shifts wheel state history, runs suspension wheel dynamics solver, processes two batch iteration helpers, finds minimum value via iteration function, and copies suspension data to physics sub-objects. Core per-frame physics step.

name: BoundingVolumeHierarchyTraversalFilter
summary: Filters bounding volume hierarchy traversal by checking distance thresholds against an input parameter. Returns TRUE if any relevant bounding volume extends beyond the test distance, FALSE if all checked volumes are within it. Three mode-dependent filter paths based on BVH mode state. Part of collision detection pruning.

name: CollisionPositionTransform
summary: Transforms a collision contact position from body-local coordinates to world space using the body rotation matrix, subtracts the vehicle's world-space position, then applies two consecutive 3x3 matrix coordinate transformations. Part of collision detection geometry processing.

name: GetBodyMotionState
summary: Computes suspension spring-damper force and torque for a body via SuspensionSpringDamperForceComputationWithClampi, then returns the results through two output float arrays (force and torque vectors). Part of vehicle suspension query interface.

name: VehicleActive
summary: Returns boolean indicating whether the vehicle is in an active state. Checks multiple conditions: threshold values > 0, active flag set, optional override flag, and secondary state byte. Part of vehicle state management.

name: TrigTableLookup
summary: Performs a linear interpolated lookup into a 256-entry trig table using a scaled input value (x4.0 offset by -0.5). Uses integer truncation for table index and fractional part for interpolation between adjacent entries. Part of vehicle physics trig calculations.

name: RandomPhysicsParameterGenerator
summary: Generates a randomized physics parameter in [0.0, 1.0] range by interpolating between a lower bound (value+0.1) and upper bound (value+1.6) using a trig-table-based pseudo-random value. Returns 0 if inactive flag not set, 1.0 if input parameter >= 0.9, 0.0 if <= 0.0. Part of vehicle physics parameter randomization.

name: VisualStateChange

name: AudioDSPStateUpdate

name: CollisionContactResponse

name: SweepAndPruneAABBOverlapDetection

summary: Broad-phase collision detection using sweep-and-prune on AABB projections. Computes min/max axis-aligned projections for each triangle, sorts them by left bound, sweeps for overlapping pairs, and validates each overlap with SATEdgeSeparationTest. Marks overlapping pairs at field offset 0x18.

name: CollisionImpulseAccumulator
summary: Accumulates collision impulse vectors into a contact impulse buffer. Adds three components each from two input vectors (a2, a3) to six consecutive double fields (linear + angular impulse accumulation). Part of collision response system.

name: sub_44FF50
summary: Initializes the audio engine's voice routing, device enumeration, and effect configuration. Sets up audio sources for different effect categories (engine, collision, UI, etc.), configures gain envelopes, and manages mute channel assignment based on quality level.

name: sub_455260
summary: Looks up a string from one of two string tables (aEmpty or aPause_0) based on a discriminator field at offset 0x0. Returns pointer to formatted string or null for unknown type.

name: DualFieldGetter
summary: Reads two DWORD fields at offsets 0x38 and 0x3C from a struct and writes them to caller-supplied output pointers if non-null. Simple accessor / getter function.

name: sub_458190
summary: Serializes keyframe array (movement path) data to output text buffer using format strings. Validates keyframe array exists with >=4 entries, writes header strings, then writes one control point format entry per keyframe, followed by closing string. Returns 0 on success, 1 if data invalid.

name: sub_458A60
summary: Serializes tracking camera / shader configuration parameters into a formatted string buffer. Reads struct fields (position, orientation, FOV, clear color, clip planes, LOD, flags, activation zones, tracking rates) and writes them as key-value shader command strings to the output buffer.

name: CollisionInvMassStore
summary: Stores a mass value and its reciprocal (1/mass) into struct fields at offsets 0x180 and 0x188, then performs a reciprocal-division copy on a separate parameter. Part of collision/body initialization system.

name: F_6FieldBulkSetter
summary: Bulk-setter that writes six DWORD parameters (a2-a7) into six contiguous fields of a struct at offsets 0x28 through 0x3C (indices 10-15). Used for initializing grouped float/int configuration values.

name: PhysicsStateIntegration

name: PerIndexStructFieldResetter

name: RotatingIndexSearchWithThreshold

name: UtilityFunction_b9c0

name: InputCommandDispatchToEntities

name: CollisionContactIteration

name: YouHaveBeenBootedHandler

name: StartNetworkUpdate

name: NetworkFilterSort

name: DriverEntrantSetupEntry

name: NetCommParseCommandLine

name: sub_463BC0
summary: Enters multiplayer lobby or championship selection based on flag at +0xC5. Sets championship mode to 5 with timeout overrides, enables global boolean flag, calls dispatch wrapper, and shows "Select Circuit" or "Multiplayer Create" prompt depending on sub-routine result. Returns 0 if flag not set.

name: sub_463E20
filled_label: Game Entry Initializer (Audio, Network Replay, Title)
summary: Initializes audio stream struct with defaults and instance handle, formats game version string. If stack buffer copy predicate succeeds, sets flag at +0x1D0, stores this pointer at +0x3FC0, and queries sub-object result at +0x417C. Always initializes network replay buffer.

name: sub_463EF0

name: SessionTypeSetter

name: SynchronizeWithServer

Always clears accumulated fields and runs array initialization. Returns state value.

name: SessionScoringUpdate
filled_label: Per-frame session state manager and scoring update
summary: Core per-frame update for race session state machine — advances timers, dispatches linked-list session-state messages, manages server communication (OK request, track-open signal), and triggers scoring/timing subsystems. Part of the session lifecycle management system.

name: SessionStateByte7CE25FSetter
filled_label: Session flag setter based on object state
summary: Checks init guard byte_7CE260; if zero (not initialized), checks object bytes at +0xC5/+0xC6 and sets global byte_7CE25F=1 when either is nonzero. Also builds track config name and conditionally runs guarded init.

name: sub_465000
summary: Frees all nodes in four linked lists of a large object: walks linked lists at +0xE5B0 and +0xE5A0 (14704/14700), frees each node via ConditionalFreeByFlagCheck+FreeWrapper, clears list pointers/counts.
