name: ResourceManagerFrameCleanup

name: sub_465300
filled_label: Input command dispatch to collision/event lists
summary: Processes input command from a2. If it's a collision-type command (bits 29-30 == 1, subtype 0 or 7), routes to FloatComputation for direct collision processing. Otherwise allocates a new node, processes via ArithmeticComparison_3a90, and appends to one of two linked lists based on command type flags.

name: GameObjectUpdateFrame
summary: Per-frame update for game object. Optionally appends to doubly linked list, decrements a timer (field 0x124), calls position/physics subroutines (sub_466350, sub_466650) when flags set, and invokes virtual methods at vtable+44 and vtable+168.

name: sub_466350
summary: Position/heading update for camera or vehicle. Computes deltas from saved position, applies angle/velocity physics with clamping and flag-based branching (flags at 0xF4/0xF5). Uses sin/cos to compute velocity components and stores them at fields 0x118-0x120. Also uses global dword_7D0398 (photo/free camera mode) for alternate clamp logic.

name: sub_466650
summary: Secondary axis/rotation update for camera or vehicle. Accumulates elapsed time in this[67] (clamped to 3.0), reads position deltas, applies damping correction based on this[68] error term. Flag at 0xF4 selects brake-reset path vs smooth-damping path.

name: SetupValueDisplayFormatter_69a0
summary: Retrieves a value via virtual call (vtable+180), normalizes by dividing by (this[62]-this[61]), converts to percentage, and formats as "%d%%" string. Checks flag at this+0xF0 to choose signed vs unsigned division.

name: CareerModeDriverStatsReset
summary: Resets career mode driver stats display by destroying the existing stat list, calling a vtable method, rebuilding the stat list with 13 stat keys (adding Circuit, BestLap, and an extra ExperienceLaps to the base 10), then calling state cleanup and sub_468BF0. Belongs to career mode results/stats system.

name: sub_46BC20
summary: Builds UI list of lap times for a vehicle. Uses this[94] as vehicle index into vehicle data array (stride 18624). For each valid lap (up to minimum of current lap and max displayable), formats lap number, lap time, and gap to best lap; creates UI menu item per lap with composite display string.

name: SessionCheckEndCondition
summary: Evaluates multiple session-end conditions (race completion, qualifying, vehicle state, timeout) and invokes a vtable callback with the result (1 = end session). Central decision function for session lifecycle.

name: SessionMessageUICommandHandler
summary: Multi-branch handler for session UI commands based on type selector at offset 0x304: copies track buffer strings (types 432/434) or processes a session message with progress bar event encoding, texture creation, path construction, and session state dispatch (type 435). Always calls vtable function at +168 before returning.

name: sub_475150
summary: Populates UI list with available network game sessions: reads current game count from GameModuleManager, iterates sessions to create menu items with descriptions/player counts/status colors, and shows "Searching..." or "No games available" fallback messages.

name: SeasonPathMatchSearch
summary: Searches a linked list of season scene nodes for one whose path string matches the global SeasonPath (`dword_7D0434`). Stores the match index at offset 0x174.

name: SeasonSceneSearchByName
summary: Searches a linked list of season scene nodes for one whose name string matches a filtered path obtained via `ConditionalDispatch_40b0`. Performs byte-by-byte comparison and stores match index at offset 0x174.

name: SeasonSceneInitialization
summary: Orchestrates season scene initialization: performs path-based and name-based scene searches, copies match index, traverses linked list for GameFilterDataPath match, then recalculates viewport layout.

name: GameContentFilterCheck
summary: Checks a content string at offset 0x180 against the game filter. If content matches the filter, skips processing; otherwise invokes virtual callback at offset 160. Always follows up with a settings path comparison that may trigger a scene list search.

name: sub_478ED0
summary: Manages track path display in UI: resolves stored path vs current track path (dword_7CE5D0) with fallback to default directory; updates display via vtable callback; handles championship+server mode (sets byte_7CFF48 flag and triggers notification); runs hit test.

name: UIComponentScrollUpdate
summary: UI scroll/selection update handler: dispatches scroll logic based on state (this+0x104), managing a float accumulator timer, bounded counter updates, and layout recalculation.

name: sub_47C360
summary: Builds a UI menu list page by iterating over race standings entries, creating menu items with scene names and position numbers, then configuring list management handlers. Supports page navigation direction (previous/next).

name: UILoadingPercentDisplay
summary: Reads loading progress float via vtable dispatch, converts to percentage string with "%d%%" format, and conditionally dispatches events based on field 0xFC mode (230 = threshold-gated dispatch, 232 = global dispatch).

name: MultiRegionOffsetAccumulationWithVTableDispatch
summary: Offsets four rectangle bounds (left, right, top, bottom) by (a3, a2), renders the union of old+new rectangle as damaged area, notifies self via vtable offset 44, and propagates offset recursively to child elements. Returns result of vtable offset 160 (end-state handler). Part of UI scroll/pan region system.

name: UIScrollViewRender
summary: Renders a scrollable UI view with optional screen-scale correction, clipping to parent bounds. Handles dirty-flag invalidation, iterates child scroll items to compute visible region, and dispatches either a direct 2D quad render or a scaled corrected render path.

name: StateChangeHandlerWithSubscriberNotification
filled_label: State change handler with subscriber notification
summary: Handles UI state change: dispatches notification if state differs, then activates (vtable+64 with 4) or deactivates (RangeCheck + ConditionalStateMachineDispatch), then walks subscriber linked list from this+0x90 notifying each via vtable+56.

name: UIFieldRenderer
filled_label: UI field renderer with bitmap and text
summary: Renders UI field with text and optional bitmap: validates label string at this+0xB0 and visibility flag at this+0xC8, selects rendering context via ShortComputation_6720/ByteFieldGetterAt100, measures text, calculates centered position using bound fields (this+0x4..0x10) and optional sub-structures at this+0x98/0x9C, then renders via BitmapDraw_81f0.

name: sub_4881F0
filled_label: UI element render/position with dual path
summary: Renders UI element: gets pointer via vtable+168; if non-null, computes dimensions from pointer data, calls F_10ParamForwarder and PositionUpdate; if null, computes dimensions from this[1..4] bounds and calls DelegationWrapper. Always dispatches vtable+44(0) finalization.

name: UITextBoxRendererWithScrollbar
summary: Renders a scrollable UI text box widget with optional scrollbar, drawing up to two text strings (header at this+0xB0, body at this+0xB8) and supporting bitmap overlays. Computes an output bounding rectangle (a2=left, a3=right, a4=top, a5=bottom) that encompasses all rendered content.

name: UIScrollWidgetUpdate
summary: Main update for a scroll widget. If flag at 0xEC is set, reads position bounds via DualFieldRead, checks if delta falls within range, sets active flag (0xED), runs DeltaBasedUpdate, then conditionally notifies and runs sub_486600 if widget is not hidden.

name: UIMenuItemCreator
summary: Creates and initializes a new UI menu item struct (232 bytes). Allocates via heap, sets vtable, copies text strings, inserts into list. Returns 0 on success, -1 if text argument null.

name: UICustomRenderDispatch
filled_label: UI custom render element dispatcher (linked-list walk with string lookup)
summary: Iterates a linked list of custom UI render elements, resolving each element's texture/driver path via string matching against a name array, then dispatches per-element rendering through virtual-method calls with viewport clipping.

name: UIScrollListUpdate
summary: Per-frame scroll list update: reads timing values, updates animation counter (this[0x148]), clamps pixel scroll position (this[0x150]), dispatches navigation advance or counter decrement based on byte flags. Called each frame for smooth scrolling.

name: TextInputRender
summary: Renders text input field with password masking and scroll. Copies edit buffer (optionally masking chars as '*'), appends cursor glyph when visible, measures text width, scrolls if text overflows available space, and draws via BitmapDraw_81f0. Calls vtable[11] update after render.

name: CollisionPositionStepper
summary: Steps collision/animation position toward target. Accumulates time delta, computes steps, advances position at rate proportional to distance (0.444 scaling), wraps within range (step * multiplier), and calls vtable[11] update each step.

name: sub_48D0D0
summary: Computes which list item index should be centered in visible area based on scroll position (this+0x334) and offset. Steps one-by-one toward target index via vtable[46] callback. Used for list/gallery scrolling with centering.

name: LinkedListNodeAppend
summary: Appends a new value node to a doubly-linked UI list/collection. Allocates a data node (8 bytes) with vtable and stores the input value, then allocates a list node (16 bytes) to link it, updating tail pointer and count.

name: ScrollProgressHandler
summary: Calculates and updates scroll bar thumb position for a UI scroll area. Computes progress ratio from current scroll value vs range, converts to pixel position, and triggers redraw if the thumb position changed.

name: UIScrollAreaAutoScrollManager
summary: Manages auto-scroll behavior for a UI scroll area based on input state. Reads mouse/touch position and scroll state via ShortComputation_6720 and DualFieldRead, then dispatches scroll commands (0=none, 6=scroll up, 7=scroll up fast, 8=scroll down, 9=scroll down fast, 3=stop) via virtual call at vtable+64 depending on which region the cursor is in.

name: MediaBufferPlaybackManager
summary: Renders a linked list of media buffer items with string lookup, message dispatch, and surface fill operations. Handles playback index clamping, item navigation, state-dependent multi-item rendering, and virtual-method cleanup.

name: UIStringComparison_e250
summary: Compares two stored path strings (this+0xB0 and this+0xE8). If they match and resources are loaded, renders a Bink video frame (via BinkVideoFrameRender) and signals update. If paths differ, calls vtable+160 to reload/reinitialize the video.

name: sub_48E4B0
summary: Compares two path strings (this+0xB0 and this+0xFC). If they differ, calls vtable+160 to reload. If they match and resources are loaded (this+0xE4 non-null, flag at this+0xF8 set), renders a Bink video frame via BinkVideoFrameRender, then copies the rendered surface via Accessor/RenderSurfaceFillCopy, signals update and repaints.

name: UIDimensionCapture
summary: Captures and computes UI element dimensions (position/size) by querying child widgets via indexed accessors and applying fallback defaults. Part of the UI layout system.

name: sub_48F1A0
filled_label: UI Tile Grid Cursor Input Handler
summary: Processes cursor/touch position within a UI tile grid widget: reads two-axis coordinate from a sub-object via DualFieldRead, checks if the position falls inside predefined rectangular regions (tiles), transitions between interaction states (hover, select, activate), and dispatches virtual-method callbacks for rendering and state updates.

name: UIViewportLayoutCalculator
summary: Computes tile grid layout dimensions for a viewport: reads available width/height, iterates child linked list to find max tile dimensions, calculates row and column counts based on layout mode (0=vertical, 1=horizontal), and handles overflow by invoking state reset virtual method. Calls UITileGrid to update tile positions.

name: UITileGrid
summary: Computes screen positions for tiles in a grid-based UI layout. Iterates over row/column counts, walks a linked list of tile nodes to find valid tiles, calculates X/Y positions accounting for alignment (left/center/right), and calls sub_48EA20 to place each tile.

name: UIWidgetProcessChildren
summary: Processes child widgets by reading input position and checking bounds intersection. For state groups 3-5, iterates the child linked list and dispatches a hit notification when a child rectangle contains the input position.

name: PanelMouseInteractionHandler
summary: Handles mouse/input interaction for a panel: for state groups 3-5, reads input position, tests against a custom hit-test vtable method, then iterates child widgets and dispatches hit notification on bounds match. Always iterates child dispatch list.

name: CollisionBroadphaseTraversal
summary: Recursive broadphase AABB traversal: walks list testing overlap via AABBOverlapTest; if no direct hit but sub_491680 filter passes, clips rectangle and recurses on subdivisions. Returns 1 on any overlap, 0 if list exhausted.

name: LinkedListNodeUnlinkByContent
summary: Reads reference node at struct offset 16, prepends its content to another list, then walks the list at offset 12 to find and unlink a matching node. Frees the unlinked node (and its value if flagged). Returns 1 on success.

name: CollisionProxyListBuilder
summary: Rebuilds collision proxy working list at header offset 28: clears it, then iterates two source lists (ring buffer slot + embedded list at offset 44), copies each node's AABB into a pool node and appends to working list. Then calls BroadphasePairPartition between working list and list at offset 12.

name: SubListWalkDestruction
summary: Destroys an embedded linked list at `*this + 12`: prepends each node's value to another list (reparent), then frees all node memory (with conditional value free). Zeros the 4-DWORD list sentinel.

name: sub_496880
summary: Iterates child objects (linked list at offset 0x1C) calling virtual render method (vtable+164) on each. Processes the current active object (offset 0x18) with virtual position update (vtable+56), then copies its page/layer names into string tables (StringReverseCopyLookup with "current page" / "current layer" keys). Calls final virtual method (vtable+64) on the current object. Part of the UI page/layer rendering system.

name: sub_4973D0
summary: Renders and copies a surface fill contingent on a float threshold (> 0.2 at 0xC4) and a valid resource pointer (at 0x1568). Searches for a named resource via ObjectSearchWithDoubleIteration; if not found or name mismatch, falls back to sub_497AD0 with aNoDropIcon string. Renders via F_10ParamForwarder and RenderSurfaceFillCopy.

name: GuardedDrawRenderDispatch
filled_label: Guarded rectangle fill & render list dispatch
summary: Conditionally fills a rectangular region on a render surface, then iterates two render lists calling draw methods. Guarded by enable flag at this+0x60 and a virtual method check at vtable[0x28]. Part of render subsystem.

name: RenderDispatchWithIteration
filled_label: Render dispatch with rect clamping and child iteration
summary: Renders clamped sub-rectangles from a linked list onto a drawing surface, then iterates child linked list calling draw method. Core render dispatch function in UI render system.

name: StringPointerAccessor
summary: Returns a string pointer from struct field at offset 0x10, or a default path string (byte_5EA438) if the field is null. Simple accessor for resource path or filename.

name: sub_49A5D0
summary: Dispatches UI actions based on a command ID at offset 0x00. Cases 1-6 perform list navigation (search by name, utility action with varying parameter, set current page string). Case 7 searches list items and performs linked list search. Case 9 copies string parameters. Case 0xA triggers polling loop. Case 0xB sets global multiplayer active flag to -1 (shutdown). Case 0xC sets up a rendering context and calls vtable methods. Cases 3-6 optionally use offset 0x14 as a TwoFieldSetter parameter.

name: WidgetRectBounds
summary: Computes output bounding rectangle for a widget. If widget dimensions are zero/negative, outputs raw dword rect stored at 0x4-0x10; otherwise computes pixel-accurate bounds from 16-bit position and size fields.

name: ShortComputation_adb0
summary: Getter: returns field 0xC of this. No side effects. [auto]

name: sub_49B9A0
summary: Checks if current player and current vehicle are on the same team, if an engine wear parameter exceeds a threshold, and if engine wear mode is active. On first detection, calls sub_41B190 to notify the driver. Updates and returns the driver present flag.

name: sub_49BE50
summary: Computes difference between finish and start time values, formats as "+/-MM:SS.mmm" string in output buffer. Part of lap timing HUD display with ghost/replay comparison support.

name: sub_49BFF0
summary: Reads time value for next lap index (current+1, wraps at 2→0), formats as " MM:SS.mmm" string in output buffer. Part of lap timing HUD display with ghost/replay comparison support.

name: sub_49C0B0
filled_label: conditional debug-string formatter from vehicle struct
summary: Copies default string to output; depending on TextRenderFlag, selects either a vehicle struct (via sub_4D1B50 lookup) or postProcessInput; if a time field in the struct is positive, formats a debug string from offset 0x46F8 and outputs it.

name: SteeringWheelAnimation
summary: Renders steering wheel animation HUD element. Conditionally selects audio trigger path or sub-function chain based on engine input mode state, then updates five animation parameters via clamped lerp.

name: sub_49DE40
summary: Renders session-state-2 HUD overlay: clipped backdrop, colored status indicators, suspension corner position bars, and formatted text (round/event info). Used for race standings or car status view.

name: sub_49F870
summary: Renders 2D text labels (driver names, timings) above vehicles in the 3D world projected to screen space. Part of the HUD/overlay rendering system — collects visible vehicles via view-frustum test, sorts by distance, and draws scissored text labels.

name: RaceFinishHandler
summary: Handles race completion per driver. Triggers per-driver commentary, transitions game state machine to post-race mode, and conditionally switches to menu mode based on vehicle state and timing. Dispatches event 19 for race winner.

name: FileSettingsScanner
summary: Scans a settings file buffer for configuration key-value pairs. Parses tokens delimited by separators, extracts the key portion by removing substrings, compares the key against a reference path, and calls a virtual callback to process matches.

name: LinkedListWalker
summary: Walks a singly-linked list and invokes FileSettingsScanner on each node. Tracks current position in iterator field (this+0x8). Used during player file initialization to process settings entries.

name: LinkedListDispatchWithVTableCalls
summary: Walks a linked list and calls each node's first vtable function (vtable[0]) with a parameter. Optionally performs resource lookup with dual path before traversal. Tracks current position in iterator field (this+0x8).

name: PitCrewMeshLoader
summary: Loads pit crew member meshes into the scene graph. Guards on detail level threshold, allocates mesh resources, walks sub-mesh linked list, appends nodes to actor node list, and builds child index table. Falls back to error logging on allocation failure.

name: sub_4A3320
summary: Sets up pit crew member orientation: computes Euler rotation matrix from parameter a3, applies 180-degree Y-axis rotation, sets state flag (this[0x8] = 2), and forwards transform data. Part of pit crew animation system.

name: PerElementConditionalActionDispatcher
summary: Manages per-part flag state in a pitstop operation. In normal mode (a2=0), conditionally sets or clears Bit12 on each non-null part object based on completion state (float == 99999.0) and a pending-interaction byte flag. In clear-all mode (a2≠0), clears Bit12 on every part unconditionally.

name: sub_4A35F0
summary: Computes desired float values from the input parameter struct `a2` (reading flags and float offsets for two animation phases), then propagates those values into each array element's sub-element structures by calling RangeProportionInitializer. Called by PitStopOperationTimer to drive part animation targets.

name: PhysicsChannelProcessingWithLocals
summary: Computes time-phase subdivisions (0.0, 0.25×, 0.5×, 0.75×, and offset-3.6) from an input float value (elapsed time / phase), then distributes them to each array element's sub-element structures via RangeProportionInitializer. Used by PitStopOperationTimer for multi-channel animation timing.

name: AccumulatorWithStateSwitch
summary: Accumulates `a2` into an internal float value (offset 0x84) and forwards it to sub_4A2840. Behavior depends on state at offset 0x78: 0 = disabled (no action), 1 = reset accumulator to 0 then forward, other = accumulate and forward.

name: FindNearestVehicle
summary: Iterates through the global vehicle pointer array (dword_7C54F0) to find the vehicle closest (by positive SpeedDeltaComputation) to a target vehicle identified by index a2. Uses two different distance-computation paths depending on whether the candidate pointer is null (fallback to base vehicle data). Returns the closest vehicle pointer.

name: TireCompoundNameIDMapping
summary: Maps a tire compound name string to an integer ID: Hard→2, Soft→3, Intermediate→4, Wet→5, Monsoon→6, unknown→1. Uses sub_588410 for string comparison (returns 0 on match).

name: sub_4A4900
summary: Loads pit crew animation MAS files (10sec, normal, and optionally pit-director) for the current vehicle/track context. Runs only when ScoringGate != 2 and either the target vehicle is the player vehicle or detail level >= 3.

name: ConditionalDispatch_55a0
summary: Dispatches to up to three sub-objects for per-frame update: calls sub_4A3570 (AnimationTargetPropagator) on `this[4]` and `this[3]`, and AccumulatorWithStateSwitch on `this[5]`, passing the caller's float parameters through. Each call is guarded by null-pointer check.

name: ConditionalDispatch_55e0
summary: Selects between two pitstop state transition targets using a boolean flag at offset 0x2C. If flag is non-zero, calls PitstopStateTransition on `this[4]`; otherwise calls it on `this[3]`.

name: PitstopStateTransition
summary: Transitions pitstop state machine from the current active sub-object to a new one (`a2`). Conditionally runs cleanup on the old sub-object (FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall) or skips cleanup based on operation state flags (offsets 0x184/0x190). Then either reinitializes the new sub-object (sub_4A3390) or directly activates it based on the old object's pending flag.

name: ArithmeticComparison_5660
summary: Sets the pitstop operation mode and selector flags based on input `a2`. When a2=0, sets mode to 1 with flags cleared. When a2≠0 and mode is not already 2, transitions to mode 2 with flags set. Always dispatches through ConditionalDispatch_55e0 after updating state.

name: StateTransition
summary: Sets operation mode and flags. When a2=0, mode=1 with flags cleared. When a2≠0 and mode is not already 2, transitions to mode 2 with flags set. Returns 0 (reset), 1 (activated), or 2 (already active). Unlike ArithmeticComparison_5660, does not dispatch further.

name: FindZeroResultIndex
summary: Iterates through valid part indices by calling NthValidPartLookup(i) until it returns 0 (no part at that index). Stores the count (first index returning 0) in `this[42]`. Requires at least one valid part to complete (i > 0 guard prevents premature exit on initial index 0).

name: NthValidPartLookup
summary: Finds the Nth (1-indexed) available part by iterating through a part list. Filters out parts whose byte at +20 is set (occupied/busy) during a valid race session, unless the out-of-session flag is active. Optionally filters by compound type via `this[87]`. Returns the matching part pointer or 0 if not found.

name: PitRepairStatusDisplay
summary: Formats and refreshes a pit-repair HUD widget by computing fuel/lap-time display strings, looking up part names, formatting repair progress counters, and selecting "Repair"/"Do Not Repair" status labels based on internal mode flags.

name: ClampedIndexAssignment
summary: Converts a float value `a2` into a zero-based integer index using parameters (base, step, upper bound). Computes `round((a2 - base) / step)`, then clamps to [0, max-1]. Stores the clamped result at offset 0x6C. Used by PitStopDecisionTireCompound for array indexing.

name: StateChangeNotify
summary: Records a state change event into a ring buffer for replay/progress bar. On state transitions to 1 or 2 (with specific conditions), saves the session timestamp. Increments a ring buffer counter (max 1023 entries, each 432 bytes), encodes a progress bar event (type 6), and dispatches AI state machine processing on the new entry.

name: SessionTransitionDispatch
summary: Drives AI mode transitions: state 0→1 (activate), state 1→0 (deactivate), state 4→1 (reactivate). Routes each transition through StateChangeNotify for ring-buffer recording and dispatch. Other states produce no transition.

name: StateConditionalAction
summary: Drives AI mode transitions: state 0→1 (activate), state 1→0 (deactivate), state 4→1 (reactivate). Routes each transition through StateChangeNotify for ring-buffer recording and dispatch. Other states produce no transition. [twin of SessionTransitionDispatch]

name: StatePhaseSetter
summary: Sets AI state to phase 4 (offset 0x184) and flag to 1 (offset 0x180). If a sub-object pointer at offset 0x14 is non-null, calls ShortComputation_3fe0 on it.

name: ObjectStateClear
summary: Resets AI state to 0 (offset 0x184) and flag to 0 (offset 0x180). If a sub-object pointer at offset 0x14 is non-null, calls ShortComputation_3fe0 on it. Inverse of StatePhaseSetter (which sets state to 4, flag to 1).

name: BitmaskStateTest
summary: Tests whether a given bit index is set in a bitmask field, with an early-exit guard based on a state field value. Returns true if state field is not 5, or if the specific bit is set in the bitmask.

name: ShortToFloatVectorUnpack
summary: Converts 2 int16 values to float by multiplying by 0.001953125 (1/512) and writes to X/Z float output with Y set to 0. Unpacks compact 2D vector data.

name: FloatToBitfieldPack
summary: Multiplies float by 10.0, clamps to [0, 32767], shifts left 17 bits, and inserts into bitfield at offset 0x2C preserving low 17 bits. Packs unsigned value into high 15 bits of dword.

name: BitfieldExtractScale
filled_label: Bitfield extract and scale (inverse of pack)
summary: Extracts bits 17-31 from bitfield dword at offset 0x2C, shifts right 17, and multiplies by 0.1 (1/10). Inverse of FloatToBitfieldPack. Returns double.

name: BitfieldInsert
summary: Multiplies float by 31.0 and inserts 5-bit value into bits 12-16 of bitfield at offset 0x2C via XOR merge. Packs color channel or similar small-range data.

name: ShortComputation_29f0
filled_label: Bitfield 5-bit extract and scale (inverse of insert)
summary: Extracts bits 12-16 from bitfield dword at offset 0x2C, shifts right 12, masks to 5 bits, and scales by 0.032258064 (1/31). Inverse of BitfieldInsert. Returns double.

name: BitfieldExtract
summary: Getter: returns field 0x2C of this. No side effects. [auto]

name: FloatToBitfieldEncoder
summary: Multiplies float by 63.0, subtracts 64 bias, and inserts 7-bit signed value into low 7 bits (0-6) of bitfield at offset 0x2C. Packs signed color/audio channel data as biased offset.

name: BitfieldToFloatConversion
summary: Extracts low 7 bits from bitfield at offset 0x2C, subtracts bias 64, and multiplies by 0.015873 (1/63). Inverse of FloatToBitfieldEncoder. Converts biased 7-bit signed value back to float.

name: BitTest
summary: Getter: returns field 0x30 of this. No side effects. [auto]

name: ShortComputation_2b00
summary: Getter: returns field 0x30 of this. No side effects. [auto]

name: BitfieldExtractionWithScale
summary: Extracts 2-bit field from bits 22-23 of dword at offset 0x30 and multiplies by 0.333333 (1/3). Decodes small-range state/flag value.

name: BitfieldExtract_2b80
summary: Getter: returns field 0x30 of this. No side effects. [auto]

name: VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles
summary: Converts packed 16-bit Euler angle data (offsets 0x0-0xD) into a full 3D orientation matrix with cross-product axes, extracts Euler angles, packs results into output structure. Uses TernarySelectByBitfield and SixBitFieldToFloatDecoder values for additional rotation parameters.

name: sub_4B32A0
summary: Packs collision vertex/transform data from fixed-point struct `this` into float vector v12-v14, then processes through bitfield packing pipeline. Called by CollisionStateUpdate during collision geometry setup.

name: ArithmeticComparison_3a90
summary: Copies variable-length data from source to destination using a 10-bit size field extracted from bits 8-17 of the source's first dword, plus 8 bytes minimum. Also copies field at offset 0x1AC between structures.

name: CollisionObjectInsertion
summary: Inserts a collision object into one of 4 type-specific sub-lists based on its 3-bit type tag (extracted from header bits [31:29]). Allocates or reuses a free node from the pool, creates a 12-byte linked list entry, links into sub-list at offset 112 + index*64. Called from PitStallProximityCheck for pit collision zone management.

name: UtilityFunction_50c0
summary: Checks if float parameter is within range [lower, upper] where -1.0e32 sentinel value means the respective bound is inactive (unbounded). Supports open-ended or fully bounded range checks.

name: FloatComparisonListIteration
summary: Walks a linked list, comparing each node's float fields at offsets +12 and +444 against threshold a2. Dispatches to different processing paths based on which field exceeds the threshold, or a default handler when both are within range. Called from sub_4B9000 for threshold-based list processing.

name: LinkedListIteratorWithStateUpdate
filled_label: List Walk With Audio State Update
summary: Walks a linked list, testing each node against field/float/audio playback conditions. On match, updates node Z-position (offset 0x370) and decodes scene node via SceneNodeDecoder. Advances via next link.

name: sub_4B6190
summary: Iterates 4 worker slots, scanning a circular buffer of pit stall entries (176 bytes each) via HashTableLookup. Collects up to 12 matching entries per slot; if 9+ found, sorts by distance and assigns workers to stalls via bitfield and data operations.

name: QueuePop
summary: Drains the circular buffer via sub_4B7860 until empty, then extracts first and last data values from the result linked list into accumulators at 0xF30/0xF34. Returns 0.

name: FloatGetter
summary: Getter: returns field 0xF38 of this. No side effects. [auto]

name: ProcessDriverEntries
summary: Iterates through driver entry array (stride 4656), copies driver name strings from linked-list nodes matching a float key, resolves file paths, loads vehicle configurations, and adjusts vehicle count. Part of vehicle/driver loading system.

name: sub_4B9000
summary: Processes a frame update for zone/collision objects by traversing a BST keyed on float thresholds, dispatching network messages, and running two-pass collision filter iteration with AABB culling.

name: TimedAudioEventPlayback
summary: Plays timed audio events within a time window [a2, a3] by walking a sorted linked list of event nodes. Each event triggers stream read, ring buffer write, and audio control operations. Part of audio/event playback system.

name: sub_4B9890
summary: Orchestrates the full session loading sequence: calls LoadingPhase1, clamps time offset to [10, 180], sets up game state machine, runs key-priority/state-trigger loop, sets player vehicle index, calls LoadingPhase2. Part of session/loading state machine.

name: sub_4B9B80
summary: Processes timed audio events between two time points (ordering them ascending), resets the ring buffer, and if the event range spans an integer boundary at 1/40th scale, triggers per-vehicle sub_4EE2D0 and MultiObjectRemove calls. Part of audio/vehicle update system.

name: PitServiceSteeringAnimationStep
filled_label: Pit service steering animation state machine
summary: Advances the pit service steering animation by one step. State machine at offset 0xF8C drives direction/speed of steering wheel rotation using queue peek events and FloatAccumulator.

name: ConditionalStateUpdate
summary: Conditionally triggers a session update when the session is active (this[0]==1) and a packed flag at offset 8 is not yet set. Passes session time and message count to CallWrapper_9870.

name: GuardedDispatchWithStateCheck
summary: Conditionally calls cleanup sub when SessionCleanupFlag is set and this[0]==1. Always runs RenderToggleRefresh and clears byte flag at this+4.

name: ShortComputation_a780
summary: If this[0] is non-null, dereferences it as a pointer and returns the pointed DWORD. Always copies this[0] to this[2]. Returns 0 if this[0] is null.

name: ProgressBarIncrement
summary: Writes a progress bar stage event (type 4, ID 24) with current session time to the ring buffer for the given driver, returning the current lap/stage value at offset 0x44.

name: sub_4BC060
summary: During qualifying session (SessionType == 7), writes tire compound usage event (type 4, ID 26/27) to the ring buffer indicating whether a tire set is currently in use or discarded, with compound identifier.

name: sub_4BC340
summary: Returns true when session is server mode (dword_7C569C == 5), penalty state permits it, and race phase is one of {5, 6, 8}; used as a conditional guard for penalty logic.

name: LapSplitTimeEvent
summary: Processes lap/split timing events with state-dependent routing. Early-returns if a ride-height threshold exceeded; validates current state against expected state for event type (0→expect state 2, 1→expect state 0, 2→expect state 1); computes intersection time delta; encodes event data into ring buffer; records lap completion.

name: SentinelSlotFill
summary: Searches a fixed-size array of 10 slots (starting at this+56) for a sentinel value -1, fills the first empty slot with this[2], and returns the slot index; if no slot is free, returns 10.

name: ArithmeticComparison_d8c0
summary: Searches an integer array (count at this[1], data pointer at this[2]) for a matching value; if found, replaces it with the last element and decrements count. Returns the index of the removed element or count if not found.

name: MemoryAllocation_d900
summary: Appends a value to a dynamic integer array (capacity at this+0xC, count at this+0x10, data at this+0x14); grows capacity by 8 when full — same logic as DynamicArrayPush_004bd860 but uses different field offsets.

name: ArrayRemoveByValue
summary: Searches an integer array (count at this[4], data pointer at this[5]) for a matching value; if found, replaces it with the last element and decrements count. Returns index of removed element or count if not found.

name: ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate
summary: Iterates two dynamic arrays of objects (first by this[1]/this[2], second by this[4]/this[5]), updates tag identifier on objects whose tag doesn't match a2, and calls SwitchBasedStateHandler on each updated object.

name: sub_4BDE20
summary: Computes 2D grid cell coordinates (0-7 range) from an object's bounding box using grid origin/scale fields at offsets 0x924-0x930, then assigns the object to all overlapping cells in the 8x8 grid.

name: MatrixClear
summary: Zeroes an 8x8 grid matrix with stride 9 (clearing 64 elements at offsets 1, 10, 19, ...) and resets the cell count at this[577] to 0.

name: sub_4BE010
summary: Computes 2D grid cell coordinates (0-7 range) from an object's bounding box using grid origin/scale fields at offsets 0x924-0x930, then assigns the object to all overlapping cells in the 8x8 grid. [twin of sub_4BDE20]

name: GridCellIterate
summary: Computes 2D grid cell coordinates (0-7 range) from a position and radius using grid origin/scale fields, then calls ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate on all overlapping cells and the overflow list.

name: SpriteGridRender
summary: Computes 2D grid cell coordinates (0-7 range) from a position and radius using grid origin/scale fields, then calls ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate on all overlapping cells and the overflow list. [twin of GridCellIterate]

name: AIDriverCountSetup
filled_label: AI driver count and team setup
summary: Configures AI opponent count and assigns team/nationality data per driver based on game mode (championship vs other). Handles single-player override, random AI count generation, and per-driver team assignment.

name: sub_4BFF70
summary: Assigns starting grid positions to all vehicles based on qualifying performance or randomized order. Handles both qualifying-session grid ordering and non-qualifying random placement.

name: sub_4C0850
filled_label: Vehicle state restore from career data
summary: Restores a vehicle's runtime state (name, position, session state) from loaded career standings data. Copies vehicle name and file path strings to the season scoring database entry and sets grid position.

name: CareerStatsWriter
summary: Writes career statistics (player/opponent states, track records, race conditions, game options) to an output buffer using format strings. Iterates two linked lists: player-opponent state nodes and per-track stat records. Returns 0.

name: TrackSceneNodeAdd
summary: Adds a new track scene node to the scene list. Checks for duplicates by name via LinkedListSearchByName, parses scene data, allocates and initializes a scene node block (24 bytes), wraps it in a list node (12 bytes), and appends to the linked list at this+0x10. Returns the existing or newly inserted node.

name: TGATextureFileScanner
summary: Scans a directory for TGA texture files matching a given filename. Iterates directory entries, compares base filenames (stripping directory paths and extensions), and builds a linked list of matching results with path match priority (exact path matches appended, others prepended). Returns a list destructor result.

name: SeasonRacesSectionFinder
summary: Returns a string-keyed linked list search result for the "SeasonRaces" section using either a provided key or the current scene's data offset; guarded by a name lookup check.

name: StringCopyWithValidation
summary: Computes maximum normalized coordinate value across active physics channels. Gets channel count via FloatArrayThresholdSearch, iterates active channels, computes normalized coordinate for each via NormalizedCoordinateCalculator, and returns highest value found. [twin of sub_45B5C0]

name: sub_4C7BD0
summary: Returns true if this vehicle's grid slot index (offset 0x4894) matches the current player vehicle's starting grid position. Used as an "is this the player's car" check.

name: PropertySetter
summary: Simple setter: stores a2 into the vehicle field at offset 0x48AC (this[4651]). Returns the value that was set.

name: UpdateCameraFOV
summary: Updates camera FOV (this[2]) based on session type, race phase, elapsed race time, and lap progress. Smoothly interpolates current FOV toward computed target using frame-time delta.

name: SoundAudioPlayback
summary: Manages audio playback each frame: handles volume fade-in (state 1) and fade-out (state 2+), advances to next track in the playlist linked list, or picks a new track from scene index when the list is exhausted. Communicates with AudioMixerPtr for actual playback control.

name: sub_4CB120
summary: Initializes a reaction/particle-effects system: sets up collision restitution and physics constants from globals, handles render-throttle frame count, allocates particle arrays with sentinel init and position setup, and for type-13 (weather) generates noise tables and random particle direction vectors. Called during special effects initialization.

name: CircularBufferSlotAlloc
summary: Allocate next free slot from a circular particle buffer. Increments write index, wraps at capacity, returns pointer to slot. If slot is free (refcount < 0), bookkeeps it.

name: ParticleEffectBillboardQuadSetup
summary: Compute and write 4 billboard quad vertices for a particle sprite. Computes perpendicular vectors relative to camera direction, scales by particle size, writes each vertex position to texture buffer via PixelWriteToTextureBuffer.

name: FloatComparisonWithConstantsTable
summary: Check if a non-zero float value exists for a given particle type entry in a constant table. Iterates entries; type 1 reads field at offset 0x28 (a2[10]), type 5 reads field at offset 0x30 (a2[12]), default reads offset 0x2C (a2[11]). Returns 1 if the field is non-zero.

name: F_3DDistanceCheckAccumulate
summary: Iterates a list of objects, computes squared 3D distance from a reference position (obtained via SessionManager virtual dispatch), and accumulates parameter `a2` into objects within 32-unit radius. Calls sub_4A2840 on each updated element.

name: ConditionalDelegateDispatch
summary: If grid position index (this[0x48A4]) is unset (< 0), recalculate via sub_4C6F10. Then copy grid position data from setup scene via ArrayOfStructIndexedFieldCopy.

name: RenderCallWithGuard
summary: If grid position index (this[0x48A4]) is unset (< 0), recalculate via sub_4C6F10. Then read indexed struct data from setup scene using grid position index and column index via IndexedStructDataRead.

name: sub_4D1180
summary: Dispatch either SingleFunctionDispatch_10e0 or RenderCallWithGuard based on session type and phase. If session type == 7 (race) and phase is 2, 3, or 4 (racing), uses SingleFunctionDispatch_10e0 and returns 1. Otherwise uses RenderCallWithGuard and returns 0.

name: IndexedArrayAccessor
summary: Indexed accessor into a pit stop order array. If the array pointer (this[107]) is null, lazily loads pit stop order data via PitStopOrderLoader, then returns pointer at 8-byte stride for given index.

name: sub_4D1670
summary: Builds a 52-element occupancy bitmask from all vehicles by reading each vehicle's type field at offset 18596, then iterates 52 paired flag fields on `this`, calling FlagFieldBitManipulation to set/clear bit flags depending on occupancy.

name: ScoringGateSelector
summary: Scans a scoring/penalty gate list at this[68] with given range, selecting the highest-priority gate type (3 > 8 > 2 > 0). Returns 3 for invalid/out-of-range, or the best match.

name: RingBufferAccessWithWrap
summary: Converts a float index to an integer ring-buffer index by truncating `a2 * this[264] - 1`, wraps using modulo this[268] (buffer size), clamps to [0, size-1], and reads a 8-byte element from the buffer at this[272].

name: sub_4D1D80
summary: Periodic scoring update (0.25s interval) that computes per-vehicle position deltas, detects active/inactive transitions, sorts drivers by standing, logs order changes and data to progress bar ring buffer, and calls pit proximity detection (sub_4D1730).

name: TrackTemperatureDisplay
filled_label: Session state handler with telemetry logging
summary: Handles session state transitions for current vehicle: dispatches AI commands (command 5 for active state, command 4 for pit/transition state), updates vehicle telemetry substate, and periodically (every 3s) logs progress bar telemetry events for the player vehicle.

name: DebugLogInit
summary: Initializes the debug logging subsystem. Writes a null byte via sub_4D5BE0, conditionally sets global debug mode constants based on dword_5C753C(), processes a double constant via sub_447F30, stores a float result in this[2], then writes 228 bytes of data via sub_4D5BE0.

name: CubicHermiteInterpolation
summary: Performs 1D cubic Hermite interpolation from a coefficient table. Computes normalized parameter t = a3/a2 * this[8], clamps index to table bounds, then evaluates cubic polynomial: ((c3*t + c2)*t + c1)*t + c0, where coefficients are read from 32-byte stride entries in this[20].

name: VehicleSuspensionForceHelper
summary: Computes suspension force scaled by temperature: ((this[35] + 273.16) * a2 * 0.002778858444950814 * this[8]) + this[7]. Converts temperature from Celsius to Kelvin, multiplies by input factor, a position scaling constant, and an offset.

name: sub_4D6B00
summary: Parses a tire brand definition file (.tbc) by reading key-value pairs for front and rear tire properties (grip curves, radius, spring, damper, wear, heating, etc.), storing them into a structured tire data block. Also computes averaged grip multipliers and a wear-rating integer clamped to [7,15]. Part of the vehicle physics/tire subsystem.

name: CompoundIndexLookup
summary: Validates tire compound index a2 against range [0, this[4]) and returns pointer to compound data at this[5] + 680*a2. If index out of range, conditionally logs "tire brand doesn't" error and returns 0.

name: DebugLogWrite
summary: Writes a formatted message to the debug log file handle at this[4]. Calls FileWriteWrapperWithLock to write the buffer, then LockCallUnlockWrapper to flush/sync the file handle.

name: ConditionalIndexSetter
summary: Simple setter that writes an integer value to offset 0x4 and returns it. [twin of IntegerSetter]

name: ConditionalBranchByFlag
summary: If flag a2 is non-zero, calls IndexValidationSetter(0) and returns 0. If a2 is zero, sets this[2] = -1 (reset index) and returns 0.

name: sub_4DA0D0
summary: Renders debug/vehicle info overlay (gear/position, name, indexed extra chars, speed) for two entities (left/right columns) on screen. Part of HUD/debug UI system.

name: sub_4DA9E0
summary: Renders lap count or elapsed time text on HUD. If session has 1 lap total, shows "N LAPS" using string table lookup; otherwise computes formatted race time (MM:SS.mmm or SS.mmm) and renders with position suffix character.

name: MaxSquaredMagnitudeSearch
summary: Iterates scene graph children, computes squared magnitude of 3D vectors from packed array, returns maximum value found. Part of LOD/geometry culling system.

name: PitCrewInstanceSetup
summary: Builds full file paths for 9 pit-crew/vehicle texture types (car body, driver, arms, wing, helmet, pit body, pit helmet, lollipop, refueler) by combining base directory, team/track config strings, and fallback paths, then calls TextureAdjuster for each.

name: SceneFileTEAMDIRVEHDIRNOTSPINWriter
summary: Processes a vehicle scene file template by reading the source file, replacing directive tags (teamdir, vehdir, spin, notspin, high/med/low detail, dashhigh/dashlow) with runtime values, and writing the result to an output file. Also handles merging backup override files for physics detail levels.

name: ConditionalAudioParamSetup
summary: Stores audio parameter byte at offset 0x42, then conditionally configures audio-physics transforms. If object pointer at offset 0x0 is valid: optionally mixes audio via AudioPhysicsMixWithLerp, computes dual-matrix transforms, sets flag bytes. Otherwise zeroes six DWORD fields and clears flags. Always computes Euler rotation matrix at end. Vehicle audio setup.

name: VehicleGraphicsSceneLoader
filled_label: Vehicle graphics scene node tree loader and initializer
summary: Loads and initializes the full vehicle graphics scene graph — wheel nodes, wings, cockpit, debris, lights, and all visual sub-nodes — from a scene file and populates bounding boxes, audio parameters, and tread/sound effect handles. Part of the vehicle rendering/graphics scene management system.

name: VehicleResetClear
summary: Resets and reinitializes a vehicle state structure — zeroes large blocks of fields (timers, counters, flags, collision state, audio handles), calls destructor loops on embedded array objects, and conditionally runs multi-system init + 3D sound cleanup when collision geometry is loaded. Returns void pointer from freed memory.

name: UITimerTweenUpdate
summary: Updates UI timer/tween countdown value by dt * 0.2 speed factor and applies result to UI element state. Part of UI animation/tween system.

name: LazyInitCallback
summary: Performs one-time lazy initialization of a UI element — moves doubly-linked list node, applies position/color values, triggers sound effect, and registers in global lookup arrays. Part of UI lazy-init system.

name: ParticleEffectWorldTransform
summary: Transforms 17 particle emitter positions from local space to world space using a 3x3 rotation matrix and translation vector, then spawns particles. Part of particle effect rendering system.

name: SubsystemStateMachine
summary: Dispatch function for subsystem slot lifecycle management — routes to lazy init or conditional release based on slot ID and activation intent. Manages 14 slot types (indices 0-13).

name: ColorAlphaUpdateFlagSet
summary: Computes ARGB color value from alpha parameter (a2 * 254), writes it to all packed array elements' color field (offset 24), and sets dirty flag bit 0x10000000 at offset 0x14. Part of color/visibility update system.

name: VibrationStateMachine
summary: State machine for vibration/force feedback — transitions between off (0), low (1), and high (2) states based on |a3| thresholds (16.0 and 64.0). Updates hardware slots and audio slots on state change. Part of input/haptic feedback system.

name: MultiplayerSessionType
summary: Configures multiplayer session mode — maps session type enum (a2) to mode value at offset 0xB6C, then initializes 4 session slots at 0x1EC (74-DWORD stride) to -1. Part of multiplayer/session management system.

name: SuspensionParamUpdate
summary: Updates wheel suspension parameters — ride height offset, damper angle, and steering angle for a given wheel index. Rebuilds rotation matrix on angle change. Part of vehicle suspension system.

name: WheelSuspensionTireStateInit
summary: Initializes wheel suspension and tire state for a given wheel index — computes wheel offset from chassis origin, stores camber/toe/caster parameters, and builds rotation matrix from Euler angles. Part of vehicle suspension system.

name: SuspensionGeometryInitializer
summary: Initializes suspension geometry for a wheel — computes wheel offset from chassis origin, copies two rotation matrices (suspension orientation + upright orientation), and extracts Euler angles from both. Part of vehicle suspension initialization.

name: SceneGraphChildVelocityScaling
summary: Updates wheel suspension parameters — ride height offset, damper angle, and steering angle for a given wheel index. Rebuilds rotation matrix on angle change. Part of vehicle suspension system. [twin of SuspensionParamUpdate]

name: ScalePropagate
summary: Propagates a new scale value to scene graph children when scale changes. Computes scale ratio and updates velocity scaling on child nodes. Part of vehicle transform/scale system.

name: sub_4E3090
summary: Deforms skinned vertex positions using a bone rotation frame (tangent/binormal/normal) for a single bone. Computes transformed positions with vertex weight interpolation and clears dirty flag. Part of mesh skinning system.

name: sub_4E3360
summary: Parses vehicle audio/sound configuration file, extracts restriction-sphere and force-field-sphere parameters, and initializes per-vehicle audio playback sub-slots for engine, tire, and environmental sounds. Part of the vehicle audio initialization system.

name: StateArrayReset
summary: Resets an array of contact/state entries by calling sub_4DF110 with zero on each entry and clearing the sixth float field to 0.0. Part of vehicle state/reset system.

name: VehiclePhysicsModeDispatcher
summary: Dispatches vehicle physics integration based on mode flag at offset 0x32BC — full init+step (mode 0), sub-step integration (mode 1), or pit/team-color update (mode 2). Central physics mode router.

name: SuspensionRatioClamp
summary: Computes negated ratio of two suspension travel values and clamps to [0,1]. Yields normalized compression ratio for suspension dynamics.

name: FloatParameterForwarder
summary: Forwards float input to AccumulatorClamp, conditionally dispatches to PhysicsForceScaleDispatch when mode flag is zero. Part of physics parameter routing system.

name: ForceApplicationRouter
summary: Forwards float input to AccumulatorClamp, conditionally dispatches to PhysicsForceScaleDispatch when mode flag is zero. Part of physics parameter routing system. [twin of FloatParameterForwarder]

name: PhysicsTimeStep
summary: Forwards float input to AccumulatorClamp, conditionally dispatches to PhysicsForceScaleDispatch when mode flag is zero. Part of physics parameter routing system. [twin of FloatParameterForwarder]

name: AnisoVectorTripleProduct
summary: Computes anisotropic triple product (cross product scaled by per-axis factors, then dotted with second vector) with bias. Part of anisotropic force/spring computation.

name: PositionUpdateWithTelemetryRecording
summary: Records position telemetry data to ring buffer when session time exceeds last recording time by 4.5s threshold. Part of telemetry/event recording system.

name: CoordinateTransformWithOffset
summary: Transforms a coordinate vector from one space to another using Euler angle rotation matrix, ride height delta, and position offsets. Part of vehicle physics coordinate transformation system.

name: ConditionalGate
summary: Conditional gate that resets a per-instance field or a global flag based on rigid body constraint. Part of vehicle state management system.

name: TireScrubReset
summary: Resets tire scrub value to zero when wear mode is active and vehicle has rigid body. Part of tire wear/physics system.

name: RayTriangleIntersectionWithBarycentricCoordinate
summary: Computes ray-triangle intersection distance using barycentric coordinates. Returns minimum ride height delta clamped at 0.025, or `this[3371]` (rest height) if no valid intersection found.

name: DistanceProjectionCalc
summary: Computes projected signed distance along a direction vector between two monitored positions, clamped to TrackRefSpeed range. Part of position tracking system.

name: TireNameAccessor
summary: Looks up tire name string from compound index; returns default path if not found. Part of tire/vehicle configuration system.

name: ConditionalMathDispatch
summary: Dispatches solver call when rigid body constraint is absent. Part of physics solver dispatch system.

name: SpeedValueSetterWithGlobalMirror
summary: Sets per-instance speed value and conditionally mirrors to global when rigid body constraint is absent. Part of speed/value management system.

name: VelocityThresholdCheck
summary: Checks vehicle velocity against range [2,4] with an additional distance comparison guard. Part of collision/contact detection system.

name: RatioComputationWithClamping
summary: Computes absolute ratio of two float fields, clamps result to [0.0, 1.0]. Used by sound effect triggering for normalized intensity calculation.

name: WheelForceParameterSet
filled_label: wheel force parameter storage / direct apply
summary: Stores four wheel force/torque parameters into struct fields or applies them directly to rigid body based on enable flag. Called during pit stop wheel operations.

name: ConditionalBufferCall
summary: Dispatches solver call when rigid body constraint is absent. Part of physics solver dispatch system. [twin of ConditionalMathDispatch]

name: ReplayAIStateCheck
summary: Reads a pointer to an AI/replay state object and checks if its state flag equals 1. Used by overtaking system to determine if AI or replay is active.

name: EngineMapSetupFieldDefinitions
summary: Registers three engine parameter range/setting pairs (rev limit, engine map, engine braking multiplier) with CRTMathHelper for vehicle file parsing. Applies scale factor for RPM conversion.

name: ParameterizedCurveInterpolation
summary: Interpolates along a piecewise-linear curve defined by (x, y1, y2) triple points. Returns two interpolated values; if y2 < y1, averages both to midpoint. Handles edge extrapolation and single-point case.

name: RandomOffsetCalculator
summary: Computes a2 * scale + bias, optionally randomizing a2 first via sub_5881F0 based on an enable flag. Used for stochastic variation in physics parameters.

name: BiasValueComputation
summary: Computes a2 * scale + bias with optional randomization of a2, using different parameter offsets than RandomOffsetCalculator. Variant of the same stochastic physics parameter computation.

name: QuadraticForceModel
filled_label: simplified quadratic force model (no bias term)
summary: Computes one torque (a4) and three force components (a3[0-2]) using quadratic polynomials and absolute values. Variation of tire force model without the bias/scale term on torque output.

name: LinearVehicleParameterEvaluation
summary: Evaluates linear combinations of input parameters (a2, a3, a4) with stored coefficients plus bias terms. Outputs force components (absolute values) and a combined torque-like quantity. No enable flag — always active.

name: QuadraticForceTorqueCurveEvaluation
filled_label: quadratic curve evaluation with split linear term
summary: Evaluates a quadratic curve: a2²*C2 + a2*C1 + a2*C3 + C0. The linear contribution is split across two coefficients (C1 and C3). Disabled by flag at 0x4D4.

name: ParametricInterpolationBlending
summary: Finds which range segment a parameter `a2` falls into, then computes sqrt-based blending weights between adjacent segments and invokes virtual callbacks with scaled values. Used for suspension force blending.

name: StateHandlerDispatch
summary: Selects one of two handler tables based on a flag byte, iterates up to 45 handler objects calling each via vtable method at offset 8. Updates the flag byte after dispatch.

name: sub_4F70C0
summary: Initializes tire configuration data by loading tire property tables, sound-file paths, and visual parameters from global config arrays into two 180-byte per-tire buffers (45 slots each). Performs wildcard string matching and color-palette/setup-parameter resolution for each tire slot.

name: ArithmeticComparison_8330
summary: Computes 1.0 / (value_at_0x80 - value_at_0x84) if the difference is positive, otherwise writes 0. Used for computing a reciprocal distance or stiffness factor.

name: F_3DPositionDeltaComputation
summary: Computes 3D position delta between current-position pointer and stored reference, or between stored position and reference pointer. Falls back to (0, 0, -1.0f) when neither pointer is available.

name: VehicleProximity
summary: Computes closest-approach proximity distances between this vehicle and two other entities by projecting position+direction lines. Stores results to output fields, with FLT_MAX sentinels for parallel or non-intersecting cases.

name: RenderColorUpdate
summary: Updates color value across all render entries in a scene graph. Converts float alpha to 24-bit grayscale color, collects up to 16 node pointers, then patches color field (offset 24) in each node's packed array while preserving existing alpha channel.

name: PhysicsFloatUpdateWithCompare
filled_label: Physics float update with spatial grid compare
summary: Updates `a1[3]` (offset 0xC) by adding `a2` only if a spatial grid query succeeds and the new value exceeds the current value. Physics/collision system.

name: FieldCompareConstant
filled_label: Field sentinel comparison (not equal to FLT_MIN-like value)
summary: Returns TRUE if `this[111]` (offset 0x1BC) is NOT equal to `-9.9999997e37` (a very large negative sentinel). Used to check whether a struct field has been initialized/set. Shared utility across many callers.

name: FloatComparisonCheck
filled_label: Float sentinel comparison (not equal to FLT_MAX-like value)
summary: Returns TRUE if `this[3]` (offset 0xC) is NOT equal to `9.9999997e37` (FLT_MAX-like sentinel). Checks whether a float field has been initialized. Shared utility used by many collision/iteration functions.

name: CollisionTestWithThreshold
filled_label: Collision test with threshold and parameter interpolation
summary: Tests collision state with threshold: if field is initialized and time delta is valid, interpolates audio parameters and cross-fades collision sample; otherwise performs basic parameter interpolation. Physics/collision system.

name: TemporaryStateWrapper
filled_label: Save state, process with temporary params, restore
summary: Saves object state fields (width, stride, data pointers, flags), replaces them with temporary values (including a stack-local buffer and constant data pointer), optionally runs DirectXVertexBufferFormatConversion if format != 1, then calls vtable+8 and vtable+4 processing methods. Restores all saved fields and returns saved flag value.

name: StateMachineDispatcher
filled_label: State machine dispatcher with processing loop and polling
summary: State machine using `this+0x10` as state (205/206, 207, 210, other). Handles state transitions to 210, then enters a do-while loop polling a processing function pointer at `this+0x18C` until completion flag at offset 0x11 is set, triggering a final dispatch.

name: StreamBufferReadStateMachine
summary: State machine for reading from a stream buffer. Dispatches data chunks to a callback and advances read position until buffer exhausted, then signals completion with state 119.

name: StateMachineWithDispatch
summary: Multi-state processing function for image/texture decompression. Handles state 202 (initialize → constructor, early-exit check, transition to 203/207), state 203 (dispatch loop with callback and counter management), and fallback states (unknown → buffer processing).

name: StreamRead2ByteTokenParser
summary: Reads a 4-byte token from a byte stream: a 2-byte big-endian size that must equal exactly 4, followed by a 2-byte big-endian value. Stores the extracted value at this+0xFC and dispatches state 81.

name: CommandDispatchStateMachine
summary: Main JPEG marker parsing dispatcher. Reads the next marker from the stream using byte-stuffing-aware (BitstreamTokenReader) or raw (JPEGMarkerReader) mode based on a flag. Dispatches to specialized parsers based on the marker value (192-255 = standard JPEG markers; 1, 208-215 = special; 224-239 = APP via function table; 254 = COM handler).

name: StateCounterWithDispatch
summary: JPEG RST marker (208-215) handler that tracks the expected restart interval counter. Compares the current marker against the expected value (this+0x1E4 + 208), dispatches state 97 on match, and increments the counter modulo 8. Falls back to an alternative handler on mismatch.

name: FormatStringWithArgs
filled_label: Select format string and call vsnprintf equivalent
summary: Selects a format string from a table (primary or alternate range) by index; resolves default string on out-of-range; detects "%s" format to switch between varargs and va_list calling convention; delegates to string formatting function.

name: sub_511B7C
filled_label: PNG image row decoder with Adam7 interlace and Huffman decompression
summary: Decodes one or more rows from a PNG image (IDAT chunks) using zlib/Huffman decompression. Supports Adam7 interlacing (7-pass) with row filter processing, horizontal stretching, and optional post-processing callbacks.

name: TextureImageColorTransform
summary: Two-pass texture/audio processing on shared state: generate engine sound wave tables and remap texture RGB pixels via lookup table (if format==3), then apply per-channel bit-shift color reduction (if flag bit 3 set and format==3).

name: sub_513E80
summary: Clamp float RGB [0,1] to range and quantize to 16-bit 5:6:5 packed format. R:5 bits, G:6 bits, B:5 bits. Uses FPUControlWordMerger for rounding mode control.

name: ObjectBufferCopyWithValidation
summary: Iterate array of object descriptors, allocate 130-byte buffers for unallocated entries, copy data from source pool. Updates parent object fields with type ID and fires vtable callback on new allocations.

name: UIScreenStateMachine
summary: Ticks UI screen state machine. Reads state from vtable dispatch; handles transition logic for states 1 (active/idle) and 2 (exiting/completed). Manages screen change requests by writing new screen IDs and invoking screen methods through vtable.

name: ArithmeticComparison_5e85
summary: Initializes arithmetic comparison sub-object accessed via main object (a1). Stores UIScreenStateMachine pointer, clears two byte flags, sets active flag to 1, dispatches virtual init calls, then clears result state field.

name: MemoryAllocator
summary: Custom heap allocator using per-category free lists with 8-byte aligned allocation. Traverses free list for best-fit block, creates new blocks via MallocWrapper when necessary, tracks total allocated bytes at this+0x4C. Calls ShortComputation_5f0e error handler on oversized allocation or out-of-memory.

name: sub_516772
summary: Frees all nodes in two free list chains for a given category, decrementing the allocation counter at this+0x4C. For category a2==1, processes two active node lists first: invokes cleanup callbacks on nodes with flag set, then clears list heads.

name: RenderVTableObjectInit
summary: Allocates a 80-byte function dispatch table via MallocWrapper, populates it with 11 function pointers composing the allocator interface (MemoryAllocator, MemoryAllocatorWithAlignment, etc.), zeroes internal state fields, and stores the table at this+0x4. On allocation failure writes constant 53 to obj and dispatches error via vtable.

name: UIControlStateMachine
summary: UI control state machine per-tick update: manages control activation state, state transitions, virtual-function dispatch for rendering/input handling, and child-control position updates. Implements a state machine with flag-based branching for button press, hold, and release logic.

name: PlaybackStateController
summary: Dispatches playback state transitions by selecting stream buffer callbacks (AudioStreamBufferFill, BufferedDataStreamWrite, or RendererVtableDispatchWrapper) and zeroing state fields based on command parameter a2.

name: CompositingCopy
summary: Copies composited sprite pixel data into destination buffers through sprite object descriptors, advancing frame when the current copy line reaches the buffer limit.

name: ArrayProcessingWithValidation
summary: Validates per-object channel indices (0-3 with non-null buffers), copies channel data via sub_51A5EA, then resets decode state fields and counters.

name: sub_51B45F
summary: Decodes Huffman-coded delta values with sign adjustment, incrementally modifying existing coefficient values in a range, with rollback on failure.

name: sub_51B7CD
summary: Validates and configures bitstream/visibility plane ranges — fills a 256-entry per-plane table with a target value over a specified index range, then selects and assigns decoder callback functions (BitstreamDecoder, sub_51B154, PlaneVisibilityTestWithBitfieldOutput, or sub_51B45F) to the output object based on mode flags and bitstream presence.

name: HuffmanTreeAlloc
summary: Allocates Huffman tree context (80 bytes) with vtable method sub_51B7CD, plus a flat table buffer (count * 256 bytes) initialized to -1/0xFF.

name: AudioRingBufferManager
summary: Writes audio data to a ring buffer. On first call, allocates the buffer via vtable. Copies input samples, zero-fills newly written region if fill level advanced, and wraps cursor when buffer is full. Returns buffer capacity.

name: BufferedDataReader
summary: Reads audio data from a ring buffer into an output buffer, with clamping against available data and a size limit. Allocates read buffer on first use, copies via virtual dispatch, and wraps read position at buffer capacity.

name: SoundEffectStateCallback
summary: Handles state transitions for a sound effect audio object. Selects the appropriate ring buffer function (read/write/render dispatch) based on state parameter a2, allocates buffer on first use, and resets ring buffer position on each transition.

name: RenderBufferSetup
summary: Sets up render buffer for vehicle texture rendering. Allocates bounding box array, initializes to full grid bounds, tightens via GridOccupancyBoundingBoxScan, subdivides via sub_51D57F, computes weighted centroid for each sub-region via F_2DImageWeightedAverage, stores count to output field.

name: sub_51DFCB
summary: Dispatches between texture encoding modes based on state flag. Selects PackedPixelCopyWithPaletteLookup (mode 0/1) or BlockTextureDecompression (mode 2). Allocates dither buffer and symmetric table when entering mode 2, clears grid rows when dirty flag is set.

name: sub_51E0DC
summary: Initializes texture processing context. Allocates main structure (44 bytes), sets dispatch function pointers, validates pixel mode (must be 3), allocates 32 row buffers (4KB each), allocates palette buffer, conditionally allocates dither resources when mode 2 activated.

name: ImageBufferStrideFill
summary: Fills image buffer with stride-based per-channel gradient values. Calls CombinatorialPermutationGenerator to determine layout, allocates output buffer, fills each channel with division-interpolated byte values across the stride.

name: CodecModeSelect
summary: Selects processing function pointer (assigned to sub-buffer+4) based on mode field at this+0x4C (values 0/1/2+) and channel count at this+0x64 (==3). Conditionally initializes sub-buffers via VirtualArrayFill, MemoryZeroFill, PerIndexTableGenerationWithDivision, and sub_51E3E7.

name: ObjectSetupWithBoundsCheck
summary: Allocates a sub-object via factory function at this+0x4, initializes its fields with codec/function pointers, then conditionally clamps dimensions (width/height) based on thresholds at this+0x64 (>4) and this+0x54 (>256) by writing to the sub-object and dispatching a virtual call. Part of codec/decoder initialization.

name: RGBAColorSpaceConversion
summary: Decode RGBA color from compressed/encoded format using SSE SIMD. Performs channel bit masking, dequantization via coefficients, polynomial approximation, and conditional blend between two decode paths based on zero-comparison.

name: sub_528CC0
summary: Decode packed color data to two output vectors using SSE SIMD polynomial approximation. Performs input masking, linear transform, residual computation, integer bit extraction, conditional blend between two decode branches.

name: CMpegFilePlayer_Open
summary: Opens/initializes an MPEG file player by validating file format magic, computing audio buffer sizes via 64-bit integer division, setting up network buffer timing, and activating the underlying audio stream device. Part of the audio/video playback system.

name: BufferedFileReader
summary: Normalizes a string, validates it, converts to an index via CharToIndexConversion, allocates a 28-byte node, initializes it, and inserts it into an indexed array at `this[result]`. If the slot already holds a list, appends the node to the tail (following offset 0x18 next pointer). Returns the index, or -1 on failure. [twin of ResourceLookupOrCreate]

name: AudioStreamBufferRead
summary: Allocates/reallocates memory for a resource with mode-dependent sizing: looks up resource node for base size, falls back to linked-list search, then calls sub_58C724 with computed parameters. [twin of MemoryAllocation_5160]

name: F_4BitFieldPack
summary: Reads 4 bytes from buffered stream via sub_534E70 and packs them into a 32-bit integer (little-endian order). File I/O / binary data reading system.

name: StreamFileTypeCheckWithDispatch
filled_label: Stream file close with write flush
summary: Closes a file stream: if mode is 'w' (write), flushes remaining buffered data via FileReadLoop, copies state, then calls FileHandleDestructorWithModeCheck for cleanup. File I/O system.

name: sub_5357E0
summary: Processes compressed data through a state machine with states 0-13: validates compression header (method=8, window size), reads 4-byte header fields, decompresses data blocks via sub_537110, reads 4-byte uncompressed size, and reports errors via string pointers. Deflate-style decompression system.

name: sub_535E80
summary: Encodes a single frame or data chunk through a codec pipeline. Validates object state, selects codec handler via function table (funcs_536014), and handles audio/video format modes (42, 113, 666 constants). Part of media codec/compression system.

name: TextBufferDecompressor
summary: Refills the decompression input buffer for zlib inflate. Manages sliding window by shifting data when read position nears window end, updates hash chain offsets, reads more compressed data from stream via virtual call, and computes initial hash value from new bytes. Core buffer management helper for inflate.

name: BitstreamWriteBits
summary: Writes 3 bits at a time into a bitstream shift register. When the accumulator exceeds 13 bits, flushes 2 bytes to the output buffer and shifts remaining bits. Always calls ChecksummedBufferWriter for output tracking. Part of bitstream encoding pipeline.

name: BitstreamEncoder
summary: Encodes end-of-block marker (binary '10' followed by zero padding) into the bitstream. Flushes accumulated bits to output buffer when shift register exceeds capacity. Resets buffer capacity to 7 at completion. Part of bitstream/audio encoding pipeline.

name: BitStreamWriter
summary: Flushes accumulated bitstream data to output buffer. If bit count is exactly 16, writes both bytes and resets accumulator. If bit count is 8-15, writes one byte and shifts remaining bits. Part of bitstream encoding pipeline.

name: UnicodeBufferFlusher
summary: Flushes accumulated bitstream data to output buffer. If bit count is exactly 16, writes both bytes and resets accumulator. If bit count is 8-15, writes one byte and shifts remaining bits. Part of bitstream encoding pipeline. [twin of BitStreamWriter]

name: AudioRingBufferCopy
summary: Copies audio data from ring buffer to destination buffer, handling ring buffer wrap-around when read pointer reaches the end. Updates buffer pointers (read, write, remaining sizes), invokes optional callback for each contiguous segment copied. Part of audio output data pipeline.

name: MultiFieldSetter
summary: Copies three input parameters (position/scale components) into primary fields at offsets 4, 8, 0xC and duplicate reference fields at 0x58, 0x5C, 0x60. Sets field at 0x64 to 1.0f. Part of 3D transformation/position initialization.

name: sub_53D8E0
summary: Formats a 16-byte binary UUID/GUID structure into a standard hyphenated hex string using format "%.8X-%.4X-%.4X-%.2X%.2X-%.2X%.2X%.2X%.2X%.2X%.2X".

name: sub_541CA0
summary: Sets bit 3 (value 0x8) or clears it in field `this[0x80]` based on boolean parameter `a2`. Returns updated field value.

name: RandomRotationMatrixFromEulerAngles
filled_label: Build rotation matrix from Euler angles
summary: Computes a 3×3 rotation matrix from Euler angle inputs (a2,a3,a4) using sin/cos, writes it to offsets 0x15C-0x188 (zeros in column 4, 1.0f at 0x198), then transforms the orientation vector at 0x24-0x2C by the new matrix into 0x18C-0x194.

name: sub_541F60
filled_label: Compute aim/turn angles toward target point
summary: Computes pitch and yaw angles to face toward target position (a2,a3,a4) from current position at 0x24-0x2C. Stores result at 0x30-0x34 and calls orientation helper UtilityFunction_1cd0.

name: RenderDrawOperationWithClipping
summary: Clips draw parameters (position, dimensions, source pointer) via helper sub_543540, then performs 2D surface blit/fill if clipped region has positive dimensions. Clears status bit 0x400 in field offset 0x18 on completion.

name: TreeNodeAccumulator
summary: Recursively traverses a tree (scene graph or actor hierarchy) starting at node `a2`, accumulating values from child-linked lists into counters at offsets 0x34, 0x38, 0x3C, and 0x64. Zeroes WORD fields, folds DWORD bits, and calls TwoCounterIncrements per child entry.

name: ArithmeticComparison_7390
summary: Reads one of two fields (offset 0x8C or 0x90) based on selector constant `a3` (4096 or 0x2000). Writes selected value to output pointer `*a2` and returns it.

name: TwoCounterIncrements
summary: Increments two adjacent counters at offsets 0x84 and 0x88 by 1 each.

name: TwoListCleanup
filled_label: Clean up two linked lists with per-node cleanup
summary: Walks and frees two separate linked lists rooted at this+0x24 and this+0x2C. First list (from this+0x24 via this+0x40): traverses via node[48], calls ArrayCleanupWithDualFree on node[47]+0xBC? and frees node[47]. Second list (from this+0x2C): traverses via node[5] (offset 0x14), calls SingleFieldFree on node[4] (offset 0x10) and frees node. Resource manager bulk cleanup.

name: SceneRenderTransform
summary: Computes orientation offsets from a dual matrix transform, updates rotation matrices (orientation and random Euler), then processes wheel forces, camera projection (param 14), and recursive state traversal for an audio/scene node. Returns result from sub_5550E0 or the count field.

name: BitmaskClear
summary: Propagates flag bits through a scene graph tree: sets flag a2 on current node (this+0x3C), sets flag a3 on all children in linked list (child list at this+0x204, next at node+0x10, flag field at node+0x14). Recursively propagates to siblings if this+0x44 is non-null. Walks up to parent (this+0x4C) when a4=1. Used during buffer clear/reset operations to propagate dirty/visible flags through hierarchy. [twin of SceneGraphFlagPropagation]

name: sub_54B450
filled_label: Three-float field setter with bitmask clear
summary: Stores three float parameters at offsets 0x2C, 0x30, 0x34 (calling InterruptDispatch on each), then clears a bitmask at offset 0x40 via BitmaskClear.

name: ArithmeticComparison_b4a0
summary: Reads three adjacent fields (offsets 0x2C, 0x30, 0x34) and writes them to caller-provided output pointers if non-null. Returns `a4`.

name: TransformationMatrixUpdate
filled_label: Scene node transform matrix update with hierarchy and scaling
summary: Updates the world transformation matrix for a scene node. Concatenates with parent's world matrix if parent exists, applies XYZ scale factors when scaling flag is set, and stores final combined matrix at `this+0x1A0`.

name: SceneNodePositionGetter
summary: Lazily computes a scene node's world position transform via D3D device wrapper vtable+4 when cache flag is not set, then reads XYZ coordinates from node offsets 0xE8/0xEC/0xF0 into caller-provided output pointers.

name: DoublyLinkedListNodeMover
filled_label: Doubly-linked list node move to tail
summary: Unlinks node `a2` from its current doubly-linked list, optionally processes its subtree via TreeNodeAccumulator, then appends it to the tail of `this` list. Handles sublist merging when both source and destination have sublists.

name: DoublyLinkedListNodeTransplant
filled_label: Doubly-linked list node transplant to global list
summary: Unlinks node `a2` from its current container list and inserts it at the tail of a global list (via `dword_8B8F28+264`). Transplants sublist if present.

name: FlagFieldBitManipulation
filled_label: Flag field bit manipulation with recursive propagation
summary: Sets or clears bits 1 (0x2) and 2 (0x4) in flag field at offset 0x3C based on parameters `a2` and `a3`. Optionally propagates the operation to linked child objects when `a4==1`.

name: BitFlagReader
summary: Getter: returns field 0x3C of this. No side effects. [auto]

name: BitClear
filled_label: Clear bits 1 and 2 in flag field
summary: Clears bits 1 (0x2) and 2 (0x4) in the flag field at offset 0x3C using mask 0xFFFFFFF9.

name: Bit12FlagSet
