summary: Clears bits 1 (0x2) and 2 (0x4) in the flag field at offset 0x3C using mask 0xFFFFFFF9. [twin of BitClear]

name: UIWidgetRecursiveStateUpdate
summary: Recursively propagates a state update to linked child widgets, then sets or clears a global state flag based on parameter `a2`.

name: SceneGraphChildCount
summary: Counts nodes in a singly-linked list starting at `this[0x204]`, following next pointers at offset 0x10. Returns the count.

name: LinkedListIndexedAccessor_c230
summary: Counts nodes in a singly-linked list starting at `this[0x204]`, following next pointers at offset 0x10. Returns the count. [twin of SceneGraphChildCount]

name: sub_54D080
summary: For each triangle in a mesh, computes centroid, bounding sphere radius (max vertex distance from centroid), and dominant normal axis. Handles both 48-byte and 64-byte vertex strides based on MMX flag.

name: PackedArrayTotalSize
summary: Sums a size/count field at offset +8 from each element in a packed array with 64-byte stride. Returns total.

name: PackedArrayIndexLookup
summary: Walks packed array elements (64-byte stride), accumulating per-element size fields to locate which element contains global index `a2`. Returns pointer to the sub-element at that index within the found element.

name: RenderListIteration
summary: Iterates over scene render list elements: for non-type-2 elements, applies D3D matrix transforms; counts type-2 elements. Returns type-2 count.

name: UIFocusChange
summary: Updates UI focus state, prepares rendering batch transform, processes render list elements, and runs scene batch collision detection. Called per-frame for scene/interaction updates.

name: NetworkPacketDataWriter
summary: Writes 6 data fields from a source struct into a specific entry slot of a network/communication packet buffer array, marking the entry as dirty (bit 3).

name: LinkedNodeDestruction
summary: Frees a linked buffer node's data array and descriptor struct, then clears the reference pointer. Used for particle/scene buffer cleanup.

name: NetworkPacketDataReader
summary: Writes 6 data fields from a source struct into a specific entry slot of a network/communication packet buffer array, marking the entry as dirty (bit 3). [twin of NetworkPacketDataWriter]

name: BufferEntryClear
summary: Clears the active/dirty flag (bit 0) and resets a status field to zero on one or all render buffer entries, resetting them for the next frame.

name: SceneNodeVisibilityToggle
summary: Sets or clears the visibility flag (bit 6, 0x40) on a scene render node based on a boolean parameter.

name: sub_5506A0
summary: Walks linked list of animation nodes, decrementing track values by the entry's step value for tracks referencing a specific animation data entry, gated by entry type and timer threshold. [twin of LinkedListAnimationTimerDecrement]

name: MeshVertexIndexBufferLoader
summary: Loads mesh data from file handle or memory block, parsing header flags to determine format (material blocks vs texture/animation blocks), allocating sub-arrays, and inverting scale factor.

name: sub_550F70
summary: Destructor for loaded mesh data, handling both material-block format (bit 0) and texture/animation-block format (bit 1). Walks sub-arrays freeing allocations and decrementing refcounts, then frees the top-level array.

name: PerEntityDataBlockCopyFromParameterTable
summary: Copies parameter data from a parameter table into per-entity data blocks (136-byte stride) based on indexed entries, sets a flag, and optionally clears a bitmask on the source.

name: BinkVideoFrameRender
summary: Renders a Bink video frame onto a render surface. Waits for frame readiness, decompresses current frame via BinkDoFrame, advances to next frame, updates frame counter, then copies rendered frame to target buffer via BinkCopyToBuffer. Returns true when frame counter wraps to 0 (indicating loop completion).

name: BinkVideoFrameDecoder
summary: Decodes a Bink video frame to a surface (variant of render, uses different surface lock method). Waits for next frame, decompresses, advances frame index, then copies decoded frame to buffer via BinkCopyToBuffer with additional flag bits from a5. Returns result from surface unlock call.

name: VertexBufferSurfaceInit
summary: Initializes a vertex buffer for rendering a texture (only when flag bit 0x20000 at offset 0x24 is set). Allocates a 36-byte vertex buffer descriptor, configures primitive type (34 = D3DPT_TRIANGLESTRIP?), vertex stride (dword_8CEF78), and vertex count (768). Allocates the actual vertex buffer via BufferLockAllocate with 96-byte elements, then zeroes two fields per vertex (offset 0x8 = 0, offset 0xC = 1.0f) and calls ArithmeticComparison_0f90 to finalize.

name: sub_552910
summary: Renders a single font glyph as a textured quad. Guards on glyph index (a2 < 0x20 or >= glyph count at offset 0x44). Two rendering paths: if bit 0x10000 at offset 0x24 is set, calls ClippedRenderRegion directly; otherwise builds 6 vertices (two triangles) in vertex buffer at offset 0x10 with computed position and UV coordinates from the font texture, advancing the vertex counter at offset 0x8 by 6.

name: sub_553070
summary: Renders a text string one character at a time through font glyph rendering. Two paths: if bit 0x20000 at offset 0x24 is set (hardware path), allocates a vertex buffer via BufferLockAllocate, iterates characters calling FontGlyphRenderQuad (sub_552910), finalizes with ArithmeticComparison_0f90 and AudioBufferFormatSetup with render state (font texture, masks, alpha). If clear (software path), iterates characters directly via sub_552910 with no buffer setup.

name: sub_557120
summary: Per-frame rendering update: clears render flags, traverses sub-node array and render node linked list, updates audio nodes, animation time, and dispatches graphics vtable calls.

name: sub_5574B0
summary: Cleanup/free function for a resource node: frees sub-resource array entries (with audio and vtable cleanup), frees multiple standalone pointer allocations, and dispatches texture flag cleanup. Called from doubly-linked list node removal.

name: ArrayElementFlagSetWithBoundsCheck
summary: Sets the 0x4000 flag on an array element at given index (bounds-checked), calling a multi-field update helper.

name: BoundsCheckedArrayWrite
summary: Writes a value to offset 0xC of an array element at given index with bounds checking against the array element count.

name: sub_55B8C0
summary: Counts "MeshFile" entries within "Instance" blocks in a scene file. Opens the file, reads lines, and counts mesh file references. Part of scene file resource inventory system.

name: sub_55EBA0
summary: For each vertex, computes a reflected direction vector using D3D device transforms: transforms source position, adds offset from a2[9-11], normalizes, computes reflection via half-vector formula, maps to [0,1] range, stores at vertex buffer offsets +40 and +44. Checks MMX flag at this[6]+20 to select stride (16 vs 12). Part of billboard/reflection shader setup.

name: AppendNodeToDoublyLinkedListTail
summary: Appends a node to the tail of a doubly linked list, updating prev/next pointers between old tail and new node, setting bit 2 in node flags.

name: DoublyLinkedNodeRemovalGlobalListReInsert
summary: Removes a node from its current doubly linked list, then re-inserts it at the tail of a global UI/context linked list (dword_8B8F28+348), clearing the node's active flag (bit 2).

name: sub_561660
summary: Process transform nodes with frustum culling and screen-space projection. Iterates linked list of nodes, checks visibility bit, performs plane-distance tests against camera frustum, and appends transformed vertices to batched output buffer (up to 1023 entries).

name: NetworkPacketReceive
summary: Poll UDP socket for incoming packets using select() with zero timeout. For each received packet, null-terminate buffer and dispatch to FilePathNameLookup. Returns select result or this[57] flag check.

name: sub_563410
summary: Network receiver for audio streaming data that handles TCP and UDP socket I/O, optional XOR/RC4 decryption, and dispatches received audio note/parameter commands to the audio system. Part of the network audio streaming subsystem.

name: sub_5651B0
summary: Parses a configuration/INI file line: strips C++-style comments (//), handles quoted strings and parenthesis tracking, trims trailing whitespace, and returns a classification code (0=empty, 1=space/brace, 2=closing-brace, 3=comment, 4=value).

name: sub_565400
summary: Parses a dot-delimited config key path: copies key from offset 0x198 to string start, splits on '.', checks each token against a lookup table, and advances through the key hierarchy.

name: sub_5654A0
summary: Parses a dot-delimited config key path, validates the first token against a lookup table, and extracts the resulting string value into an output buffer.

name: sub_565520
summary: Parses config lines with either "key=value" or dot-delimited path syntax: counts '=' separators, dispatches to StringBasedLookup (single '=') or sub_565400 (path), then copies result and extracts value strings.

name: sub_5655F0
summary: Parses config string values as integer tuples (1-4 values) from parenthesized format strings after key token extraction, storing results through optional output pointers as booleans (non-zero check).

name: sub_565760
summary: Parses config string values as integer tuples (1-4 values) from parenthesized format strings after key token extraction, storing results through optional output pointers as booleans (non-zero check). [twin of sub_5655F0]

name: LinkedListDestructorWithChildCleanup
filled_label: two-level list destructor with inner cleanup
summary: Destroys two-level linked list. Calls EnhancedListCleanupWithSubObjectDelete on inner list, frees extra resource at v3[132] (offset 0x210), then iterates outer nodes freeing data (with sub-object ShortComputation_4370) and nodes. Finally zeroes list head and frees head structure. Directory/file enumeration cleanup.

name: sub_565F80
summary: Enumerates files matched by pattern recursively through directory tree. Uses obj+0x21C as reentrancy semaphore. For each non-directory file found, constructs full path (with subdirectory prefix) and adds entry via sub_565CA0. Recurses into subdirectories when a3 flag is set. File/resource scanning system.

name: DirectoryEntryIterator
filled_label: build full path from directory entry
summary: Constructs full file path by concatenating base directory (at data+0x144) with entry name (at data+48) into buffer at list_head+16. If flag at list_head+0x218 is set, normalizes path via sub_566810. Returns pointer to constructed path or 0. File/resource enumeration subsystem.

name: SubCallWithConditionalFieldFree
summary: Writes a formatted message to the debug log file handle at this[4]. Calls FileWriteWrapperWithLock to write the buffer, then LockCallUnlockWrapper to flush/sync the file handle. [twin of DebugLogWrite]

name: DataEntryAccessor
summary: Returns the custom data entry path stored at this[6] if non-null, otherwise falls back to the default application directory (byte_5EA438). Simple accessor with null check.

name: StringKeyedLinkedListSearch
summary: Frees a single resource pointer at offset +0x8, then processes an array at offset +0x10 by reading its element count from the preceding length header, iterating backward through 24-byte elements calling ShortComputation_d4d0 on each (destructor), and finally freeing the array allocation. [twin of ArrayCleanupWithDestructorLoop]

name: sub_568FB0
summary: Builds a constraint Jacobian matrix in buffer a2 from three groups of elements stored in the struct (this[140], this[142], this[144]). Each element is classified into a type (1/2/3) and the corresponding matrix block is initialized to identity (diagonal = 1.0, off-diagonal = 0). Part of physics constraint/contact solver initialization.

name: StructCopyWithReciprocalDivision
summary: Copies 3 inertia tensor diagonal components (3 doubles) from a2 to offset 0xBC, computes their reciprocals at offsets 0xD4/0xDC/0xE4, then calls InertiaTensorWorldSpaceTransform to update world-space inertia.

name: TripleBufferAllocation
summary: Allocates three buffers for constraint/joint element groups: first group count*56 bytes to this[140], second group count*132 bytes to this[142], third group count*88 bytes to this[144]. Resets all counts to 0 after allocation.

name: BufferEntryAppendWithMatrixInit
summary: Appends a 132-byte entry to the second constraint group buffer (this[142], stride 132). Stores metadata parameters at offsets 120/124/128, initializes a 3x3 matrix at offsets 24 and 48 via sub_56C3A0, and increments element count at this[141] (offset 0x234).

name: ApplyImpulseToRigidBodyWithTorque
summary: Applies impulse vector to rigid body at a world-space point: accumulates impulse into linear momentum, computes torque via cross product (lever arm × impulse), accumulates into angular momentum. Part of collision response constraint solver.

name: AccumulateAngularMomentum

name: F_3DVectorSubtractWithCrossProduct
summary: Accumulates impulse (a3) into linear momentum and cross product (lever arm a2 × impulse) into angular momentum. Same physics as ApplyImpulseToRigidBodyWithTorque but takes pre-computed lever arm vector as a2 parameter instead of computing it from world position. [twin of AccumulateAngularMomentum]

name: ConstraintStiffnessMatrixAssembly
summary: Builds diagonal and off-diagonal constraint stiffness matrix blocks for contact constraints. Computes cross product of constraint axes, transforms through world-space inverse inertia tensor, scales by inverse mass, accumulates into sparse block matrix. Part of vehicle physics constraint solver.

name: sub_56D8F0
summary: Opens a model error text log file, writes a formatted string to it, then closes the file.

name: sub_57BF00
summary: Dispatches incoming network command strings received via UDP to appropriate handlers — status reply with IP/port info, socket-based connection with port scanning, or mutex-protected state change (values 1–5) — forming the server-side command processing for a multiplayer game lobby/session.

name: sub_57CB50

name: sub_57DE30
summary: Removes a connection node from active linked list under mutex, frees it, clears connection struct fields, resets ring buffer, and reprepends to free list. Coordinates three mutexes for list access, struct field protection, and connection allocation. Calls vtable callback at offset 0x94 after cleanup. Network connection teardown.

name: sub_57E280
summary: Timer-driven periodic update (0.125s interval). Acquires mutex, iterates managed objects via vtable, processes entries matching specific condition via sub_585870, then drains pending callback queue via MutexCallbackDispatch. Network/audio update tick.

name: NetworkCleanup_fbe0
summary: Performs network shutdown: drains both mutexes (first at 0xAD8, second at 0xAF4), destroys all linked lists (two lists cleared via flush+destroy calls), calls virtual method at vtable+48, then calls WSACleanup if Winsock was initialized. Returns 1 if WSACleanup was called.

name: NetworkConnectionThread
summary: Thread entry: calls virtual init, zeros socket handles, initializes Winsock, destroys first linked list (at 0xAC8) under mutex, signals a flag at 0xB38, creates TCP (type=1) and UDP (type=2) sockets, configures both via TCPSocketInit, and marks thread ready (0xA75=1). Returns 0 on success.

name: AudioStreamingThreadShutdown
filled_label: audio streaming thread shutdown and cleanup
summary: Shuts down audio streaming thread: calls virtual shutdown callback, terminates thread, gracefully closes TCP and UDP sockets, destroys first linked list (at 0xAC8) freeing nodes via virtual delete, then calls full network cleanup. Returns 0 on success, 8 if not initialized, 9 if NetworkCleanup fails.

name: NetworkSocketInitializationAndListen
filled_label: bind both sockets, listen TCP, store IP config
summary: Initializes network listener: calls virtual init, binds UDP socket to port and TCP socket to port+50, copies IP string to config buffer, configures byte flags, starts TCP listen with large backlog, then dispatches post-listen callbacks. Returns 0 on success, 6 if bind fails.

name: sub_580DE0
summary: Processes a network query response by searching a mutex-protected linked list of pending queries, removing the matched node, marking the result object as complete, and optionally re-sending follow-up network packets based on the query state (state 3 triggers a virtual callback, state 4 re-sends with updated data).

name: StartAddress
summary: Thread start routine that runs a float-accumulation loop, polling two state conditions (vtable dispatch at offsets 0x50/0x54), and dispatching accumulated values via vtable entry 0xC when a 0.333 threshold is reached. Part of an animation/interpolation subsystem.

name: sub_584230
summary: Network message dispatcher for the multiplayer session protocol. Reads a bitmask of pending handshake/connection IDs from the packet buffer, then dispatches to 15 message-type handlers (connection request, ping, node-add, HST, clock sync, data transfer, etc.) via a switch statement. Default case returns 0 for unhandled messages.

name: sub_585040
summary: Drains two linked lists: first calls sub_584CD0 (mutex-guarded pop) in a loop dispatching each value via vtable+0x5C, then drains a second list under mutex, processing nodes with SEH cleanup and freeing memory. Part of an audio/streaming shutdown sequence.

name: sub_585130
summary: Drains two linked lists: first calls sub_584E30 (mutex-guarded pop) in a loop dispatching each value via vtable+0x5C, then drains a second list under mutex, processing nodes with SEH cleanup and freeing memory. Variant B with different list offsets.

name: sub_585870
summary: Complex trigger/event processing function. Initializes mutex-protected state, iterates objects via vtable calls, builds a linked list of qualifying objects (allocating 12-byte nodes), then processes each through a decompression/decode chain (DecompressionDecode) with vtable dispatch. Cleans up allocated nodes at end.

name: IterateTriggersViaVtableCallHandlersPerTick
summary: Iterates objects (triggers) via vtable methods (start iteration at +200, get count at +164, get item at +28, check predicate at +172), dispatches each qualifying item through a handler at vtable offset +52 with parameters from DualQueryIntoTwoOutputParams, FieldGetter_5cc0, and ReadFieldAtOffset0x14. Releases items via vtable+32 and ends iteration via vtable+204.

name: sub_586800
summary: Encodes multiple bitfield blocks (j, a3, a5, a6) into a bitmap array using metadata from a lookup table at this[7]. For each block, reads bit count and start position from table entries indexed by this[13], this[14], this[15], this[16], builds bitmask, and sets/clears corresponding bits in the array via IndexToBitmaskConversion and BitSetClearOperation. Returns BitfieldEncoder result for a4 flag.

name: FileCloseWithLock
summary: Conditionally frees a sub-object at this+0xC if non-null. Calls destructor, empty stub helper, and heap free wrapper, then nulls the pointer. [twin of ConditionalFreeSubCall]

name: FileTellSeekPositionQuery
summary: Implements file seek/tell: validates file state, flushes buffer, computes absolute position from relative offset (supports seek_cur via sub_58AD08), calls OS-level seek via sub_58C724, and manages file error flags.

name: sub_588410
summary: Compares two null-terminated strings case-insensitively, with two code paths: a locale-aware path using character-type tables (MultiByteToWideChar via sub_591FA1) and a simple ASCII path using inline case folding (tolower via bit-0x20 mask for A-Z).

name: StringFormatWithNestedIO
summary: Allocates/reallocates memory for a resource with mode-dependent sizing: looks up resource node for base size, falls back to linked-list search, then calls sub_58C724 with computed parameters. [twin of MemoryAllocation_5160]

name: sub_5895A2
summary: Handles FPU rounding and NaN/infinity values: for NaN/Inf checks the FPU exception type via UtilityFunction_1d2e and dispatches math error handling; for normal numbers applies FrndMSVCCRTRounding for rounding.

name: sub_589A35
summary: Converts a single character to uppercase. Uses locale-aware conversion via sub_589AA4 when locale is available; otherwise applies simple ASCII tolower (subtract 32 for 'a'-'z').

name: sub_589AA4
summary: Converts a single character to uppercase using the system locale via LCMapString (sub_591FA1). Handles multi-byte characters by swapping byte order and returns the uppercased result as a 1 or 2-byte value.

name: LockCallUnlockWrapper
summary: Computes maximum normalized coordinate value across active physics channels. Gets channel count via FloatArrayThresholdSearch, iterates active channels, computes normalized coordinate for each via NormalizedCoordinateCalculator, and returns highest value found. [twin of sub_45B5C0]

name: MemoryBlockValidationCheck
summary: Flushes the file write buffer, then checks flag at offset +13 for write error (bit 6); if error is set, validates the OS handle via sub_592891 to determine if the handle is invalid.

name: sub_58A0BF
summary: Iterates all thread heap slots from the global slot array (dword_8D4A24), acquires per-slot critical sections, and validates open file streams via MemoryBlockValidationCheck. Mode a1=1 counts valid streams; mode a1=0 returns -1 if any writable stream has errors.

name: FileWriteWrapperWithLock
summary: Allocates/reallocates memory for a resource with mode-dependent sizing: looks up resource node for base size, falls back to linked-list search, then calls sub_58C724 with computed parameters. [twin of MemoryAllocation_5160]

name: CRTAmsgExit
summary: C runtime assertion/error exit handler. Checks error display flag; if set, shows error dialog. Then processes the error code and calls registered exit function pointer with code 0xFF. Used by CRT stubs for allocation failures and runtime errors.

name: sub_58AE69
filled_label: _fdopen: file descriptor to FILE stream with mode parsing
summary: CRT `_fdopen` implementation that allocates a FILE stream structure for an open OS file handle and parses the mode string ("r", "w", "a" with modifiers "+tbcnSRTD"). Increments global file open count.

name: ErrorIDLookupTable
filled_label: OS error code to CRT errno mapper
summary: CRT error mapping function that translates Windows GetLastError codes to CRT errno values. Uses a two-column lookup table (error code → errno) with range-based fallbacks for common error families. Stores both original OS error code and resulting errno in TLS.

name: sub_58AFE1
filled_label: fclose: flush and close file stream
summary: CRT `fclose` implementation that flushes buffered writes, clears the file handle from critical section tracking, closes the OS handle via sub_58C724, and releases the stream structure.

name: sub_58B077
summary: Converts string to double (strtod/atof equivalent). Skips leading whitespace, parses number via locale-aware conversion, handles infinity/NaN/special values, sets TLS errno on range error.

name: sub_58B4D4
summary: Converts a single character to uppercase using the system locale via LCMapString (sub_591FA1). Handles multi-byte characters by swapping byte order and returns the uppercased result as a 1 or 2-byte value. [twin of sub_589AA4]

name: StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection
summary: Enters the critical section guarding a file stream. For streams in the CRT global array, computes index from array offset and uses lazy-init indexed CS. For external streams (outside array range), calls EnterCriticalSection on embedded CRITICAL_SECTION at offset +0x20.

name: AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave
summary: Leaves the critical section protecting a file stream. Mirror of StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection: for CRT global array streams uses indexed CritSectLeave; for external streams calls LeaveCriticalSection on embedded CRITICAL_SECTION at offset +0x20.

name: sub_58C331
summary: CRT `_close` implementation that validates the file handle index is within range and currently open, enters the per-handle critical section, closes via HandleCloseWithErrorReporting, and sets errno to EBADF (9) on invalid handle.

name: HandleCloseWithErrorReporting
filled_label: CloseHandle with cleanup and error mapping
summary: Closes an OS handle by CRT index, with special handling for shared stdout/stderr handles. Clears the handle's open-state byte in the critical section array and maps any CloseHandle failure to CRT errno via ErrorIDLookupTable.

name: sub_58C5AC
summary: Allocates a FILE stream structure from the CRT's global stream pool (dword_8D4A24 array). Searches for an available slot — either allocates a new 56-byte stream via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc or reuses an inactive slot with no I/O flags set. Initializes stream with handle=-1 and zeroed fields under critical section protection.

name: sub_58C724
summary: CRT `_close` implementation that validates the file handle index is within range and currently open, enters the per-handle critical section, closes via HandleCloseWithErrorReporting, and sets errno to EBADF (9) on invalid handle. [twin of sub_58C331]

name: FileSeekViaSetFilePointer
summary: CRT `_lseek` implementation that positions a file handle using SetFilePointer. Validates handle index, clears the EOF tracking flag on success, and maps OS errors to CRT errno via ErrorIDLookupTable.

name: sub_58C824
summary: CRT file stream position/remaining-bytes calculator. Queries file size, accounts for buffered read position, and adjusts for text-mode newline (0x0A) expansion. Sets errno to EINVAL (22) on invalid mode flag combination. [twin of sub_58AD08]

name: sub_58C9B4
summary: CRT `_close` implementation that validates the file handle index is within range and currently open, enters the per-handle critical section, closes via HandleCloseWithErrorReporting, and sets errno to EBADF (9) on invalid handle. [twin of sub_58C331]

name: sub_58CA19
summary: CRT `_read` implementation that reads bytes from a file handle via ReadFile with text-mode translation (\r\n → \n, Ctrl-Z EOF handling, pushback character support). Handles pipe break and access-denied error mapping.

name: sub_58CF35
filled_label: fputc/_flsbuf: character output to file stream
summary: CRT character output function that writes a single byte to a FILE stream. Handles stream initialization (buffer allocation, read→write mode transition), buffer fill, and direct unbuffered write via sub_58E22B. Sets error flag on failure.

name: sub_58DE2C
filled_label: Double special-case classifier for binary math operation
summary: CRT math helper that classifies special IEEE 754 double values (infinity, NaN, zero, one, compared to 1.0) for a binary double operation. Computes one of several constant results based on the combination of input classifications and returns a flag indicating whether the result is a special case.

name: CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter
summary: CRT `_lock` implementation that enters a critical section by index from the global lock table. Lazily allocates and initializes the CRITICAL_SECTION on first use with thread-safe double-checked locking. Exits fatally via CRTAmsgExit if allocation fails.

name: TwoFieldInitializer_e0b4
summary: Initializes a C++ object's vtable pointer at offset +0x50 and an integer field at offset +0x14 to 1. Constructor fragment or init helper called during TLS/thread object setup.

name: TLSValueRetrievalWithInit
filled_label: _getptd: per-thread data retrieval with lazy init
summary: CRT `_getptd` (get per-thread data) implementation that retrieves the thread-local storage data block via TlsGetValue, lazily allocating a 116-byte structure and initializing it with thread ID and vtable on first access per thread. Preserves GetLastError across the call.

name: sub_58E22B
summary: CRT `_close` implementation that validates the file handle index is within range and currently open, enters the per-handle critical section, closes via HandleCloseWithErrorReporting, and sets errno to EBADF (9) on invalid handle. [twin of sub_58C331]

name: sub_58E290
filled_label: _write: file write with text-mode newline translation
summary: CRT `_write` implementation that writes bytes to a file handle. In text mode, translates \n (0x0A) to \r\n (0x0D 0x0A) via 1024-byte chunks. Handles append-mode seeking, ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED mapping to EBADF, and returns ENOSPC (28) on empty write without error.

name: sub_58FD90
summary: Resolves a locale from language/region strings. Initializes locale info function pointer based on OS (GetLocaleInfoA on NT, sub_5904F7 on Win9x). Performs binary search matches of language string (a1) and region string (a1+64) against locale tables. Validates resulting code page and locale. Fills output structure with locale ID, language ID, and code page. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

name: MathDispatchWithErrorFallback
summary: Gate for floating-point parsing — if FPE exception flag (dword_5E9AD0) is set, writes error code 33 to TLS slot, resets FPU control word with mask 0xFFFF, and returns input double unchanged; otherwise delegates to FloatParsingWithErrorHandling.

name: ConditionalMathWithDAT005e9ad0Flag
summary: Dispatches floating-point operation based on decoded exception code bit flags. If sub_5919DA returns false, calls sub_591727 for exception context setup. Then if FPE flag (dword_5E9AD0) is set or decoded mode is zero, sets error code, resets FPU, returns fallback (a4); otherwise forwards to FloatParsingWithErrorHandling.

name: sub_5919DA
summary: Checks FPU exception code bits (a1, lower 5 bits) against FPU control word mask bits (a3). For each masked exception (divide-by-zero, denormal, underflow, overflow, inexact), applies the appropriate result value based on rounding mode and clears the bit. Returns TRUE when all exception bits are consumed/handled.

name: FloatParsingWithErrorHandling
summary: Computes maximum normalized coordinate value across active physics channels. Gets channel count via FloatArrayThresholdSearch, iterates active channels, computes normalized coordinate for each via NormalizedCoordinateCalculator, and returns highest value found. [twin of sub_45B5C0]

name: sub_592891
summary: Flushes file buffers for an open file identified by index. Validates index against open file count, checks active flag in per-slot bitfield, enters critical section, calls FlushFileBuffers, reports errors via TLS. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure with TLS error 9.

name: sub_5932BA
summary: Conditionally performs error cleanup and exit display. If ErrorDisplayFlag is 1 or console is attached (ConsoleAttachedFlag == 1 when flag unset), calls sub_5932F3(0xFC) for cleanup, runs optional InitCallbackFunc, then sub_5932F3(0xFF) for termination display. Otherwise returns 0 (no display needed).

name: SEHWrappedRenderDispatchCall
summary: Dispatches C++ catch handler by reading handler function pointer from exception record's handler table and calling via atomic lock/unlock wrapper with handler context data.

name: sub_59416F
summary: Allocates a block from the custom slab buddy allocator. Rounds request size up to 16-byte boundary, searches slab descriptors for suitable free block (wrapping cursor), splits remainder, updates two-level free bitmap and free lists. Returns pointer to allocated memory or 0 on failure.

name: sub_594478
summary: Allocates a new slab (32KB block) for the custom heap allocator. Grows slab descriptor array via HeapReAlloc if capacity exhausted. Allocates bitmap/free-list metadata (0x41C4 bytes) via HeapAlloc and slab memory (1MB reserve) via VirtualAlloc. Initializes descriptor fields and bitmap. Returns descriptor pointer or 0 on failure.

name: sub_594529
summary: Initializes a newly allocated slab for first use. Commits 32KB slab virtual memory via VirtualAlloc, initializes 64 free-list heads, sets up per-block header linked lists (free block chain), configures bitmap tracking entries, and updates slab descriptor flags. Returns slab size class index or -1 on VirtualAlloc failure.

name: SlabBuddyAllocatorInitialization
summary: Initializes the slab buddy allocator. Selects context (static pool or HeapAlloc), reserves 4MB virtual address space, commits initial 64KB, initializes per-block free lists and block headers in committed region. Returns allocator context pointer or 0 on allocation failure.

name: sub_594AB4
summary: Walks the allocator context linked list and decommits free pages (state 240) via VirtualFree, up to a given page limit. Updates live page counter and lowest-free pointer. If all 1024 pages in a context become free, destroys the entire context via sub_594A5E.

name: CounterThreshold
summary: Adds a byte value to a per-page counter in the allocator tracking array. When the counter reaches 240 and the total live page count hits 32, triggers a page trim (sub_594AB4 with limit 16). Clears the source byte after adding.

name: sub_594C12
summary: Allocates memory from the slab buddy allocator system. Iterates existing allocator contexts searching for a free block of sufficient size via sub_594E1A. If none found, creates a new context via SlabBuddyAllocatorInitialization. Returns allocated pointer or 0 on failure.

name: sub_595801
summary: Allocates a file slot from the global file descriptor array (dword_8D4920, 32 slots per group, 36 bytes each). Scans for free slot (bit 0 clear), initializes per-slot critical section if needed, marks slot in-use. If no slot found, allocates new group. Returns slot index or -1 on failure.

name: sub_595924
summary: Assigns a Windows handle to a CRT file descriptor slot in the global array. Maps indices 0/1/2 to console standard handles (STD_INPUT/OUTPUT/ERROR) when console-attached flag (dword_5E65B4) is set.

name: sub_5959A0
summary: Assigns a Windows handle to a CRT file descriptor slot in the global array. Maps indices 0/1/2 to console standard handles (STD_INPUT/OUTPUT/ERROR) when console-attached flag (dword_5E65B4) is set. [twin of sub_595924]

name: sub_595A1F
summary: Returns the raw Windows handle from a CRT file descriptor entry if the entry is marked open (bit 0 of flags at offset+4). Otherwise sets TLS error 9 and returns -1.

name: CriticalSectionEnterWithLazyInit
summary: Enters the critical section for a CRT file descriptor index (a1). Lazily initializes the CRITICAL_SECTION at offset+12 via CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter/CritSectLeave guard if the init count at offset+8 is zero.

name: sub_596030
summary: Wrapper around sub_596089 (wide-to-multi-byte conversion) with thread-safe locale initialization guard. Increments heap lock counter, conditionally enters critical section (slot 19) if thread locale refcount (dword_8D5A58) is non-zero, then calls conversion and releases accordingly.

name: sub_596175
summary: MSVCRT math error handler dispatcher. Examines the error type code at a2, selects a handler action (4, 17, 18, 8, 16) based on sequential comparisons, optionally invokes sub_5919DA for error logging, calls sub_591727 to set up arguments, and returns error code via SetErrorCodeBasedOnInputRange depending on FPE exception flag (dword_5E9AD0) and stub result.

name: sub_596716
summary: Wrapper around sub_596089 (wide-to-multi-byte conversion) with thread-safe locale initialization guard. Increments heap lock counter, conditionally enters critical section (slot 19) if thread locale refcount (dword_8D5A58) is non-zero, then calls conversion and releases accordingly. [twin of sub_596030]

name: sub_597234
summary: Displays a MessageBoxA using the last active popup window as parent. Lazily loads user32.dll and resolves MessageBoxA, GetActiveWindow, GetLastActivePopup function pointers on first call. Returns the MessageBox result or 0 if DLL load/resolution fails.

name: sub_598E9E
summary: Writes a single character to buffered output with optional codecvt encoding conversion. Handles direct buffer write, overflow via vtable dispatch, and multi-byte conversion via codecvt facet vtable call at index 5. Returns character written or -1 on error.

name: CharValidationAgainstEncodingTableWithLocaleFall
summary: Validates a character for putback or output, handling encoding table check and codecvt conversion. Either returns character to putback buffer, validates backward scan with truncation, or writes raw byte to output. Returns character or -1 on error.

name: sub_5990AE
summary: Reads one decoded character from buffered input stream with codecvt encoding conversion. Returns buffered byte directly if available; otherwise reads via StreamGetcWithUnderflowHandler, converts through codecvt vtable[4] (do_in), and handles partial/error results.

name: sub_599ED6
summary: Writes a single character to buffered output with optional codecvt encoding conversion. Handles direct buffer write, overflow via vtable dispatch, and multi-byte conversion via codecvt facet vtable call at index 5. Returns character written or -1 on error. [twin of sub_598E9E]

name: FileOffsetPositionValidation
summary: Validates a character for putback or output, handling encoding table check and codecvt conversion. Either returns character to putback buffer, validates backward scan with truncation, or writes raw byte to output. Returns character or -1 on error. [twin of CharValidationAgainstEncodingTableWithLocaleFall]

name: sub_59A103
filled_label: Locale-aware char extraction with format conversion
summary: Extracts wide character from stream with locale-aware format conversion. Fast path returns buffered char via StdGninc; main path reads chars through a format-conversion pipeline using virtual vtable[4] callback on locale facet at offset 0x38; falls back to IOFormatWrapper when no facet exists.
